item.title: Petrobras pode incluir projeto de gás na Colômbia em plano de negócios 2027-2031
item.description: A Petrobras poderá incluir o projeto de gás natural Syrius, no mar da Colômbia, como parte da curva de produção a ser apresentada em seu plano de negócios para o período de 2027 a 2031, previsto para o final deste ano, caso consiga aprovar a tempo a licença ambiental, afirmou uma executiva da companhia nesta quarta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Petrobras (PETR3.SA) poderá incluir o projeto de gás natural Syrius, no mar da Colômbia, como parte da curva de produção a ser apresentada em seu plano de negócios para o período de 2027 a 2031, previsto para o final deste ano, caso consiga aprovar a tempo a licença ambiental, afirmou uma executiva da companhia nesta quarta-feira. A Petrobras, que atua como operadora com uma participação de 44,4% em parceria com a estatal colombiana Ecopetrol, avançou na obtenção da licença ambiental para o projeto, mas ainda precisa concluir as consultas com as comunidades locais, disse Sylvia Anjos, diretora de Exploração e Produção. "Acho que deve aparecer sim (na curva de produção), se a gente conseguir essa licença; mas talvez entre", disse Anjos, a jornalistas, durante o congresso de petróleo e gás ROG.e. "Ainda me falta... um número bem reduzido de comunidades para aprovar o projeto ambiental. Se eu tiver a licença ambiental, aí eu posso aprovar o projeto de produção... tendo a licença, o próximo passo é aprovar na diretoria." A executiva reiterou que o projeto prevê a construção de um duto que vai levar o gás do fundo do mar diretamente para a costa, sem a necessidade de uma plataforma. "A gente fez um projeto bastante inovador por ser um gás metano, um gás lindo, que não precisa processar nada, é maravilhoso. Então ele vai sair do fundo do mar, o gasoduto, até chegar no terminal em terra. Então não vai ter uma plataforma", afirmou. Questionada se a Petrobras está estudando investir na Venezuela, Anjos descartou. Entretanto, disse que está estudando "tudo que é disponível na África". Na semana passada, a Petrobras informou ter assinado contratos de partilha de produção para a exploração de oito blocos marítimos na Costa do Marfim "com elevado potencial", em mais um passo da petroleira que expande sua atuação na costa oeste africana, enquanto busca novas oportunidades para realizar descobertas e recompor suas reservas de petróleo para a próxima década. Além da Costa do Marfim, a Petrobras vem buscando oportunidades em [USN:L6N44I10F TEXT:"países"] que incluem Gana, São Tomé e Príncipe, Namíbia e África do Sul.

item.title: Brazil's Petrobras may include Colombia gas project in 2027-2031 plan, exec says
item.description: Brazil's state-run oil firm Petrobras may include the Sirius offshore gas project in Colombia as part of the production curve to be unveiled in its 2027-2031 business plan later this year, a company executive said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Brazil's state-run oil firm Petrobras (PETR3.SA) may include the Sirius offshore gas project in Colombia as part of the production curve to be unveiled in its 2027-2031 business plan later this year, a company executive said on Wednesday. "I think it should appear (in the business plan) if we get the environmental license," said Sylvia Anjos, director of exploration and production, to journalists at an oil industry event. She added that Petrobras has made progress toward obtaining the license, but still has to conclude consultations with local communities. The firm serves as the operator in the project with a 44.4% stake along with Colombia's Ecopetrol (ECOPETROL.CN) . The project foresees the construction of a pipeline that would carry gas from the seabed directly to the coast, without the need for a platform, Anjos said. Petrobras said [USN:L1N40Z0XJ TEXT:"earlier this year"] that it had completed more than half of the prior consultations needed, a legal requirement designed to protect the rights of ethnic communities that may be affected by such projects.

item.title: US drafted a memo condemning UK over West Bank sanctions. It was never released
item.description: In early September, US officials in Jerusalem and Washington prepared a draft statement attributed to Secretary of State Marco Rubio condemning plans by the UK, France and Canada to block imports from Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank.
item.dc:creator: Humeyra Pamuk, Alexander Cornwell
item.content:encoded: In early September, US officials in Jerusalem and Washington prepared a draft statement attributed to Secretary of State Marco Rubio condemning plans by the UK, France and Canada to block imports from Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank. The September 8 dated document, previously unreported and which two sources said was driven by David Milstein, an influential aide to US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee, proposed that Rubio describe the countries' [USN:S8N42N05Y TEXT:"actions"] as a series of hostile measures against Israel that contribute to antisemitism. "These tactics unacceptably draw from the playbook of the antisemitic boycotts, divestments and sanctions movement," the draft document, reviewed by Reuters, said. The statement was never released. According to three people familiar with the matter, the statement was not supported by the White House and the State Department's senior leadership. The people spoke on condition of anonymity. Instead, speaking to reporters on September 8 in Florida before traveling to Latin America, Rubio refrained from outright criticism of the decision or any particular country. "Obviously, we’re not going to do what the UK did. We saw their announcement today, but I don’t have any comment on it right now," Rubio said. The episode illustrates a widening divide between the White House and Trump's senior diplomats in Israel about how best to respond to the expansion of Israeli settlements under Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's right-wing government. It also highlights a growing ideological split within the American right over support for Israel, with polling showing younger Republicans holding an increasingly unfavorable opinion of Washington's closest Middle East ally. President Donald Trump earlier this year expressed his opposition to settlement expansion, a growing source of friction with Israel's Arab neighbors, but his administration has put little pressure on Israel to change its policy. That has at times put him at odds with Huckabee, a Baptist minister who is a staunch supporter of settlements and who refers to the West Bank by its biblical name, Judea and Samaria, a term used by the Israeli government but not formally adopted by the US. Huckabee's aide Milstein last year advocated that the US impose sanctions on the entire International Criminal Court to convince it to drop war crimes charges against Israeli leaders over the Gaza war - a measure the Trump administration has yet to deploy. In response to questions from Reuters, a senior US official said the draft statement was not prepared in consultation with the State Department or White House. The US embassy referred questions, including requests for comment from Huckabee and Milstein, to the State Department. The White House did not respond to a request for comment. US PUBLIC SUPPORT FOR ISRAEL QUESTIONED US public backing for Israel has fallen since the Gaza war began in 2023, particularly among Democrats. A June Quinnipiac University poll found 48% of voters and 66% of Democrats believe the United States is too supportive of Israel, up from 16% and 20% when the question was first asked in 2017. While large majorities of Republicans aged 50 and older view Israel positively, younger conservative Americans have grown more critical, a Pew Research Center poll from late March showed. Some 57% of Republicans aged 18-49 have an unfavorable opinion of Israel, up from 50% a year previously. In December last year, Trump said that he and Netanyahu, whose government has overseen a rapid expansion of settlements, [USN:S0N3XP00A TEXT:"did not"] fully agree on the West Bank following a meeting with the Israeli leader. That September, Trump said he would not allow Israel to annex the territory. Israel has occupied the West Bank since the 1967 Arab-Israeli War. The United Nations and most countries consider settlements to be illegal under international law governing military occupation. Israel rejects this, viewing the territory as disputed rather than occupied. Violence by Jewish settlers against Palestinians in the territory has risen sharply this year, some of them emboldened by support from Netanyahu's right-wing government, which includes ministers who are themselves settlers. Huckabee has publicly [USN:L8N44H0H7 TEXT:"condemned"] the violence and called for perpetrators to be prosecuted. He has also said violent settlers were a minority and do not represent the wider settler community. Some 500,000 Israeli settlers and 3 million Palestinians live in the West Bank, territory Palestinians have long sought for a future state, along with Gaza and East Jerusalem.

CAPE TOWN, Sept 23 : World Cup winner Patrick Vieira headlines a lengthy list of new coaches in charge of African national teams as the group qualifiers for next year’s Africa Cup of Nations finals kick off on Thursday. Vieira takes charge of Senegal, where he was born, as they look to recover from a disappointing World Cup where they were expected to pose Africa’s best challenge at the tournament in Canada, Mexico, and the United States but delivered an underwhelming performance that cost their former coach Pape Bouna Thiaw his job. A total of 21 new coaches will be in charge this week as 48 countries begin the group phase of the qualifiers. The list includes six of the 10 African countries who competed at the World Cup. Vieira was only a child when he and his mother left Dakar for France, whom he helped win the 1998 World Cup.

“I have lots of flashes, such as the place where I used to play football with a tennis ball,” he said after returning to the country as an adult. However, there is no home debut for Vieira this month with Senegal playing Mozambique and Ethiopia away and then playing a friendly against the Comoros in Marseille. PAST CUP OF NATIONS WINNERS BACK IN COACHING ROLES Winning Cup of Nations coaches Aliou Cisse (Senegal 2021) and Herve Renard (Zambia 2012 and Ivory Coast 2015) have new jobs, with Cisse coaching Angola, who face Egypt in Cairo on Friday. Renard has an equally tough return to the role of Ivory Coast coach as they host neighbours Ghana. Renard was drafted in as an emergency to coach Tunisia at the World Cup, after Sabri Lamouchi was dismissed following a heavy defeat in their first game. The North Africans have since appointed Moin Chaabani, a former international defender, to revive their fortunes. Sebastien Migne is the new coach of Gabon, who begin their campaign away to Morocco on Friday. The Frenchman should know their opponents well, having coached Haiti when they twice led Morocco in a World Cup group game in Atlanta before losing 4-2. There is also a return for 78-year-old Claude Le Roy, as coach of Congo, who are away against Namibia on Thursday. Le Roy last coached Togo five years ago. It will be the veteran French coach’s 12th national team appointment and a second stint with the Congolese, where he was coach from 2013 to 2015. Le Roy holds the record for the most tournament appearances (9) and matches (38) coached at the Cup of Nations finals.

(Editing by Toby Davis)

item.title: ベッセント米財務長官、中国の何立峰副首相と再び会談－首脳会談前に
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： ベッセント米財務長官は23日、中国の何立峰副首相と再び会談した。両氏は米中間の経済協議を主導しており、20日にニューヨークで会談したばかり。今回の協議は、習近平国家主席が米国に到着し、トランプ大統領と会談する数時間前に行われた。

ベッセント氏は会談後、Xへの投稿で、何氏と「実質的な協議」を行ったと説明。「米国の労働者、農家、企業を守る意義ある約束を取り付けるとともに、米国の経済・国家安全保障上の利益を推進することに引き続き重点を置いた」と述べた。

協議はホワイトハウスに近い世界銀行本部で行われたと、事情に詳しい関係者が明らかにした。世銀自体は協議に関与していないという。

ベッセント氏と何氏はそれぞれ1時間余り、世銀内に滞在した。何氏は午前11時40分、李成鋼商務次官（国際貿易交渉代表）とともに本部を出た。その後、廖岷財政次官も退出した。李氏と廖氏はいずれも20日にニューヨークで行われた会談にも出席していた。

ニューヨークでの協議では、米中当局者はAIや貿易、投資を巡る数時間に及ぶ話し合いを前向きに評価した。李氏は「良い雰囲気」で行われたと述べ、ベッセント氏も協議は「非常に成功した」と評価していた。

原題：Bessent Met China’s He for Talks on ‘Unfinished’ Work (Correct)（抜粋）

item.title: World's largest copper mine halts operations after worker death
item.description: Operations at the world's largest copper mine, BHP's Escondida mine in Chile, were suspended on Wednesday after a worker was killed in an accident, the firm said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Operations at the world's largest copper mine, BHP's (BHP.AX) Escondida mine in Chile, were suspended on Wednesday after a worker was killed in an accident, the firm said. BHP said the worker had been killed while carrying out maintenance work. The union representing the site had previously told Reuters that the accident involved a front-end loader frequently used by the industry. "All operational activities at the mine have been suspended," BHP said in a statement, without giving a timeline for when they may restart. Typically in Chile, mines may only kick off activities after a fatal incident once inspectors verify that conditions are safe enough for a restart. Escondida is located in Chile's Atacama Desert. BHP operates the mine, while Rio Tinto (RIO.L) holds a 30% stake and Japan-based JECO Corp 12.5%. BHP had estimated the site would produce up to 1.28 million metric tons of the red metal this year.

item.title: US lawmakers propose overhaul of China tech review before Trump-Xi talks
item.description: The Republican chair of the US House Energy and Commerce Committee and the panel's top Democrat unveiled bipartisan legislation to overhaul a federal process that blocks Chinese technology from entering the US market, as President Donald Trump prepares to meet Chinese President Xi Jinping on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: The Republican chair of the US House Energy and Commerce Committee and the panel's top Democrat unveiled bipartisan legislation to overhaul a federal process that blocks Chinese technology from entering the US market, as President Donald Trump prepares to meet Chinese President Xi Jinping on Thursday. The bill would rewrite procedures governing the Federal Communications Commission's "Covered List," which has become a central tool in Washington's efforts to restrict Chinese technology on national security grounds. The move comes amid a broader US-China struggle over trade and technology. The legislation, first reported by Reuters, signals congressional concern about how the FCC is using its authority to restrict Chinese technology. Representatives Brett Guthrie and Frank Pallone said in a joint statement the legislation would change how products are added to the FCC's Covered List and require the agency to seek input from other government agencies before determining whether foreign technology poses an unacceptable national security risk. “The current process for identifying and barring malicious foreign technology has worked in many cases, but lacks the transparency, consistency, and clarity needed to meet our long-term national security needs as technology rapidly advances," the lawmakers said on Wednesday. The Covered List has been used by the FCC to ban new Chinese drones, robots, routers, power inverters and other equipment from Chinese companies and has been one of the most significant parts of the Trump administration's China policy. Reuters reported last month the FCC could use the list to ban imports of new models of [USN:L1N43P156 TEXT:"Chinese optical transceivers "]that are crucial to data centers. Trump and Xi are scheduled to hold talks in Washington on Thursday. FCC Chair Brendan Carr did not immediately comment on the lawmakers' proposal. SUDDEN DISRUPTIONS The proposal would also give Congress the ability to reverse FCC Covered List determinations and require input from the Commerce Department before determining specific foreign gear poses unacceptable risks to national security. The FCC would be required to report to Congress at least seven days before placing any technology on its Covered List and make clear the FCC does not have to retroactively review or revoke any equipment authorization issued before a company or product was added to the Covered List. That aims to offer "stability to American consumers and companies so that they do not face a sudden disruption by the placement of certain technology or equipment on the FCC’s covered list." In June, the FCC used the designation to ban the import of previously approved equipment from a group of Chinese manufacturers including Huawei, Dahua (002236.SZ) , ZTE (000063.SZ) and Hikvision (002415.SZ) . The FCC's actions aim to push Chinese gear out of technology supply chains and spur domestic manufacturing. "I don't think it's an exaggeration to say FCC has become the center of gravity for competitive actions towards China in this Trump term," said Eric Sayers of the American Enterprise Institute in Washington.

AMSTERDAM, Sept 23 : Germany coach Juergen Klopp refused to make any promises of silverware on Wednesday but said signs of progress should be visible when his side face the Netherlands in his first match in charge in the Nations League on Thursday. The former Liverpool manager succeeded Julian Nagelsmann in July after Germany's shock 2026 World Cup exit. Nagelsmann had said following Germany's Euro 2024 quarter-final defeat that he was sad he would have to wait two years to lift the World Cup, a prediction that came back to haunt him when his side were eliminated by outsiders Paraguay this summer. Klopp was asked about his remark at the start of his Liverpool tenure that he would probably have won a title if he was still in the job four years later. He went on to win a string of trophies, including the Premier League and Champions League titles.

He was far more circumspect on Wednesday. "I don't want to promise anything," Klopp told a press conference. "What I can say is we will try and that's what it is about now. That's where we are at the moment." Four-times world champions Germany have been eliminated early at the last three World Cups and have tasted no major international success since lifting their last World Cup in 2014. Klopp raised eyebrows last week by naming two separate squads for two sets of two matches in the coming days as he rebuilds the national team ahead of Euro 2028. "I am in charge of the senior team and my task is to take the football there so that we are in with a chance to win every game we play," Klopp said. "It won't work every day but we are working at it. I hope we can see some things already tomorrow."  "We need to take steps and the boys are ready for that," he said. After visiting the Netherlands on Thursday, Germany host Greece on Sunday and Serbia on October 1 before travelling to Greece three days later.

item.title: Hacked FBI data has sensitive information about employees’ intelligence roles
item.description: FBI data allegedly stolen by the hacking group ShinyHunters carries granular detail about scores of bureau officials’ job assignments, including sensitive work against Chinese spies, Russian intelligence, drug cartels, and more, Reuters has found.
item.dc:creator: Raphael Satter, A.J. Vicens
item.content:encoded: FBI data [USN:L6N45E0VU TEXT:"allegedly stolen"] by the hacking group ShinyHunters carries granular detail about scores of bureau officials’ job assignments, including sensitive work against Chinese spies, Russian intelligence, drug cartels, and more, Reuters has found. The 5,000-line spreadsheet – said by the hackers to represent only a small piece of their claimed two- to three-terabyte trove – includes names, addresses, telephone numbers, dates of birth, social security numbers, and emergency contact details for what they claimed were thousands of FBI employees. It also includes details of assignments to specific field offices and, in some cases, to units engaged in high-stakes intelligence, security, or counterespionage work. In a statement, the FBI said it was aware of "a cyber-criminal enterprise group claiming a compromise of the FBIJobs.gov portal and alleged impact to FBI employee personally identifiable information." The bureau said the cause of the breach was still undetermined, but that it was "actively and aggressively investigating the matter." The hackers said on Tuesday that they had breached the FBI, stealing data on a large number of current and former FBI employees. ShinyHunters said it is holding the data hostage until the bureau rescinds an unflattering statement about the group issued in May. Former FBI counterintelligence operative Eric O’Neill said the data allegedly stolen by ShinyHunters was “a foreign intelligence service goldmine.” “China would be incredibly interested to know the individuals who are working against it,” said O’Neill, who founded the cybersecurity company Nexasure AI after [USN:N23346564 TEXT:"his stint at the bureau"]. He predicted that other hostile intelligence services would be eager to get their hands on the data, along with disgruntled extremists in the United States. “If I were on that list I would be very concerned,” he said. ShinyHunters said in a statement Wednesday that it was trying to keep the personnel information from circulating widely in the meantime. “If the 5,000 sample data records leak, it’s not because of us,” the group said. Although Reuters has not been able to authenticate the entire spreadsheet, it has been able to individually verify the details of more than 22 people by cross-referencing information in the hacked data with credit records and previous data leaks carried by the dark web intelligence platform District 4 Labs. COUNTERTERRORISM, COUNTERINTELLIGENCE AND SURVEILLANCE Some of the assignment details in the ShinyHunters’ data are indistinguishable from what employees themselves might say publicly, noting agents at field offices in Baltimore or Newark, New Jersey, for example. But in some cases, the data referred to FBI units or initiatives that were sensitive or whose existence has not previously been disclosed. The data names 14 staffers focused on China-related matters, including members of the “China criminal enterprise unit,” the “China tech transfer analysis unit,” and the “China intelligence section.” Nine others are listed as serving in Russia-related roles, including two in the “Russia Operations Section” and one working on “Russia Critical Infra and Tech Threat.” Three people are listed as working in Iran- or Hezbollah-focused intelligence roles. Eighteen others are listed as working with “data intercept” or “telecom intercept” technologies, or in the FBI’s “clandestine technical operations” unit, or its “covert access section,” or in video, audio, or electronic surveillance roles. A further 11 FBI staffers are listed as working in HUMINT, or human intelligence, jobs, including several listed as working in the “Humint program management section.” Trevor Hilligoss, a former Army investigator who worked with the FBI, said the information tying specific named people to human intelligence work was particularly troubling. “You don’t have to look far to find examples of undercover agents being harmed when their cover is blown,” he said. Hilligoss, now the chief intelligence officer for cybersecurity company SpyCloud, said his concerns were heightened by the inclusion of emergency contacts – often spouses or children – “who may have less operational security knowledge than their relative that works in a sensitive field.” Reuters could not verify that all the job assignments were authentic or up-to-date, but it was able to match the career details or titles of eight people whose data was leaked to information in court filings, news articles, or public profiles on LinkedIn or to online posts on sites such as Instagram. OTHER TARGETS ShinyHunters previously claimed credit for the purported theft of [USN:L6N40W1A9 TEXT:"millions of business records"] from video game developer Rockstar Games, the maker of "Grand Theft Auto," and an intrusion focused on the [USN:L6N41P0Z6 TEXT:"education tool Canvas"] that triggered widespread disruption [USN:L6N41L0UT TEXT:"across U.S. schools"]. In May, the FBI said ShinyHunters sometimes used “exaggerated claims of access to sensitive or personal information to prompt payment from victims.” ShinyHunters said its "threats and claims are very real,” adding that the FBI's statement was why it targeted the bureau. Reuters has not been able to verify what else the hackers are holding. ShinyHunters previously told Reuters they obtained files related to the vetting of employees and applicants, the contracting of background investigations, and agents' sensitive medical data, but said on Wednesday it would not release any further data. O’Neill, the former FBI operative, cautioned against drawing conclusions about what the hackers hold. “They’re really trying to scare the hell out of the FBI,” he noted.

item.title: BHP dice detiene operaciones de mina chilena Escondida tras muerte de trabajador
item.description: La minera global BHP dijo el miércoles que todas las actividades operacionales de la mina Escondida en Chile, el mayor yacimiento mundial de cobre, se encuentran suspendidas tras un accidente que dejó un trabajador fallecido.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La minera global BHP dijo el miércoles que todas las actividades operacionales de la mina Escondida en Chile, el mayor yacimiento mundial de cobre, se encuentran suspendidas tras un accidente que dejó un trabajador fallecido. El presidente del sindicato de trabajadores, Sebastián Liberona, había confirmado más temprano a Reuters el deceso del trabajador, ocurrido mientras realizaba labores de mantenimiento. "La compañía informó de inmediato a la autoridad y activó los protocolos internos correspondientes. Todas las actividades operacionales de la mina se encuentran suspendidas", dijo en un comunicado. De acuerdo a la normativa chilena, las mineras solo pueden retomar sus actividades tras un accidente fatal una vez que se realizan las labores periciales y los inspectores verifican que las condiciones son seguras para retomar labores. La empresa agregó que inició una investigación para esclarecer las causas. En tanto, el sindicato de trabajadores -donde pertenecía el trabajador- pidió a las autoridades administrativas y judiciales una investigación exhaustiva. "Las presiones por la continuidad operacional y productividad no pueden significar la falta de control de graves riesgos", señaló en un comunicado posterior. Escondida está ubicada en el desierto de Atacama. BHP controla el yacimiento, que tiene como socios a Rio Tinto (RIO.L) y la japonesa JECO.

item.title: StoneX reduz previsão de safra de cana 26/27 do centro-sul e vê recorde para 27/28
item.description: O centro-sul do Brasil, região que responde por mais de 90% da cana-de-açúcar processada no país, deverá ter uma moagem menor do que a esperada em 2026/27 devido a chuvas que impactam as operações, mas que por outro lado vão aumentar os volumes disponíveis e a produtividade no próximo ciclo (2027/28), que veria uma safra recorde, estimou nesta quarta-feira a consultoria e corretora StoneX.
item.dc:creator: Roberto Samora, Isabel Teles
item.content:encoded: O centro-sul do Brasil, região que responde por mais de 90% da cana-de-açúcar processada no país, deverá ter uma moagem menor do que a esperada em 2026/27 devido a chuvas que impactam as operações, mas que por outro lado vão aumentar os volumes disponíveis e a produtividade no próximo ciclo (2027/28), que veria uma safra recorde, estimou nesta quarta-feira a consultoria e corretora StoneX. Uma visão de preço de açúcar mais vantajoso do que o valor equivalente do etanol terá impacto no "mix" de produção das usinas em 2027/28 (abril/março), levando o setor a destinar mais matéria-prima para a fabricação do adoçante no período, destacou a StoneX, em sua primeira estimativa para o novo ciclo. Enquanto isso, a expansão da indústria de etanol de milho garante uma produção recorde para o biocombustível, segundo a consultoria. Todo o cenário ainda deve garantir maior oferta de açúcar para o Brasil, maior produtor e exportador global da commodity. De acordo com a StoneX, o tempo chuvoso no inverno do centro-sul, associado ao fenômeno climático El Niño, prejudica o montante total a ser colhido de cana em 2026/27, cujo volume foi revisado de 640,1 milhões para 635,3 milhões de toneladas --ainda um crescimento de 3,9% sobre 2025/26. Mas possibilita um "início firme" da temporada 2027/28, ajudando a elevar as toneladas de cana por hectare (TCH) e o próprio volume de cana. Assim, a companhia projeta uma moagem total de 662,1 milhões de toneladas para o novo ciclo. "A grosso modo, o ciclo 27/28 será marcado pelo alto volume de chuvas e seus benefícios ao rendimento agrícola, e pela perspectiva de crescimento do mix açucareiro e, consequentemente, da oferta de açúcar, que pode subir 2,4 milhões de toneladas em 27/28 e se aproximar do recorde de 23/24", disse a StoneX. Em relatório escrito por Marcelo Di Bonifacio Filho e Letícia Corrêa, a consultoria disse que, com os dias perdidos de colheita até o momento em 2026/27, e considerando uma entressafra chuvosa, a área colhida deverá cair neste ano 3,1%, para 7,96 milhões de hectares. A safra de cana só não cai ante o ano anterior pelo ganho de produtividade, estimada em 79,8 toneladas por hectare em 2026/27, versus 74,4 em 2025/26. Já a estimativa de produção de açúcar 2027/28 ficou em 42,4 milhões de toneladas, aumento de 11,6% ante 2026/27, que teve um cenário de preços mais favorável à fabricação de etanol em parte do período, segundo a consultoria. "Mesmo considerando estoques finais (de açúcar) em 27/28 subindo 8%, com um consumo interno de 8,43 milhões de toneladas, as exportações têm potencial para atingir 33,8 milhões de toneladas via centro-sul no calendário abril-março, aumentando de forma robusta a oferta para o 'trade flow' global no segundo semestre de 2027", disseram os analistas. O contexto atual dos preços de açúcar e etanol justifica aumento do "mix" açucareiro para 49,3% em 2027/28, alta de 3,1 pontos percentuais ante 2026/27. A produção de açúcar em 2027/28 cresce também com o maior volume de matéria-prima disponível, com a produtividade agrícola superando 80 toneladas por hectare. "A decisão de 'mix' das usinas em 27/28 será impactada pela dinâmica atual de preços do açúcar", disseram os analistas. Eles lembraram que já em julho, o açúcar passou a ficar mais vantajoso que o etanol no Estado de São Paulo, principalmente por conta das quedas observadas nos preços do biocombustível após a entrada da safra 26/27. "Posteriormente, já em agosto, o rally de preços do Nova York passou a estimular não somente o mix açucareiro na temporada corrente, mas também para os contratos de 2027." PRODUÇÃO DE ETANOL AINDA CRESCE, COM O MILHO Com o setor favorecendo o açúcar, o "mix" de cana para etanol cairá para 50,7% em 2027/28. Ainda assim, a produção de etanol total (de cana e milho) deverá crescer 7,2% em 2027/28 ante o ciclo anterior para 40,5 bilhões de litros, com a oferta do biocombustível de milho compensando a queda esperada de 1,5% no volume do combustível de cana. A produção de etanol de milho deverá saltar 29,7% em 2027/28, para 13,6 bilhões de litros. "A safra 2027/28 será marcada por renovação do recorde da produção de etanol no centro-sul, puxado, claro, pela expansão acelerada do etanol de milho", disse a StoneX, citando que entre outubro de 2026 e março de 2028 serão oito novas unidades entrando em operação e outras cinco com programação de expansão de capacidade. A capacidade de produção de etanol de milho deve começar abril de 2027 com 38,9 mil m³/dia e finalizar março de 2028 com 51,2 mil m³/dia, acrescentou.

item.title: US CDC confirms first measles-related death of 2026, does not disclose state
item.description: The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention reported that there was one US measles-related death on its website on Wednesday, weeks after Pennsylvania health officials reported the first two of four measles-associated deaths in its state.
item.dc:creator: Siddhi Mahatole
item.content:encoded: The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention reported that there was one US measles-related death on its website on Wednesday, weeks after Pennsylvania health officials reported the first two of four measles-associated deaths in its state. The CDC had not confirmed those deaths and raised questions about whether they were due to measles. The US has had 3,471 measles cases this year as of September 17, according to the agency. The US Department of Health and Human Services spokesperson declined to confirm where the death had occurred. The US health agency said it had received a report from a state in which measles was listed as the underlying cause of death and that its National Center for Health Statistics had verified the death. A Bloomberg News report said the death reported by the CDC on Wednesday was one of the Pennsylvania deaths. "A standardized definition (of measles-related death) is very important, so that the cases can be counted objectively. If different agencies count deaths differently, it is very confusing and leads to a lack of transparency and trust," said Kawsar Talaat, associate professor at Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health. Pennsylvania, the hardest hit from the outbreak, has reported [USN:L4N4571A0 TEXT:"four measles-associated deaths"] so far this year, and had 835 cases as of September 23. The state's health department did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. The deaths have become the focus of a public dispute between Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro and US Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., who has said only one of the deaths resulted from measles. The agency said last week it was working with the Council of State and Territorial Epidemiologists to develop a standardized case definition for measles deaths, as the outbreak grows across the country. This work is intended to promote consistent classification and reporting of measles deaths across jurisdictions, HHS said. The agency shifted to using mortality data from the National Center for Health Statistics for its national measles death count, moving away from its reliance on state health departments — a change that has drawn scrutiny.

item.title: モルガンSの投資銀案件リスト流出、従業員が誤送信－SNSにも画像
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米モルガン･スタンレーがアジアで獲得を目指している、または動向を追っている100件余りの投資銀行案件を記載した内部文書を同行の従業員が誤って流出させた。事情に詳しい関係者が明らかにした。同行が手掛けようとしている案件の詳細が露呈した格好となった。

ブルームバーグ･ニュースが入手し、関係者らが内容を確認した資料によると、リストには中国や韓国、インドなどの新規株式公開（IPO）候補企業が挙げられていた。リストはアジア地域が中心だが、欧州や中東、アフリカにも及んでおり、こうした企業を支援するプライベートエクイティー（PE）投資会社や年金基金のほか、棚上げされた案件に関する情報も載っていた。

関係者によると、同行の従業員が今週、この案件リストを電子メールで送信し、その後メールの取り消しを試みた。さらに、ぼかしが入った同文書の画像がインスタグラムのアカウントに投稿されていた。

モルガン･スタンレーはブルームバーグ･ニュースへの声明で、顧客情報の機密保持を極めて重視しているとし、「今回の不注意による情報共有に対処するため速やかに措置を講じ、引き続き関係者と協議している」と述べた。

今回の情報流出は、香港での株式売り出しの引き受けやアジアの合併案件で長年にわたり上位に名を連ねてきたモルガン･スタンレーにとって痛恨の失態だ。投資銀部門では通常、見込み顧客の取引詳細は厳重に管理されている。

顧客や関係者がモルガン･スタンレーに連絡したかどうかや、同行がこの問題に具体的にどう対応しているかは明らかになっていない。

原題：Morgan Stanley Investment-Bank Deal List Leaked in Email Misfire

item.title: Conagra shareholders vote for proposed changes to executive pay
item.description: Conagra Brands shareholders voted on Wednesday in favour of proposed changes to the US packaged food maker's executive compensation program.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Conagra Brands (CAG.N) shareholders voted on Wednesday in favour of proposed changes to the US packaged food maker's executive compensation program. Proxy adviser ISS had urged shareholders to vote against the changes, citing concerns about declining financial performance and a lack of clarity around targets. Here are more details: The proposal was approved on an advisory basis at Conagra's AGM. CEO John Brase's compensation package includes a $1.15 million base salary, an annual incentive target opportunity equal to 150% of his eligible base salary and $7.3 million in annual long-term incentives, consisting of 60% performance shares and 40% restricted stock units(RSUs), [USN:L6N44Z0MX TEXT:"as Conagra had proposed"] in a proxy statement on August 11. Conagra, which makes Hunt's ketchup, Slim Jim meat sticks and Swiss Miss hot cocoa, halved its annual dividend in July and is reviewing its non-core assets under new CEO Brase after issuing a weak profit outlook. Conagra Brands is expected to report its first-quarter results on September 30.

Zelenskyy says Ukraine ready for maritime truce and puts onus on Russia to respond

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine is ready for a ceasefire in the Black Sea and is waiting for Russia’s response.

UNITED NATIONS: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy told leaders at the United Nations on Wednesday (Sep 23) that Ukraine was ready for a maritime truce in the Black Sea based on proposals by Egypt, India and Türkiye and said it was now up to Russia to respond . Zelenskyy spoke at Ukraine 's Crimean Platform summit on the sidelines of the annual UN General Assembly gathering of world leaders and ahead of a Security Council meeting on Russia 's war in Ukraine , which is now in its fifth year. Ukraine , which fears that Russia plans to pound power and heating facilities with missiles and drones this winter, has been pressing for ceasefires covering attacks on energy infrastructure and shipping in the Black Sea. Zelenskyy said Egypt, India and Türkiye had outlined options to restore safe navigation for merchant shipping in the Black Sea, where cargo movements are at a near st and still due to heavy attacks on ships and port infrastructure by both sides.

"We are waiting for Russia 's response. Ukraine is ready ... to ensure safe shipping and food security in the Black Sea if Russia is ready to take real steps towards de-escalation too. We have to start somewhere," he said. Top wheat importers in Asia, the Middle East and Africa that count on the Black Sea region for wheat have been finding it hard to secure supplies. Global wheat prices have soared. Zelenskyy , who was expected to address the UN General Assembly later on Wednesday, met US President Donald Trump on Tuesday and said they had also discussed a Russia - Ukraine ceasefire on energy-related targets.

US Secretary of State Marco Rubio told reporters after meeting Russia n Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov on Wednesday that both Russia and Ukraine had expressed interest in a limited ceasefire involving grain and energy. The Kremlin has not publicly backed the proposals. Ahead of the Lavrov-Rubio meeting, the Kremlin said there were no grounds for wider Ukraine peace talks, while saying it remained open to such talks. "For now, there are no prerequisites for moving on to a peaceful negotiating track, although we, as the Russia n side, remain open to peace talks," Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov told reporters. Zelenskyy said on Tuesday that he would be ready to meet Russia n President Vladimir Putin at a trilateral meeting with Trump.

ROME, Sept 23 : Napoli President Aurelio De Laurentiis has a gift for turning football politics into cinema, and FIFA President Gianni Infantino found himself cast as both villain and hero in the Italian film producer's latest monologue on the state of the game. Speaking after receiving a lifetime achievement award from Italy's Foreign Press Association on Wednesday, De Laurentiis stopped short of directly attacking Infantino, who has faced calls to resign after exploring a plan under which private investors would have bought shares in the World Cup and other competitions. Instead, the Napoli owner offered a barbed assessment of the FIFA chief's rise and global profile before admitting he had been impressed by the staging of this year's World Cup. "Infantino is someone who does his job from his point of view," De Laurentiis said during the ceremony in Rome.

"If a once secretary is then allowed, once he becomes president, to do certain things and travel around the world wearing the FIFA badge, meeting Trump, meeting Putin, meeting everyone, what are we supposed to say to him? We have to say: he is doing his job from his perspective. "This year, when I went to watch the World Cup matches, you saw these stadiums organised in an extraordinary way… I wanted to shoot Infantino; but when I saw how he had organised everything, I said: 'No, I hold my hands up, I have to say well done.'" EUROPE FOOTBALL'S POWER STRUCTURES De Laurentiis, whose Napoli have won two Serie A titles and five domestic cups since he rescued the club from bankruptcy more than two decades ago, was less charitable about European football's power structures. "Sport is not in crisis in the United States, which is still that shining beacon; it is in crisis in Europe," he said. "What is the Europa League for? What is the Conference League for? To collect votes for those who then have to be re-elected within all those organisations which, as it happens, are beyond any legislative oversight, because they do whatever they want and, if you raise your head even slightly, they immediately want to cut it off. "Look at what is happening at FIFA, look at what happened at UEFA in the past. There's a series from a few years ago, which tells the story of all FIFA's problems..." De Laurentiis repeated his desire for Napoli to have a family-friendly stadium and said hard-core ultras had no place in that vision. "I am against ultras, football must be about passion and educating children. You can’t have hooligans … or ‘ultras’ that are moulded from the Mafia, ’ndrangheta and Camorra,” De Laurentiis said, listing three of Italy’s organized crime syndicates. “Until our police chiefs and government ministers get the situation under control it’s a major problem.”

Source: Reuters

item.title: Brasil tem fluxo cambial negativo de US$7,078 bilhões em setembro até dia 18, diz BC
item.description: O Brasil registrou fluxo cambial total negativo de US$7,078 bilhões em setembro até o dia 18, conforme dados divulgados nesta quarta-feira pelo Banco Central.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O Brasil registrou fluxo cambial total negativo de US$7,078 bilhões em setembro até o dia 18, conforme dados divulgados nesta quarta-feira pelo Banco Central. Pelo canal financeiro, houve saídas líquidas de US$6,839 bilhões em setembro até o dia 18. Por este canal são realizados os investimentos estrangeiros diretos e em carteira, as remessas de lucro e o pagamento de juros, entre outras operações. Pelo canal comercial, que contabiliza exportações e importações, o saldo de setembro até o dia 18 foi negativo em US$240 milhões. Os dados mais recentes do BC são preliminares e fazem parte das estatísticas referentes ao câmbio contratado. SEMANA Na semana passada, de 14 a 18 de setembro, saíram líquidos do país US$1,091 bilhão. No acumulado do ano até 18 de setembro, o Brasil registra fluxo cambial total positivo de US$8,714 bilhões.

item.title: 米5年債利回り急上昇、2007年以来の5%台－指標堅調で利上げ継続観測
item.description:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米5年債利回りが約20年ぶりに5%を上回った。堅調な米経済指標を受け、インフレ圧力を抑えるため米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）が利上げを継続するとの見方が強まった。
5年債利回りは23日に一時、前日比で20ベーシスポイント（bp、1bp＝0.01%）上昇して5.03%を付けた。FRBの利上げ局面がピークを迎えた2023年に4.99%を付けていたが、今回それを上回った。
S&Pグローバルがこの日発表した米製造業・サービス業活動を測る指標（速報値）が、市場予想の中央値を上回った。また、同日午後に実施された5年債入札は、最高落札利回りが06年以来の高水準となった。
原題：US Treasury Five-Year Yields Breach 5% for First Time Since

item.title: MPS investors can back defence plan and still accept Intesa's offer, CEO says
item.description: Monte dei Paschi Chief Executive Luigi Lovaglio urged investors in the Italian bank to back his defence strategy against a takeover bid by Intesa Sanpaolo even if they intend to tender their shares under the offer.
item.dc:creator: Valentina Za
item.content:encoded: Monte dei Paschi (BMPS.MI) Chief Executive Luigi Lovaglio urged investors in the Italian bank to back his defence strategy against a takeover bid by Intesa Sanpaolo (ISP.MI) even if they intend to tender their shares under the offer. Addressing a Bank of America investor conference in London, Lovaglio said an October 29 vote on the defence plan should not be seen as a choice between Intesa's bid and the alternative deal MPS is proposing. "It's not a moment where you decide about one deal or the other," Lovaglio said. Under Italian rules, the management of a company targeted by a bid needs shareholder approval to proceed with any moves that could thwart the takeover. To fend off the €36 billion cash-and-share offer, MPS is proposing buying rival mid-sized commercial bank Banco BPM (BAMI.MI) as well as wealth manager Banca Generali (BGN.MI) in two all-share deals worth in aggregate €38 billion. Lovaglio said that backing the defence strategy would give MPS's management the chance to better define and explain the plan to shareholders. The market's response to the defence plan has been poor. However, Lovaglio said that by having an alternative on the table, shareholders stood a better chance of extracting a higher price from Intesa. Intesa, whose offer includes €4 billion in cash on top of the share component, has ruled out raising the price. Shareholder approval for Lovaglio's plan would complicate matters for Intesa, whose buyout offer is due to start only in November after clearing regulatory hurdles. Intesa is counting on concluding its bid before the two MPS bids go live. Given the binding nature of such bids once launched, Intesa needs to get control of MPS before the tender period for the two MPS offers starts.

item.title: 米国、ディーゼル輸出を90日間禁止する計画を策定中－ポリティコ
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米ホワイトハウスは、ディーゼル燃料の輸出を90日間禁止する計画を策定している。政治ニュースサイトのポリティコが匿名の関係者の情報を基に報じた。

ポリティコによると、実際に禁止するための法的手続きはなお不透明だが、トランプ大統領は週末までに禁止措置を打ち出す意向だ。禁止措置が導入されれば、高騰する燃料費の抑制に向けたトランプ政権のこれまでで最も踏み込んだ措置となる。

イランとウクライナでの戦争を背景にディーゼル価格が過去最高水準に上昇する中、トランプ氏は今週、米国のディーゼル輸出禁止を支持するよう側近らに促したと述べていた。ただ、エネルギー業界関係者は、輸出規制による価格押し下げ効果は短期的なものにとどまり、その後は燃料費が一段と上昇するとして、規制の可能性に強く反対している。

全米自動車協会（AAA）によると、米国のディーゼル小売価格は過去最高値を更新し、1ガロン当たり6.50ドルを超えた。

原題：US Prepares Plan for 90-Day Diesel Export Ban, Politico Reports

item.title: Rendimiento de bonos del Tesoro a cinco años supera el 5% por primera vez en casi dos décadas
item.description: El rendimiento llegó al 5,03% después de que datos económicos sólidos reforzaran las expectativas de nuevas subidas de tasas de la Reserva Federal.
item.dc:creator: Greg Ritchie
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — La rentabilidad de los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense a cinco años superó el 5% por primera vez en casi dos décadas, ya que los sólidos datos económicos de Estados Unidos impulsaron a los inversores a prepararse para una serie de subidas de las tasas de interés de la Reserva Federal para frenar las presiones inflacionarias. La tasa de interés de los bonos de referencia subió 20 puntos básicos el miércoles, hasta el 5,03%. Esto supera el máximo del 4,99% alcanzado en 2023, en el punto álgido del ciclo de subida de tasas de la Reserva Federal para frenar la creciente inflación. Ver más: ¿Vuelve la cartera 60/40? Goldman Sachs analiza el peor ciclo de los bonos en un siglo Las expectativas de un mayor endurecimiento de la política monetaria aumentaron el miércoles después de que los indicadores preliminares de S&P Global sobre la actividad manufacturera y de servicios en Estados Unidos, publicados en septiembre, superaran las estimaciones promedio. Esto incrementó la presión en el mercado de bonos, y la venta de bonos a cinco años del Tesoro estadounidense el miércoles registró el mayor rendimiento en subasta desde 2006. La semana pasada, los funcionarios de la Reserva Federal votaron por unanimidad a favor de subir las tasas de interés en septiembre por primera vez desde 2023, situando la tasa de referencia de los fondos federales en un rango de entre el 3,75% y el 4%. El presidente Kevin Warsh afirmó que esta medida eliminó una “dosis de estímulo”. Los operadores apuestan por cuatro subidas más en los próximos 12 meses. Los responsables políticos están cada vez más preocupados por la inflación, que no ha alcanzado su objetivo del 2% en cinco años y medio, y algunos advierten de presiones inflacionarias que parecen persistir. Todo esto ocurre en un contexto de un mercado laboral estadounidense sólido. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: A pedido da AGU, CNJ ordena devolução de R$4,7 bi ao Tesouro em processos do setor sucroalcooleiro
item.description: O Conselho Nacional de Justiça (CNJ) decidiu que seja feita a devolução de R$4,7 bilhões à Conta Única do Tesouro Nacional, acrescidos dos respectivos rendimentos, com o cancelamento de 16 precatórios de processos do setor sucroalcooleiro, atendendo a um pedido da Advocacia Geral da União (AGU), que divulgou a determinação nesta quarta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O Conselho Nacional de Justiça (CNJ) decidiu que seja feita a devolução de R$4,7 bilhões à Conta Única do Tesouro Nacional, acrescidos dos respectivos rendimentos, com o cancelamento de 16 precatórios de processos do setor sucroalcooleiro, atendendo a um pedido da Advocacia Geral da União (AGU), que divulgou a determinação nesta quarta-feira. A decisão foi proferida pelo corregedor nacional de Justiça, ministro Benedito Gonçalves, em pedido de providências apresentado pela União contra o Tribunal Regional Federal da 1ª Região (TRF-1). O CNJ reconheceu a existência de risco de dano ao erário e determinou o imediato cumprimento da medida, segundo o comunicado. "Os valores, que somam R$4.738.065.026,73, estavam depositados em contas judiciais desde dezembro de 2023, vinculados a precatórios expedidos antes do trânsito em julgado da fase processual de execução. Segundo o CNJ, essa modalidade de 'precatório bloqueado' não possui amparo legal e contraria decisão anterior do próprio Conselho", disse a AGU, em nota da assessoria de comunicação. A decisão cautelar do CNJ suspendeu decisões da presidência do TRF-1 que impediam o cancelamento das ordens formais de pagamento e restabeleceu determinações da 6ª Vara Federal Cível do Distrito Federal para devolução dos recursos. O tribunal terá cinco dias para cancelar os precatórios e restituir os valores, com seus rendimentos, ao Tesouro Nacional. "A medida representa um passo relevante para o restabelecimento das contas públicas, ao permitir que recursos bilionários, mantidos fora da Conta Única e da programação financeira da União desde 2023, retornem ao Tesouro e possam ser novamente incorporados à gestão financeira do Estado. O próprio CNJ destacou que a manutenção dessa situação representava risco de lesão ao erário", disse a AGU. Procurada, a assessoria de comunicação do TRF-1 não respondeu de imediato a pedido de comentário.

item.title: トランプ氏、ベネズエラ暫定大統領と債務再編を協議＝米国務長官
item.description: [ニューヨーク ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ニューヨーク　２３日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領はベネズエラのロドリゲス暫定大統領と２２日に行った会談で、ベネズエラが抱える巨額の政府債務の再編について協議した。ルビオ米国務長官が２３日、明らかにした。

ロドリゲス氏は、米軍が今年１月に急襲作戦で当時のマドゥロ大統領を拘束して以降、初めて訪米。トランプ氏との会談は２２日夜、国連総会に合わせてトランプ氏がニューヨークで主催したレセプションの席上で行われた。

ルビオ氏は記者団に対し、トランプ氏とロドリゲス氏の会談は「短時間だったが重要な会談だった」と述べた。

その上で「ベネズエラが成功するには多くの問題を解決しなければならない。債務再編がその鍵になる」と指摘。ベネズエラはおそらく世界最大規模の再編が必要な政府債務を抱えているとし、米国が支援する意向を示すと同時に、「適切な方法で進めなければならない」と述べた。

ベネズエラ政府と国営石油会社ベネズエラ石油（ＰＤＶＳＡ）は、現在デフォルト（債務不履行）状態にある約６００億ドルの債券を抱えている。アナリストは、未払いの利息や仲裁裁定による支払い義務などを含めると、債務総額は１５００億ドルを超える可能性があると試算している。

item.title: Huracán Polo desciende a categoría 4 mientras bordea las costas del Pacífico de México
item.description: Se prevé que el huracán se desvíe bruscamente de tierra firme, pero que permanezca lo suficientemente cerca de la costa con riesgo de inundaciones en Guerrero y Michoacán.
item.dc:creator: Brian K. Sullivan
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — El huracán Polo se debilitó durante la noche mientras seguía rozando la costa del Pacífico de México, que se espera que evite un impacto directo. Los vientos de Polo descendieron a 150 millas (241 kilómetros) por hora desde las 180 mph registradas el martes, lo que lo convierte en una tormenta de categoría 4 en la escala de Saffir-Simpson, que consta de cinco niveles, según informó el Centro Nacional de Huracanes de EE.UU. El huracán se encontraba a unas 320 millas (515 kilómetros) al sureste del importante puerto de carga de Manzanillo, aproximadamente a las 6 de la mañana, hora de la Ciudad de México. Se prevé que el huracán se desvíe bruscamente de tierra firme, pero que permanezca lo suficientemente cerca de la costa como para que los vientos con fuerza de tormenta tropical y las fuertes lluvias aumenten el riesgo de inundaciones en los estados mexicanos de Guerrero y Michoacán hasta el jueves, según escribió Jack Beven, especialista sénior en huracanes del centro estadounidense, en un informe de previsiones. “Según la trayectoria prevista, se espera que el núcleo de Polo se encuentre cerca de la costa del suroeste de México durante el próximo día o los dos próximos días, aunque se prevé que permanezca en alta mar”, afirmó Beven. En su momento de mayor intensidad, los vientos de Polo alcanzaron las 180 mph, lo que lo sitúa a la par de los supertifones Bavi y Sinlaku como las tormentas más fuertes del Pacífico de este año, según Phil Klotzbach, investigador de huracanes de la Universidad Estatal de Colorado. El Niño y una zona anómalamente cálida del Pacífico cerca de México y California han contribuido a avivar las tormentas en todo el océano desde la pasada primavera. La activa temporada del Pacífico también ha traído tormentas mortales más al oeste. El tifón Dujuan dejó al menos nueve muertos y cuatro desaparecidos cerca de Tokio. La presidenta mexicana, Claudia Sheinbaum, instó a los residentes de la costa a permanecer alerta por si la tormenta cambia de rumbo. El Centro de Huracanes de EE.UU. indicó que Polo podría trazar una trayectoria en forma de arco a través del Pacífico oriental y acercarse a la costa de Baja California (México) mientras aún mantiene la intensidad de un huracán a principios de la próxima semana. --Con la colaboración de Gonzalo Soto, Alice French y Hideki Suzuki.

item.title: イラン大統領「降伏せず」、外交重視 国連演説中に米代表団退席
item.description: ［国連 ２３日 ロイター］ - イランのペゼシュキアン大統領は２３日、国連本部で開かれている国連総会の一般討論演説で、トランプ米大統領の姿勢を「弱い者いじめの姿勢」だと批判し、米国との戦争でイランが降伏することはないと述べた。
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［国連　２３日　ロイター］ - イランのペゼシュキアン大統領は２３日、国連本部で開かれている国連総会の一般討論演説で、トランプ米大統領の姿勢を「弱い者いじめの姿勢」だと批判し、米国との戦争でイランが降伏することはないと述べた。 同時に、戦争終結に向けて外交を重視する姿勢も強調した。

ペゼシュキアン氏は、脅しはイランの決意を一層固めさせるだけだと主張し、合意に至らなければイランを壊滅させ得るとするトランプ氏の警告を一蹴。「米大統領の昨日の発言は弱い者いじめの姿勢の表れだ。イラン国民が圧力に屈することはない。テロリストであり、テロリストを訓練している者たちが、われわれをテロリスト呼ばわりしている」と反論した。

ペゼシュキアン氏は演説の中で幾度も、イランは交渉を通じて米国との緊張を解決する用意があると述べつつ、イラン政府は力による威圧を受け入れないと警告した。

また、米国はいかなる国際法も尊重していないと非難。イランは米国や敵対勢力に対抗するため、強く力強い国家でなければならないと述べた。

ペゼシュキアン氏の演説が始まると、米国の代表団は退席した。国連の米政府代表部はコメントの要請に直ちには応じなかった。

演説の冒頭でペゼシュキアン氏は、戦争中に米国が民間人を殺害したと非難し、教室にいる女子生徒を写した写真などを掲げた。

イラン当局によると、２月２８日のイラン攻撃初日、南部ミナブにある学校が攻撃され、児童や教員１７５人以上が死亡した。

米国防総省は、ミナブへの攻撃に関する調査結果を公表していない。この攻撃は、米軍が関与した民間人被害としては数十年で最悪の事案となった。ロイターは３月５日、米軍による初期の内部調査で、この攻撃は米軍によるものである可能性が高いとの結論が出たと報じた。

ペゼシュキアン氏は、イランに核爆弾を追求する意図はないが、平和的な核開発の権利を放棄することはないと言明。「核兵器も持たなければ、核の知見を手放すこともない」と述べた。

世界の石油と液化天然ガス（ＬＮＧ）の５分の１が通過するホルムズ海峡は、イランと米国の緊張の焦点となっている。

ペゼシュキアン氏は「誰もがホルムズ海峡から恩恵を受ける一方で、われわれだけがこの水路を通じた海運へのアクセスを拒まれるようなことはあってはならない。敵対的な艦隊の恒久的な展開や戦争の拡大が、平和につながることはない」と述べた。

item.title: As 5% Treasury yields lose shock value, investors start worrying about 6%
item.description: For years, 5% on the benchmark US 10-year Treasury yield was viewed as the point at which global financial markets would start hitting turbulence. That threshold is beginning to look less like a ceiling and more like a waypoint.
item.dc:creator: Marc Jones, Naomi Rovnick
item.content:encoded: For years, 5% on the benchmark US 10-year Treasury yield was viewed as the point at which global financial markets would start hitting turbulence. That threshold is beginning to look less like a ceiling and more like a waypoint. This month's breach of 5% - something that has happened only briefly in recent decades - has forced investors to contemplate an unsettling question: What if 6% is the new number that should be keeping them awake at night? The latest move above 5% has not lasted long enough yet to properly test that theory. But it has always been a psychological marker rather than an automatic tripwire, according to BlueBay Asset Management's head of market strategy, Mike Bell. "People think of it as if there's a magic number for Treasury yields at which it becomes a problem, (but) it's a relative number, not an absolute number," Bell explained. What matters is how Treasury yields compare with other key investment metrics, particularly the earnings yield on stocks. Bell says that relationship is now approaching an inflection point, potentially setting the stage for an equity selloff. History offers some guidance. MSCI's main world stocks index (.MIWD00000PUS) halved in value the last time the 10-year Treasury yield broke 5%, which was just before the global financial crash. It suffered a similar slump less than a decade earlier when a near 6.8% spike helped pop the dotcom bubble. JP Morgan's analysts say one of the reasons why the pain-point might now be above 5% again is a "key structural shift" in the global economy, with AI, healthcare and services playing a bigger role. Many of those firms are spending and expanding, regardless of the level of borrowing costs. That means "the traditional interest-rate channel looks materially less binding" and the "breaking threshold" of stock markets may be "meaningfully higher, potentially in the 5.5%-6.0% range", JP Morgan said, referencing the views of some of the major investors at one of its most recent conferences. PROFOUND REPRICING In the $29-trillion Treasury market, which anchors pricing for virtually all financial assets, a shift from 5% to 6% would represent a profound adjustment in the global cost of capital. A 6% Treasury yield would imply either significantly higher inflation expectations, growing concerns about US fiscal sustainability, a conviction that interest rates will remain elevated for years - or a mix of all three. Federal Reserve policymaker Austan Goolsbee said this week that he didn't know whether markets would react differently to a lengthier period of 5% yields than they had in the past. Paul Jackson, Invesco global head of asset allocation research, said investors focus on Treasury yields for a simple reason: Treasuries represent the world's risk-free benchmark and at above 5%, investors can lock in the highest returns on US bonds since 2007. Jackson's own calculations show world stocks start to drop when the 10-year yield has traded at an average of 4.72% for 12 months and then rises. That tipping point remains some way off for now - the 12-month average is currently around 4.34% - but Jackson said he was already dialling back on stocks and switching some money into government bonds to cash in on the juicy yields. "If Treasury yields keep rising then there is a risk that the stock market is lower in 12 months' time," he said. EMERGING QUESTIONS Emerging markets, which have enjoyed something of a hot streak in recent years, are often among the first casualties when US yields surge. Higher Treasury returns tend to strengthen the dollar and make dollar-denominated assets more attractive. That sucks capital away from EM economies and can tip hard-up countries into crisis if the cost of servicing their dollar-denominated debt spirals. Data on investment flows shows last week saw the biggest exodus from EM bond funds in months, with billions also withdrawn from equity funds. Issuance of emerging-market sovereign debt has also been notably lighter than usual this month. "It's not an optimal picture for EM," said Alison Shimada, Head of Total Emerging Markets Equity, Allspring Global Investments, although she stressed that for now nothing was going "horribly wrong" and therefore remained "constructive". Perhaps the biggest risk is psychological. Once investors start asking whether 6% is attainable, the debate shifts beyond a temporary spike in yields. It becomes a broader reckoning with the possibility that the era of abundant liquidity and ultra-cheap money has ended, forcing global asset prices to adapt to a permanently higher cost of capital. Premier Miton CIO Neil Birrell said while stock markets were showing no sign of collapsing right now, that might be because investors weren't yet plugging in 5%-plus yields into their longer-term profit forecasting models. "The markets look fine until everyone re-runs their valuation models," Birrell said. "Ultimately, the numbers are the numbers and they've got to come through."

item.title: 米、対中「貿易休戦」延長や大型合意追求に前向き＝財務長官
item.description:
Andrea Shalal
[ワシントン ２３日 ロイター] - ベセント米財務長官は２３日、米中首脳会談を２４日に控える中、中国の何立峰副首相と会談した。会談後、１１月１０日に期限を迎える米中間の「貿易休戦」の延長、あるいはより包括的な貿易協定の追求に前向きな姿勢を示した。
ベセント長官と何氏の会談は２０日に続き、今週２回目。
長官は記者団に対し、２０日の協議で「中国側がより大規模な合意案を提示してきた」と説明。２０２５年の韓国・釜山での米中首脳会談に言及し、「われわれは釜山合意の継続にも、より大きな合意の検討にもオープンだ」と語った。
この日の会談に先立ち、首脳会談に向けて「未解決の問題」
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Andrea Shalal

[ワシントン ２３日 ロイター] - ベセント米財務長官は２３日、米中首脳会談を２４日に控える中、中国の何立峰副首相と会談した。会談後、１１月１０日に期限を迎える米中間の「貿易休戦」の延長、あるいはより包括的な貿易協定の追求に前向きな姿勢を示した。

ベセント長官と何氏の会談は２０日に続き、今週２回目。

長官は記者団に対し、２０日の協議で「中国側がより大規模な合意案を提示してきた」と説明。２０２５年の韓国・釜山での米中首脳会談に言及し、「われわれは釜山合意の継続にも、より大きな合意の検討にもオープンだ」と語った。

この日の会談に先立ち、首脳会談に向けて「未解決の問題」 の整理が目的だと説明。「われわれは戦略的安定を望んでいるが、それは互恵性と公平性に基づく必要がある」と述べていた。

ベセント長官はその後、Ｘへの投稿で、何氏との協議を実質的なものだったと評した。さらに、財務省が「米国の経済的・国家安全保障上の利益を推進しつつ、米労働者、農家、企業を守る有意義なコミットメント」の確保に注力していると述べた。

情報筋もこの日の協議を「生産的かつ建設的だった」とし、「双方は引き続き積極的に関与し、一連の重要な課題を巡る協議は進展している」と述べた。

トランプ大統領と習近平国家主席は２４日に今年２回目の首脳会談を行う予定。前回会談は５月に北京で開かれた。

年後半に中国・深セン で開催されるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議や、米マイアミで開かれる２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）首脳会議に合わせて両首脳が再び会談する可能性もあり、ベセント長官は「今年は両首脳が最大４回会談する歴史的な年になる可能性がある」と述べた。

item.title: Meta's Muse rekindles fears over winners and losers as personal AI agent emerges
item.description: Meta's Muse , the first major consumer product to emerge under Alexandr Wang since he was hired to head its AI efforts last year, has split the fortunes of US stocks this week.
item.dc:creator: Johann Cherian, Akash Sriram
item.content:encoded: Meta's Muse (META.O) , the first major [USN:L6N4500XV TEXT:"consumer product"] to emerge under Alexandr Wang since he was hired to head its AI efforts last year, has split the fortunes of US stocks this week. Muse, which allows users to delegate tasks such as shopping, travel booking and form-filling to an AI agent, overtook ChatGPT as the top free app on Apple's App Store and Google Play Store in the US and Canada. The app recorded 2.8 million downloads within two weeks of its launch, posting an average daily download growth of 55% in the first 10 days, according to market intelligence company Sensor Tower. Investors worried that Meta's scale could turn Muse into a powerful comparison-shopping tool, enabling consumers to more easily find lower-cost alternatives and weakening the loyalty that often keeps users with incumbent providers. The development dragged on several sectors this week, while Meta and AI-infrastructure related companies rallied. "Meta has really found lightning in a bottle here and someone who partners with Muse is likely to be a clear beneficiary off the bat to me. As far as net losers, it's just going to take more time to find out," said Michael O'Rourke, chief market strategist at JonesTrading. JITTERS ACROSS SECTORS Financials stocks were the hardest-hit in the previous session and remained under pressure on Wednesday on fears that the AI agent could prompt users to switch to policies with cheaper prices. Big banks such as JPMorgan (JPM.N) and Wells Fargo (WFC.N) lost more than 3% each so far this week, while brokerage Charles Schwab (SCHW.N) was down nearly 5%. Insurers such as Marsh (MRSH.N) and Arthur J. Gallagher (AJG.N) were down 2.4% and 4.6%, respectively. Art Hogan, chief market strategist for B. Riley Wealth, however, said those disruption concerns were far-fetched. "If you're going to trust the management of your finances to something that Muse found for you, then you were likely not a big payer to anyone in that industry to begin with. There's a whole lot more that goes in asset management than who's got the cheapest price," he said. Booking companies such as TripAdvisor (TRIP.O) and Booking Holdings (BKNG.O) , which rely on subscription models, have lost over 6% this week. Planet Fitness (PLNT.N) has tanked 17%, while the New York Times (NYT.N) is down 10%. Other decliners included ride-hailing companies such as Uber (UBER.N) and Lyft (LYFT.O) , and online food marketplace DoorDash (DASH.O) . THE BIGGEST WINNERS Meta's shares have soared nearly 13% this week and are set for their fifth-straight week of advances. The gains were fueled by expectations that the mainstream consumer-focused app could generate additional annual revenue, with Truist Securities estimating it to touch at least $28.5 billion by fiscal 2030. US-listed shares of Canada's Shopify have jumped 11.4% this week, after it said it would use Muse to [USN:L6N45D12F TEXT:"process checkouts"]. Payments platform PayPal (PYPL.O) has marginally gained after saying it would allow users to discover products and complete purchases through the AI agent. Privately held companies, including Stripe and Ticketmaster, also struck similar deals with Meta. MORE AI INFRASTRUCTURE DEMAND Apps such as Muse could drive AI compute demand, accelerating AI infrastructure buildout and benefiting chip stocks. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index (.SOX) has gained 7% since Muse's launch and is set for its biggest two-week run since mid-August, with Nvidia (NVDA.O) and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD.O) among top gainers.

item.title: Harvey Weinstein es condenado a 15 años de prisión por agresión sexual en Nueva York
item.description: La sentencia deriva de la condena de 2025 por agredir sexualmente a Miriam Haley, después de que una condena anterior de Weinstein fuera anulada.
item.dc:creator: Mike Vilensky
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Harvey Weinstein fue condenado a 15 años de prisión por agresión sexual, lo que supone el último revés judicial para el magnate del cine convertido en símbolo del movimiento #MeToo tras casi una década de procesos judiciales. La sentencia, dictada este miércoles, se deriva de una condena dictada el año pasado en un tribunal penal del estado de Nueva York. Un jurado declaró al cofundador de Miramax culpable de obligar a la antigua asistente de producción de Project Runway, Miriam Haley, a mantener relaciones sexuales orales. El fiscal del distrito de Manhattan, Alvin Bragg, había solicitado 20 años. Weinstein había solicitado 9 años. Aunque Weinstein ha indicado que recurrirá la última condena y sentencia, esta supone, por el momento, el final de una larga batalla judicial liderada por la Fiscalía del Distrito de Manhattan para encarcelar a Weinstein, después de que una avalancha de acusaciones en su contra desencadenara un debate nacional sobre el abuso de las mujeres en el ámbito laboral. Ver más: Harvey Weinstein es declarado culpable de agresión sexual en Nueva York por segunda vez Lleva en prisión desde 2020, la mayor parte del tiempo en Rikers Island, en medio de procedimientos judiciales tanto en Nueva York como en California, donde también ha sido condenado por delitos sexuales. En unas declaraciones realizadas antes de que se dictara la sentencia, Weinstein le dijo al juez: “No soy una persona perfecta” y “pido sinceras disculpas a cualquiera a quien haya podido hacer daño con mis actos”, afirmando que siente “remordimiento por el dolor de Miriam Haley”. Sin embargo, añadió: “Debo reiterar mi inocencia”. Solicitó clemencia para poder pasar el resto de su vida con sus hijos y ayudar a otros reclusos. Haley también se dirigió al juez Curtis Farber y, con la voz quebrada, afirmó que haber sido agredida por Weinstein “me ha minado la autoestima”. Testificar en su contra ha sido “la peor decisión de mi vida”, añadió. “Me planteé retirarme tantas veces. Pero por cada persona que siente miedo, cansancio, intimidación o vergüenza, sabía que esas eran las razones por las que tenía que seguir adelante”. Weinstein, de 74 años, fue declarado inicialmente culpable en 2020 de agredir sexualmente a Haley y de violar a otra mujer, Jessica Mann, en un juicio celebrado en Nueva York que supuso un punto de inflexión para el movimiento #MeToo. Fue condenado a 23 años, pero el tribunal superior del estado de Nueva York anuló las condenas, alegando que el numeroso grupo de mujeres que testificaron sobre abusos no imputados privó a Weinstein de un juicio justo. Ver más: Harvey Weinstein apela su condena por violación ante el tribunal de Nueva York Weinstein fue declarado culpable de nuevo de agredir sexualmente a Haley en un nuevo juicio celebrado en 2025, que tuvo lugar en medio de un clima político cambiante y de un mayor escepticismo hacia el movimiento #MeToo. El jurado no logró alcanzar un veredicto por segunda vez respecto al cargo de haber violado a Mann. En otro nuevo juicio celebrado este año, el jurado volvió a no alcanzar un veredicto sobre el mismo cargo de violación. En junio, el fiscal del distrito de Manhattan, Alvin Bragg, archivó el caso de violación, por lo que Weinstein será condenado únicamente por agredir sexualmente a Haley. Weinstein también fue declarado culpable de violación y agresión sexual en California y condenado a 16 años de prisión por dichos delitos. Sin embargo, a principios de este año, un tribunal de apelación de California ordenó que se le volviera a dictar sentencia, alegando que el juez de primera instancia había tenido en cuenta un “factor agravante que ahora es inválido”. Ver más: Abdalá Bucaram fue condenado a más de nueve años de cárcel: qué dice el fallo y por qué Aún no se le ha vuelto a dictar sentencia en California, por lo que la pena de prisión de Nueva York es, actualmente, la única que le pesa. Su equipo de abogados ha declarado que solicitarán la revisión del caso de California ante el tribunal supremo de dicho estado. Weinstein, que en su día fue uno de los hombres más poderosos de la industria del entretenimiento, fue acusado por primera vez de delitos sexuales en 2018 en Nueva York, lo que llevó el movimiento #MeToo a los tribunales penales. Weinstein afirma que está luchando contra el cáncer y otras enfermedades. “Me parece una lenta marcha hacia mi muerte”, declaró Weinstein en una comparecencia ante el tribunal a principios de este año. “Mi estado mental se ha derrumbado. Vivo en una ansiedad constante”. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

Shorter races a good compromise, says F1 champion Norris

FAST

BAKU, Sept 23 : McLaren’s reigning world champion Lando Norris on Wednesday described Formula One’s move to shorten races next year as a good, short-term compromise that would improve the racing action. The governing FIA's Formula One commission on Monday agreed to reduce the standard Grand Prix distance from 305 km to 290 km from 2027, cutting races by two or three laps. The move is aimed at ensuring drivers make it to the end of races without running out of fuel, with the fuel flow rate set to increase next year. “It's a good compromise that we need to make to make our sport better and rely more on driving rather than who can look after our battery the best,” Briton Norris told reporters.

“I think in a few years' time when all engine manufacturers are on board with having more fuel again and having bigger tanks and all of that, then it's something we can go back to, the longer races and the races that we've always had in Formula One,” added the 26-year-old. The fuel flow rate permitted by the rules will increase by 5 per cent next season, as part of a rebalancing of the split between combustion engine and electric power to 58-42 from the current 53-47. It will increase again by 13 per cent in 2028, with the combustion engine-electric power split rising to 60-40. The move is aimed at allowing for more flat-out driving and less energy management after widespread complaints about the racing having become more artificial. Red Bull’s four-times champion Max Verstappen, a vocal critic of the sport’s current hybrid rules, said shortening the race distance would be worth it if it made the racing better. “I mean I would run 50 per cent less if it would give me a nicer engine to drive,” joked the Dutchman. “But, I don’t think it’s a big problem. If we have to shorten it a little bit for the fuel consumption but for overall a better racing experience then I think everyone will take it.”  Ferrari rival and seven-times world champion Lewis Hamilton, however, opposed the move. “This is supposed to be the sport which is the most physically and mentally demanding and there are some (races) that are so hot and you are on the edge,” said the 41-year-old. “But that is where you want to see athletes, right on the edge of performance…”

Source: Reuters

item.title: Microsoft plans $10 billion-plus Gulf investment with focus on resilience
item.description: Microsoft is planning to invest more than $10 billion across the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Kuwait between now and 2030, including in cloud and AI infrastructure, a senior executive said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Federico Maccioni
item.content:encoded: Microsoft (MSFT.O) is planning to invest more than $10 billion across the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Kuwait between now and 2030, including in cloud and AI infrastructure, a senior executive said on Wednesday. The US tech giant is making digital resilience a key part of its strategy for the region as the Iran war rumbles on . Microsoft's investment reflects both its "ongoing build-out of infrastructure and also the expansion of operations in the region," Vice Chair and President Brad Smith told Reuters. Gulf countries are pouring billions into AI as they strive to become global hubs to help diversify their economies away from oil and gas, betting that land abundance and access to cheap energy will lure hyperscalers, including Microsoft. However, challenges remain in areas including access to advanced chips and the uncertainty brought by the war, including [USN:L6N4570O0 TEXT:"attacks"] on data centres such as Amazon (AMZN.O) cloud unit AWS's facilities in Bahrain and the UAE. "We're sustaining all the investments we planned to make before this conflict started, and we're in fact adding to them ... It's an aggressive spending schedule," said Smith. He said Microsoft had supported local partners during the conflict, including with digital resilience assessments, even in the first week of the conflict, which began on February 28. DIGITAL RESILIENCE Microsoft is now working to help the Gulf countries in areas such as readiness and critical data protection as part of a digital resilience initiative. It could not provide a breakdown of the planned investment by country or specific project, Smith said, citing factors including security. While the UAE has been largely spared attacks since May, several other Gulf countries have continued to face threats. Microsoft also plans to invest more than $400 million in subsea and terrestrial connectivity across the Middle East by 2030. It is also strengthening its partnership with national AI companies, including Abu Dhabi's G42, in which Microsoft invested $1.5 billion for a minority stake in 2024, giving the US firm a board seat currently filled by Smith. Microsoft is working with Saudi Arabia's Humain and Qatar's Qai "in selected areas that are priorities for them," he said, noting that it does not plan capital investments in the firms.

item.title: 米シカゴ連銀総裁、原油ショックに警戒 持続的なインフレ要因の恐れ
item.description: [２３日 ロイター] - 米シカゴ地区連銀のグールズビー総裁は２３日、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は、現在のエネルギーシ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米シカゴ連銀総裁、原油ショックに警戒　持続的なインフレ要因の恐れ 1:29 配信

米シカゴ地区連銀のグールズビー総裁。カリフォルニア州ビバリーヒルズで５月撮影。REUTERS/Mike Blake

[２３日　ロイター] - 米シカゴ地区連銀のグールズビー総裁は２３日、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は、現在のエネルギーショックが自然と解消されると期待するのではなく、インフレを持続的に押し上げる要因として扱う必要があるとの認識を示した。

グールズビー氏は２３日公開のポッドキャスト番組「エコノミクス・アプライド」で、「大きな負の供給ショックについては、最初からインフレへの影響がかなり持続すると想定しておいたほうがいい」と指摘。コロナ禍や関税措置発動時にも同じことが起き、原油ショックについても同じことが起きている可能性があるため「われわれは注意すべきだ」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：米景気拡大維持、ＦＲＢの利下げペース次第 アングル：米長期金利5％接近で株式市場に警戒感、決算後はマクロ要因に注目 焦点：ベセント氏発言で強まる日銀9月利上げ観測、米国の影響力拡大に懸念も アングル：米国債「ツイスト・スティープ化」、ＦＲＢの信認巡る懸念反映か アングル：インフレで揺らぐ債券のヘッジ機能、米投資家は実物資産に移行 最終更新: 9/24(木) 1:29 ロイター

item.description: OEIRAS, Portugal, Sept 23 : Cristiano Ronaldo walked into a packed room, claimed to be nervous, then did what he has done for more than two decades: taking centre stage, swatting away critics and insisting the final whistle is not yet in sight.The 41-year-old Portugal captain, speaking on Wednesday at the Por

OEIRAS, Portugal, Sept 23 : Cristiano Ronaldo walked into a packed room, claimed to be nervous, then did what he has done for more than two decades: taking centre stage, swatting away critics and insisting the final whistle is not yet in sight. The 41-year-old Portugal captain, speaking on Wednesday at the Portugal Football Summit main stage before Thursday's UEFA Nations League match against Wales, said he still had plenty to offer his country as Jorge Jesus prepares for his first game as national team coach. Jesus replaced Roberto Martinez after Portugal's disappointing World Cup campaign ended in the round of 16 against eventual champions Spain. Ronaldo, now on 979 career goals — 833 for clubs and 146 for Portugal — is 21 short of the 1,000-goal landmark he has openly targeted. Asked whether winning the Nations League or reaching four figures mattered more, he grinned and chose both.
