"One goal is to achieve both – reaching 1,000 goals and the national team trying to win this Nations League," Ronaldo said at the Portugal Football Summit at the Portuguese FA headquarters outside Lisbon. "It's a new era with manager Jorge Jesus, whom we all know well; I just hope things go well for him." Ronaldo said reaching 1,000 in Portugal colours would be "the icing on the cake". "Scoring my 1,000th goal for the national team would be the culmination of something – a beautiful story," he said. "It wouldn't be the end of it, but it would be a beautiful story." Ronaldo insisted, however, that he was not consumed by the chase. "I've already admitted that I want to get there, and I will get there," he said. "An obsession? No ... The rest is about enjoying it, enjoying every day." PRODUCTIVE TALKS Ronaldo acknowledged he had considered his international future after Portugal's World Cup exit, but said talks with the Portuguese FA and Jesus convinced him to continue. "They count on me. I still believe that I'm able to help the national team," he said. "The most important point is to be able, inside the pitch, to score goals and help the team to win games. "If the manager doesn't count on me, I can leave today – no problem at all... When I feel that I'm not doing anything here, that I'm not contributing on the pitch, not scoring goals, creating a bad atmosphere, or that they don't want me here, I'll be the first to pack my bags." Pressed on retirement, Ronaldo refused to draw a clear line under his career. "I learnt something from my late 30s onwards, which is to live in the moment, don't think about tomorrow," he said. "Is it possible? Yes. Highly likely? Yes. But will it happen? No, I don't know." Ronaldo also bristled at criticism, saying media outlets had been trying to "kill" him for years. "That's not going to happen under any circumstances – not even with a shotgun," he said. "And even so, I still manage to dodge the bullet." Ronaldo may be 21 goals from four figures and perhaps closer to the exit than he cares to admit, but for now he remains exactly where he likes to be: in Portugal's shirt, in front of the cameras, and dodging bullets with a smile.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Governo abre discussão sobre futuro de concessões hidrelétricas, cita possíveis "travas" em leilões
item.description: O Ministério de Minas e Energia colocou em consulta pública uma proposta de diretrizes sobre o futuro de uma série de concessões de usinas hidrelétricas que vencem até 2032, citando possíveis "travas" em leilões para evitar concentração de mercado entre os grandes grupos hidrelétricos.
item.dc:creator: Leticia Augusto
item.content:encoded: O Ministério de Minas e Energia colocou em consulta pública uma proposta de diretrizes sobre o futuro de uma série de concessões de usinas hidrelétricas que vencem até 2032, citando possíveis "travas" em leilões para evitar concentração de mercado entre os grandes grupos hidrelétricos. A discussão interessa a importantes companhias do setor que possuem portfólios hidrelétricos, como Axia (AXIA3.SA) , Copel (CPLE3.SA) e Engie (EGIE3.SA) . Axia e Copel, que tiveram concessões hidrelétricas renovadas em seus processos de privatização, têm defendido que os próximos ativos vincendos sejam colocados para disputa em leilões, alegando que isso também [USN:S0N43801A TEXT:"maximizaria os ganhos ao governo"]. Já a Engie, com concessões vencendo nos próximos anos, quer a prorrogação de seus contratos. No documento, o ministério não propõe um caminho único -- licitação ou prorrogação -- para os contratos vincendos, que envolvem mais de 15 gigawatts (GW) do parque hidrelétrico brasileiro. Mas, no caso de eventuais leilões, diz que se cogita o estabelecimento de "travas ou limites máximos de aquisição dos ativos no leilão, calibrados pelo 'market share' resultante após os lances". A ideia, segundo a nota técnica, seria evitar que companhias elétricas aumentem seus portfólios hidrelétricos a ponto de serem capazes de exercer influência relevante sobre os preços de energia no país. Essas medidas seriam calibradas para que não reduzam a concorrência nos leilões, e também discutidas com os agentes do setor, órgãos de controle, regulador, operador, planejador, potenciais investidores, bem como os participantes do Sistema Brasileiro de Defesa da Concorrência (SBDC), diz a pasta. Já no caso de prorrogações contratuais, a alternativa ficaria condicionada, por exemplo, à demonstração da prestação do "serviço adequado". Também não haveria antecipação do fim do prazo da outorga atual. Tanto no caso de licitação quanto de prorrogação contratual, as empresas terão que pagar ao governo pelas novas outorgas hidrelétricas. O pagamento pelo valor da outorga ocorrerá 50% à vista, e o restante poderá ser pago em até cinco parcelas anuais, diretamente à Conta de Desenvolvimento Energético (CDE), visando a modicidade tarifária. A previsão é de que as novas outorgas hidrelétricas terão prazo de vinte anos, podendo ainda ter duração inferior. Ao todo, as regras devem alcançar 40 usinas hidrelétricas, que totalizam cerca de 15,4 GW de capacidade instalada, sendo 20 com concessões vencendo até 2029, e outras 20, no horizonte entre 2030 e 2032. Além disso, outras 40 pequenas centrais hidrelétricas (PCHs), com 0,7 GW de capacidade instalada, têm contratos expirando no período.

item.title: プーチン氏、下院選の高投票率は「軍への支持の表れ」と評価
item.description: [モスクワ ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[モスクワ ２３日 ロイター] - ロシアのプーチン大統領は２３日、先週末の下院選挙で高い投票率となったことについて、国民がウクライナで戦うロシア軍や国家安全保障を守る当局の取り組みを支持していることの表れだと述べた。

２１日発表された選挙結果によると、プーチン大統領を支持する与党「統一ロシア」が下院定数４５０議席のうち３５５議席、約８０％を占める見通しとなり、過去最多となる議席を獲得した。

ロシア中央選挙管理委員会によると、投票率は５９．３％だった。国営タス通信は、これは近年の下院選挙の大半を上回る水準だと伝えた。

結果について初めて公にコメントしたプーチン氏は、「これほど多く、さらには記録的ともいえる人数が投票に訪れたことは、ロシア国民が国の強化を目的としたわれわれの取り組みを支持していることを示している」と述べた。

item.title: US senators press for quick Chinese vehicle ban this week as Xi visits
item.description: US senators proposing bipartisan legislation to make permanent a ban on Chinese vehicles are aiming to win quick Senate approval this week, as President Donald Trump meets with China's President Xi Jinping, one of the bill's authors said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: US senators proposing bipartisan legislation to make permanent a ban on Chinese vehicles are aiming to win quick Senate approval this week, as President Donald Trump meets with China's President Xi Jinping, one of the bill's authors said on Wednesday. The effort, first reported by Reuters, is led by Democratic Senator Elissa Slotkin of Michigan and Republican Senator Bernie Moreno of Ohio. The bill has significant momentum and a House version now tops 100 cosponsors, while automakers and legislative aides hope to win passage this year. Slotkin said she and Moreno aim to win unanimous Senate approval for it this week. "Whether you are a Democrat or Republican, no one wants Chinese cars in America," she said at a Capitol Hill press conference, adding the measure's authors are trying to identify any opponents and address their concerns. A couple of Republican senators have already raised some concerns, a congressional aide told Reuters, adding that it was not yet clear whether they will object. A notice sent to offices of Democratic senators said Moreno intended to seek unanimous consent for the bill this week. Trump is expected to meet Xi in Washington this week to address a wide range of trade issues. China has strongly opposed the US vehicle ban and efforts to make it permanent. Earlier this month, Trump told Fox News he would accept Chinese car companies building cars in the United States, sparking alarm among automakers. Slotkin said allowing this would mark "the beginning of the end of auto manufacturing in the United States." INDUSTRY CONCERNS Last week, automakers, suppliers and dealers urged Trump "to maintain policies that keep the door firmly shut to Chinese automakers seeking to sell, import or manufacture vehicles inside the US" A regulation imposed by former President Joe Biden's administration in early 2025 effectively banned all Chinese automakers from selling or building passenger vehicles in the US because they could send sensitive driver data to China. Washington also maintains more than 100% tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles. The bill, which has 51 Senate supporters, would make the ban into law and prevent the White House from issuing waivers to Chinese vehicles to sell vehicles in the United States. The auto industry letter came from six groups representing General Motors (GM.N) , Toyota (7203.T) Volkswagen (VOWG.DE) , Ford (F.N) Hyundai (005380.KS) Stellantis (STLAM.MI) Tesla (TSLA.O) and others. They argue Chinese investment would not create new American jobs but "shift jobs away from manufacturers that have made generational investments in the US and toward companies owned and operated by the Chinese government." Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, cellular connectivity and some satellite communications technologies are covered under the rules based on national security concerns linked to the ability of vehicles to collect sensitive data on American owners.

item.title: 円が158円台前半に下落－強い指標でドル全面高、利上げ継続との見方
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 23日のニューヨーク外国為替市場で、ドルが主要通貨に対して全面高となり、円は対ドルで9月3日以来の安値をつけた。米総合購買担当者指数（PMI）が2021年以来およそ5年ぶりの高水準となり、連邦準備制度（FRB）が利上げを継続するとの見方が強まった。

円は一時、0.6%安の1ドル＝158円40銭まで売られ、200日移動平均線の158円45銭に接近した。先週18日に、日本銀行がレートチェックを実施したとの報道が伝わる前につけていた158円05銭の安値水準を超えて円安・ドル高が進んだ。

一方、ブルームバーグ・ドル・スポット指数は0.6%上昇し、7月30日以来の高水準を付けた。今月に入ってからは1.4%上昇している。

この日は金利が急上昇した。強いPMI統計に加え、原油高や低調な入札を受けて国債売りが加速。大半の年限で利回りが約20年ぶりの高水準に上昇した。

バンク・オブ・アメリカ（BofA）の為替ストラテジスト、アレックス・コーエン氏は「ファンダメンタルズは一段のドル高を示唆している」と指摘。「PMIの上振れで米経済の底堅さが改めて意識された。夏場に見られた米経済指標の弱含み傾向は後退し、FRBの利上げ観測は他国・地域よりも根強い」と述べた。

ドルを巡るセンチメントは改善が続いており、先高観が根強い。FRBが3年ぶりの利上げに踏み切った後も、当局者はインフレに対するタカ派姿勢を維持している。原油高と底堅い経済指標を背景に、短期金融市場は年内に少なくとも0.25ポイントの追加利上げを織り込んだ。10月の利上げ確率は50%を上回っている。

INGのストラテジスト、フランチェスコ・ペソレ氏は「相場を支配しているのはFRBだ。FRB高官のタカ派発言だけでも、ドル需要を維持するには十分だ」と指摘した。

過去10年の傾向では、9月最終週はドルが最も上昇しやすい。ブルームバーグの集計によると、この期間の週間騰落率（中央値）は、1年を通じて最も高かった。最終週に当たる21日から始まる今週も、ドルはこれまで0.8%上昇しており、今年も過去と同じ傾向をたどっている。

item.title: 南ア中銀、政策金利7.25％に引き上げ インフレ率3％への抑制目指す
item.description:
Kopano Gumbi Sfundo Parakozov
[プレトリア ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Kopano Gumbi　Sfundo Parakozov

[プレトリア　２３日　ロイター] - 南アフリカ準備銀行（ＳＡＲＢ、中央銀行）は２３日の金融政策委員会（ＭＰＣ）で、政策金利のレポ金利を２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）引き上げ、７．２５％にすることを全会一致で決定した。インフレ率を中銀目標である３％に抑えることを目指していると述べた。

南ア中銀は、インフレ目標３％の上下１％ポイントを許容範囲としている。８月の南ア消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）は前年同月４．４％上昇と、７月の４．３％から伸びが加速した。

ロイターがまとめた調査でエコノミストの大半が２５ｂｐの利上げを予想していた。７月に開かれた前回の会合以降、イラン情勢の緊迫化に伴い原油価格が再び上昇し、世界経済の見通しも悪化している。

item.title: Four US Republicans call for Trump to release Taiwan security funds
item.description: Four of US President Donald Trump's fellow Republicans called on his administration on Wednesday to release more than $15 billion in stalled national security assistance for Taiwan, as he prepared to welcome Chinese President Xi Jinping for a three-day visit to Washington.
item.dc:creator: Patricia Zengerle
item.content:encoded: Four of US President Donald Trump's fellow Republicans called on his administration on Wednesday to release more than $15 billion in stalled national security assistance for Taiwan, as he prepared to welcome Chinese President Xi Jinping for a [USN:L6N45E02J TEXT:"three-day visit"] to Washington. US Senators Mitch McConnell of Kentucky, the former Senate majority leader, John Cornyn of Texas, Lisa Murkowski of Alaska and Thom Tillis of North Carolina wrote to Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth expressing concern about the funds. The letter cites the State Department's failure to move ahead with $300 million in foreign military financing Congress appropriated for Taiwan, the Defense Department's failure to obligate $1 billion and the administration's decision to withhold approval for a $14 billion package of foreign military sales to the island. "We are concerned by President Trump's description of Taiwan as 'a very good negotiating chip' in engagements with Xi Jinping and the Chinese Communist Party," the letter said. "It is difficult to imagine how the United States might credibly project influence deterrence in the Indo-Pacific if the price of keeping up diplomatic appearances is denying our partners key deterrent capabilities," the letter said. The State and Defense departments did not immediately respond to a request for comment on the letter. Xi [USN:L4N45D00S TEXT:"is expected"] to press Trump to halt Taiwan arms sales altogether under a 1982 joint statement during his visit to Washington, sources briefed on the matter told Reuters. China regularly describes the issue of Taiwan, which Beijing views as its own territory, as its most sensitive and important diplomatic issue, and has repeatedly called for arms sales to stop. The Trump administration in December approved an $11 billion arms package to Taiwan, the largest ever. However, a second package, worth some $14 billion, has been on hold for months. After a [USN:P8N3ZT02P TEXT:"May summit in Beijing"] with Xi, Trump said he was holding it in abeyance and described it as a "very good negotiating chip." Trump's fellow Republicans in Congress rarely question his administration's actions publicly. Three of the senators who signed Wednesday's letter — McConnell, Cornyn and Tillis — are leaving the Senate at the end of this year, with only Murkowski remaining.

item.description: Sept 22 - A rise in Japanese bond yields is creating a "reverse carry" opportunity for overseas investors as Bank of Japan interest-rate hikes make the traditional yen-funded carry trade less compelling, Rong Ren Goh, fixed income portfolio manager at Eastspring Investments, said on Wednesday.Japanese asset p

Japan's steep yield curve opens 'reverse carry' trade opportunity, Eastspring says

A banknote of Japanese yen is seen in this illustration picture taken June 15, 2022. REUTERS/Florence Lo/Illustration

FAST

Sept 22 - A rise in Japanese bond yields is creating a "reverse carry" opportunity for overseas investors as Bank of Japan interest-rate hikes make the traditional yen-funded carry trade less compelling, Rong Ren Goh, fixed income portfolio manager at Eastspring Investments, said on Wednesday. Japanese asset prices have swung sharply since the US Federal Reserve and BOJ raised rates within two days of each other last week, with a decades-long era of ultra-cheap yen funding potentially giving way to a new dynamic where Japan's own bonds become the more attractive trade. Buying ultra-long Japanese government bonds and hedging yen exposure back into dollars or another developed-market currency could potentially give investors higher yields versus comparable bonds in their home markets, Goh told the Reuters Global Markets Forum. "The 30-year Japanese government bond above 4 per cent, when swapped in any developed-market currency in the world, including the dollar, gives you an FX-hedged yield 100 to 200 basis points higher than the base currency equivalent," he said.

Goh said the traditional yen-funded carry trade - in which investors borrow cheaply in the Japanese currency to buy higher-yielding foreign assets - is no longer a "no-brainer", as markets expect Japan's policy rate to eventually reach around 2 per cent from 1.25 per cent currently. He expects the reverse carry trade to gain broader appeal as investors become more confident of a stabilisation in Japanese bond prices following a selloff that started in 2022. Positioning data showed the net yen long position in the week to September 15 jumped to its highest since July 2025. A sharp move lower for the yen after Friday's 25-bp BOJ rate hike that came with two dissents, which investors interpreted as a dovish tilt at the Japanese central bank, was contained by a report that authorities conducted rate checks in the currency market. The yen is currently up 1.2 per cent versus the dollar month-to-date. Pointing to Japan's steepening yield curve - where the gap between 2- and 30-year JGB yields is more than 200 bps compared with an average of around 80 bps in other core developed markets where curves are flattening - Goh said buying dollar bonds no longer offered "any compelling carry play", even if the differential between U.S. and Japanese interest rates remained wide. Goh said Eastspring - which manages $291 billion in assets - is adding shorter-dated dollar-denominated bonds, while favouring the ultra-long end of the Japanese curve where the firm is gradually building exposure through high-quality corporate and Samurai bonds as it seeks "additional credit spread over and above JGBs to enhance carry further". Samurai bonds are yen-denominated debt issued by foreign governments or companies. Eastspring began 2026 with a relatively "underweight" position on the yen due to uncertainty over Japan's fiscal and monetary policies, but moved to a more neutral stance around August as currency intervention risk became more meaningful, Goh said. item.title: イラン、外交再開へ米に条件提示 ホルムズ海峡航路や制裁停止など
item.description: [国連／ドバイ ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[国連／ドバイ ２３日 ロイター] - イラン外務省の報道官は２３日、米国に対し外交再開の条件を伝えたと明らかにした。

報道官によると、イランは２２日、国連総会の合間に仲介役のカタールを通じ、２時間にわたり米国とメッセージを交換し、条件を提示した。条件には、ホルムズ海峡の沿岸国であるイランとオマーンが合意した同海峡の安全航路の受け入れ、経済「テロ」や海上封鎖を含む米国による対イラン措置の停止、凍結資産の解除、あらゆる戦線での戦闘終結が含まれるという。

これに先立ち、イラン高官は、敵対行為の終結に向けたイランの提案に対する米国の対応を精査していると明らかにした。また、両国の立場には依然多くの隔たりがあるものの、外交交渉は続いていると述べた。同高官によると、２２日の米・イラン間接協議では、ホルムズ海峡の再開や米国による対イラン海上封鎖の解除などが議題となった。

item.title: US open to extending China trade truce, or bigger deal, Bessent says after meeting with He
item.description: The United States is open to extending the US-China trade truce that expires on November 10 or looking at a more expansive trade deal, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Wednesday following his second meeting with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng to prepare for a summit between the two countries' leaders.
item.dc:creator: Andrea Shalal
item.content:encoded: The United States is open to extending the US-China trade truce that expires on November 10 or looking at a more expansive trade deal, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Wednesday following his second meeting with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng to prepare for [USN:L6N45E02J TEXT:"a summit"] between the two countries' leaders. Bessent said Beijing raised the issue of a potentially bigger US-China trade deal during talks on Sunday, but gave no details of its potential scope. US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping are expected to continue the talks at the White House on Thursday. "The Chinese on Sunday came up with the idea of a bigger deal, and given that this could be a historic year where the leaders meet up to four times -- this being the second meeting, in Shenzhen and then in Miami -- we're open to the idea of just continuing the Busan arrangement or examining the bigger deal," Bessent told reporters. "We're fine with both, and we're going to do what's best for the American people." In a post on X, Bessent called the discussions substantive and said Treasury was focused on securing "meaningful commitments that protect American workers, farmers and businesses while advancing U.S. economic and national security interests." “Both sides remain actively engaged, and the talks are making progress on a range of important issues,” said a source familiar with the meetings, describing them as productive and constructive. Bessent earlier said he was meeting with He at World Bank headquarters in Washington to clear up some "unfinished business" ahead of the Trump-Xi summit, adding that the Trump administration wanted strategic stability based on "reciprocity and fairness." His comments afterwards were the strongest signal yet that an extension of the trade truce struck last year in Busan, South Korea, was on the agenda for the Trump-Xi summit. Bessent, He and US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer [USN:L1N45B04Y TEXT:"met in New York on Sunday"] in an effort to tee up potential trade and artificial intelligence agreements for the two leaders to consider. Bessent has characterized those talks as successful, saying both sides had agreed to launch a communications "hotline" for notifying each other about AI safety incidents. China's response to the AI hotline plan was unclear, with state news agency Xinhua acknowledging only that the two sides discussed AI. US-China analysts say expectations on AI cooperation are low due to a lack of mutual trust on the technology and because neither side has expressed serious interest in slowing down development. In fact, Trump has said the opposite, that he would not "stifle" AI growth and would maintain the US lead over China in what he now calls "super intelligence." The Bessent-Greer-He meeting on Sunday left unresolved the fate of the nearly year-long trade truce between Washington and Beijing, which expires on November 10. The truce dramatically lowered bilateral tariff rates that had escalated to triple digits after tit-for-tat retaliation over Trump's tariff hikes last year. China also had agreed to restore the flow of rare earth magnets and other critical minerals that it had severely restricted. Greer told Bloomberg TV on Monday that discussions about extending the trade truce would continue because there was time. "But my expectation is we'll continue talking and I think both sides want it," he said of a trade truce extension. Greer added that the US needed to keep pressure on China to ensure compliance on its critical minerals agreements. US officials last week told reporters that the delivery of rare earths by China "has not been up to par." On Sunday, the two sides discussed other topics that had been previously discussed by Trump and Xi at a May meeting in Beijing, including lowering mutual tariffs on some non-strategic goods and Chinese purchases of Boeing aircraft and agricultural goods. Greer had said the two sides agreed to "operationalize" a process agreed in May for each side to identify potential tariff cuts on non-strategic goods, called the "Board of Trade." He said these could include Chinese exports such as "consumer goods, low-tech items," while US exports for this treatment could include energy, agricultural goods and medical devices.

item.title: 米ロ外相が会談、ルビオ氏「双方が限定停戦に関心」 ロシア慎重姿勢
item.description:
Tom Balmforth Antoni Slodkowski Simon Lewis
[ニューヨーク／モスクワ／国連 ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Tom Balmforth　Antoni Slodkowski　Simon Lewis

[ニューヨーク／モスクワ／国連　２３日　ロイター] - ルビオ米国務長官は２３日、ロシアのラブロフ外相と国連総会が開かれているニューヨークで会談した。会談後、ロシアとウクライナの双方が穀物関連施設やエネルギー関連施設を対象とする限定的な停戦に関心を示していると述べたほか、ロシアのプーチン大統領が２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）首脳会議への招待を受け入れることを期待するとし、プーチン氏が出席すればトランプ米大統領と会談する機会になるとの認識を示した。

ウクライナは、ロシアが今冬も発電施設や暖房施設を標的にする可能性を懸念しており、エネルギーインフラへの攻撃停止や黒海の海上輸送に関する安全保障を求めている。ルビオ氏はラブロフ氏との会談後に記者団に対し「ロシアとウクライナの双方が穀物とエネルギーを巡る限定的な停戦に関心を示している」と述べた。ただ「実現は容易ではない」とも指摘。エネルギー関連施設への攻撃が双方の戦術上の中核になっていることで停戦実現が難しくなっているとの認識を示した。

ロシアはエネルギー施設などに限定した停戦などを巡る取り決めに応じる用意があるとの考えを公に示しておらず、ルビオ氏の発言がラブロフ氏との会談で何らかの進展があったことを意味するのか、現時点では明らかになっていない。

＜ラブロフ氏、「特別軍事作戦」目標達成継続と表明＞

ロシア外務省もラブロフ氏がルビオ氏と会談したと発表。ウクライナと中東の情勢や、米ロ関係の改善など幅広い課題について「詳細な意見交換」を行ったとした。

また、ラブロフ氏はウクライナと「欧州の支援国」との連携のほか、ウクライナによる国境を越えた攻撃について言及。「ウクライナによる破壊的な行動や民間人、国境を越えるインフラ施設への意図的な攻撃について言及した」とし、こうした攻撃が「世界のエネルギー市場の不安定化につながっている」と伝えた。

同時に、ロシアはウクライナでの「特別軍事作戦」の目標達成に引き続き取り組む姿勢を表明。これには、ロシアがウクライナ全面侵攻の「根本的な原因」と位置付ける問題を考慮した形での解決も含まれるという。

ラブロフ氏はこのほか、米ロ関係の「早期改善」の必要性を強調し、将来的な経済協力拡大の可能性にも言及。「そのためには『懸案事項』の解消と両国の在外公館の正常な運営回復に向けた率直な対話が必要だ」とし、「事実上没収された米国内のロシア資産」の返還が必要になるとの認識を示した。

ラブロフ氏はこの日、ロシア・ウクライナ戦争を討議する国連安全保障理事会の会合に出席。会合で行った演説で、「欧州は停戦による時間稼ぎを望んでいるに過ぎない。目的はウクライナに武器供与を続けることにある」と述べ、ロシアには一時停戦を受け入れる考えがない可能性を示唆した。

＜ゼレンスキー氏、黒海海上停戦案を支持＞

ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領はこの日、国連総会に合わせて開催された「クリミア・プラットフォーム」首脳会合で行った演説で、エジプト、インド、トルコが提案した黒海の海上停戦案を受け入れる用意があると表明。対応はロシア次第になるとの認識を示した。

ゼレンスキー氏によると、会合でエジプト、インド、トルコが黒海での商船の安全な航行を回復するための選択肢を提示。「ロシアの回答を待っている」とし、「ロシアも緊張緩和に向けた真剣な措置を取れば、ウクライナは黒海の安全な航行と食料安全保障の確保に向けて準備ができている。どこかから始めなければならない」と語った。

黒海ではロシアとウクライナの双方による船舶や港湾インフラへの激しい攻撃を受け、貨物輸送がほぼ停止している。

item.title: Monedas caen con fuerza por avance del dólar ante expectativas nuevas alzas tasas Fed
item.description: Las principales monedas de América Latina cayeron con fuerza el miércoles, presionadas por el avance del dólar a nivel global, en medio de un alza de los retornos de los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense ante datos que reafirmaron las expectativas de alzas de tasas de interés por parte de la Reserva Federal.
item.dc:creator: Manuel Farías
item.content:encoded: Las principales monedas de América Latina cayeron con fuerza el miércoles, presionadas por el avance del dólar a nivel global, en medio de un alza de los retornos de los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense ante datos que reafirmaron las expectativas de alzas de tasas de interés por parte de la Reserva Federal. * La actividad empresarial estadounidense alcanzó en septiembre un máximo de más de cinco años, impulsada por un aumento de los nuevos pedidos, aunque la fuerte demanda ejerció presión sobre las cadenas de suministro y provocó un alza de los precios. * El gobernador de la Reserva Federal Michael Barr dijo el miércoles que el banco central estadounidense dio un paso importante la semana pasada para "recalibrar" los costos de financiación a corto plazo con el fin de reducir la inflación, y que probablemente tendrá que aplicar nuevas alzas de las tasas de interés. * El dólar repuntó a máximos de casi dos meses en la sesión, ya que los inversores aumentaron sus expectativas de alzas de tasas a corto plazo por parte de la Reserva Federal, mientras que los precios del petróleo escalaron después de que unas declaraciones de Irán pusieron en duda los avances en las negociaciones de paz. * El presidente iraní, Masoud Pezeshkian, prometió no rendirse nunca, un día después de que el mandatario estadounidense, Donald Trump, advirtiera que podría "aniquilar" a Irán. * El peso colombiano lideró las bajas al caer un 2,28%, a 3.276 unidades por dólar, su mayor descenso intradía en siete semanas y en su octava sesión de pérdidas. * En la bolsa el índice accionario MSCI COLCAP (.COLCAP) repuntó un 0,92% a 2.612,48 puntos. * El peso mexicano bajaba por la tarde un 1,36%, a 17,5065 unidades por dólar, a la espera además de la decisión sobre tasas de Banxico; en tanto que el índice S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , integrado por las 35 acciones más líquidas del mercado, cedía hacia el cierre un 0,37%, a 64.216,68 puntos. * "El peso se deprecia en la antesala de la decisión de política monetaria del Banco de México de mañana jueves 24 de septiembre, para la que se espera que mantenga la tasa de interés sin cambios en 6,50%", dijo Banco Base en un reporte. * "En contraste, el mercado anticipa tres incrementos adicionales de 25 puntos base en la tasa de interés de la Reserva Federal hacia junio del 2027 y dos incrementos adicionales por parte del Banco de Japón", agregó. * El real brasileño retrocedió un 1,27% a 5,1689 unidades por dólar la venta, mientras que el referencial bursátil Bovespa (.BVSP) se contagió del mal humor externo y perdió preliminarmente un 0,79%, a 185.940 puntos. * El peso chileno , cayó un 1,51%, a 962,20/962,50 unidades por dólar y anotó su menor valor de cierre en casi un año, ante el avance global de la divisa estadounidense y un retroceso en los precios del cobre, la mayor exportación del país. En tanto, el principal índice de la bolsa de comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) , avanzó un ligero 0,2%, a 11.449,63 puntos. * "El dólar sigue de cerca la tensión en medio oriente y el precio del petróleo. El dólar superó los 960 con el petróleo subiendo +3% y el cobre cayendo 1%. Si bien eso tiene lógica, la magnitud de la subida del CLP (tipo de cambio) es mayor que la de otros países como México o Brasil... lo que tiene bastante sorprendido a buena parte del mercado local", dijo Patricio Eskenazi, director de Inversiones de Conpat Global. * El peso mayorista argentino se depreció un 0,13% a 1.516,5 unidades por dólar, en un mercado donde el banco central (BCRA) interviene diariamente para sumar reservas a sus arcas, en base a un acuerdo con el FMI. La entidad monetaria compró 6 millones de dólares de la plaza cambiaria. * El índice líder S&P Merval (.MERV) de la bolsa de Buenos Aires, en tanto, cayó un 0,94%. * "El mercado descuenta que habrá estabilidad total del tipo de cambio real hasta mediados del año que viene, según surge de la comparación entre las curvas CER (inflación) y 'dollar linked' (tipo de cambio)", reportó el agente de liquidación y compensación Facimex. * El Estimador Mensual de la Actividad Económica (EMAE) de Argentina habría mejorado un 1,8% interanual en julio, reflejando una desaceleración respecto al 2,7% de junio, según la mediana de un sondeo de Reuters. * La moneda peruana, el sol , se depreció un 0,8% a 3,3890/3,3930 unidades por dólar. En tanto que la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) perdió un 1,6% a 1.568 puntos.

Klaba said a proposed 200-million-euro public commitment t

Octave Klaba, founder and Chairman of French web-hosting and server provider OVH Group, attends a debate during the MEDEF summer forum "La Rencontre des Entrepreneurs de France, La REF" in Paris, France, August 27, 2026. REUTERS/Stephanie Lecocq

FAST

Sept 23 : OVHcloud CEO Octave Klaba on Tuesday estimated operators of Europe's proposed AI gigafactories would need annual sales of 300 million euros to 400 million euros just to break even on facilities built around fast-depreciating graphics chips.  Klaba said a proposed 200-million-euro public commitment to buy AI services over five years was too small to underpin the scale of private investment required and said focus on national markets prevented OVHcloud from joining existing French consortia.  The EuroHPC program is seeking industry consortia to build and operate up to seven AI gigafactories: large computing facilities for training, fine-tuning and running AI models. "Any national strategy is doomed to failure: there are simply not enough customers to make investments of this size profitable. In our view, national demand is too weak and we must operate on a European scale," he said.

Klaba said the public sector would buy 40 million euros of computing services a year, while an operator would spend at least 600 million euros for chips alone. "The numbers don't add up," he said.  He estimated a gigafactory would need 300 million euros to 400 million euros in annual revenue to break even, making the public order worth only 10 per cent-15 per cent of required turnover.

item.title: Scientists map gene activity in brain's prefrontal cortex
item.description: Scientists have created a detailed map of gene activity within a crucial part of the brain called the prefrontal cortex, gaining insight into normal development and major brain disorders such as Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease and schizophrenia.
item.dc:creator: Will Dunham
item.content:encoded: Scientists have created a detailed map of gene activity within a crucial part of the [USN:L1N3WF0WU TEXT:"brain"] called the prefrontal cortex, gaining insight into normal development and major brain disorders such as [USN:L1N3XG1B9 TEXT:"Alzheimer's disease"], Parkinson's disease and schizophrenia. In nine separate studies, the researchers examined changes in individual types of brain cells that occur over time and made progress toward deciphering molecular processes that underlie some of the most devastating brain disorders, a step toward possible new treatments. The prefrontal cortex is the front part of the brain's outer layer, located behind the forehead. It helps a person plan, make decisions, regulate emotions and adapt behavior. It also is sensitive to age-related decline, and its functions are affected in many psychiatric and neurodegenerative disorders. Gene activity was examined in the nuclei of more than 6.3 million brain cells — neurons, immune cells, cells associated with blood vessels and support cells that help maintain brain function — from 1,494 deceased donors, ranging in age from infancy to 108 years old, and with various genetic ancestries. The donors included people with no diagnosed brain disorder as well as people diagnosed with conditions such as Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, Lewy body dementia, vascular dementia, schizophrenia and bipolar disorder. The research identified patterns shared across some of the diseases as well as some specific to individual disorders. "Together, these studies help explain where disease-related changes occur and which biological processes deserve closer investigation," said Dr. Panos Roussos, director of the Center for Disease Neurogenomics at the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai in New York City and a leader of the research published on Wednesday in Nature and other journals. "A useful treatment needs to influence the right biological process in the right cells. This map helps narrow that search. It can identify vulnerable cell populations, reveal processes associated with preserved brain function and help researchers decide which potential treatment targets to test," Roussos said. The work was conducted as part of the PsychAD research consortium, with support from the National Institute on Aging, part of the US government's National Institutes of Health. STRONG SIMILARITIES Alzheimer's, Lewy body disease, vascular dementia and Parkinson's showed particularly strong similarities in gene activity involved in nerve-cell development, neuronal communication and blood-vessel biology. The researchers also identified pathways shared in Alzheimer's and Parkinson's in microglia, the brain's resident immune cells. Comparing brain samples from donors of different ages, the researchers found extensive molecular changes during development until adulthood, relative stability through much of adulthood and then renewed changes later in life, particularly in immune and support cells. "This provides a reference for distinguishing typical aging from disease-associated changes," Roussos said. The researchers identified approximately age 24 as a transition point after which the bulk of most cell types in this region become more stable. "It does not mean the brain suddenly finishes developing on someone's 24th birthday, or that decline begins at that age. Other aspects of brain biology continue to change throughout life," Roussos said. The researchers found cellular patterns associated with differences in cognition and with depression accompanying Alzheimer's. For instance, people who retained cognitive function despite experiencing substantial Alzheimer's pathology showed differences in energy-related processes in brain cells. "These provide clues to possible protective mechanisms that need further testing," Roussos said. INHERITED GENETIC RISK The researchers connected inherited genetic risk of disorders to particular genes and cell types, and mapped genetic influences on the activity of more than 14,000 genes. They also reconstructed daily patterns of gene activity using brain samples from people who died at different times of day. In younger and middle-aged adults, daily clock genes showed coordinated patterns in neurons. In older adults, those patterns were weaker and less synchronized. "This suggests that aging changes how daily biological rhythms are organized within the brain. Whether restoring those rhythms could improve brain health is an important question for future research," Roussos said. The researchers also built molecular profiles for individual donors who had Alzheimer's, and identified differences in gene regulation and predicted interactions between cell types among individuals. "This helps explain biological variation among people with the same diagnosis, and provides a foundation for investigating more individualized treatment strategies," Roussos said.

item.title: 米総合ＰＭＩ、9月は5年ぶり高水準 新規受注急増も供給網圧迫
item.description:
Lucia Mutikani
[ワシントン ２３日 ロイター] - Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルが２３日発表した９月の米総合購買担...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米総合ＰＭＩ、9月は5年ぶり高水準　新規受注急増も供給網圧迫 0:03 配信

2025年12月、ニュージャージー州ロビンズビルにのアマゾン施設で撮影。REUTERS/Eduardo Munoz

Lucia Mutikani

[ワシントン ２３日 ロイター] - Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルが２３日発表した９月の米総合購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）速報値は５８．４と、前月の５６．０から上昇し、２０２１年７月以来の高水準となった。新規受注の急増が押し上げ要因となった。一方で、堅調な需要がサプライチェーン（供給網）を圧迫し、物価上昇につながっている実態も浮き彫りとなった。

指数はサービス業、製造業ともに上昇した。ＰＭＩは５０が景況拡大・縮小の分岐点。Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルは、今回の結果について年率換算で約５％の経済成長率と整合的との見方を示した。同時に、未処理の受注残高やサプライチェーンの遅延が急増しているとし、「操業能力の不足を示しており、それが価格上昇につながっている」と指摘した。

Ｓ＆Ｐグローバル・マーケット・インテリジェンスのチーフビジネスエコノミスト、クリス・ウィリアムソン氏は「製造業とサービス業の両方で活況を呈している」と指摘。その上で、「この成長には、新型コロナのパンデミック（世界的大流行）を除けば、調査開始以来約２０年で最も深刻なサプライチェーンのボトルネックが伴っている」と述べた。

新規受注指数は５８．２と、８月の５５．２から上昇し、２２年３月以来の高水準を記録した。サービス業、製造業の双方で上昇した。設備稼働率や将来の事業成長を示す重要な指標である受注残も２２年５月以来の高水準に達した。

Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルによると、各企業は受注残の増加に対応するため採用を拡大しているものの、適切な人材の確保に苦慮しているとの報告が増えている。

ウィリアムソン氏は「未完了受注の積み上がりは、今後数カ月間の生産高と生産能力の一段の拡大につながる可能性を示している。一方で、企業の価格決定力が高まっていることも示しており、インフレ見通しにとっては懸念材料だ」と述べた。

投入物価指数は６６．４と、前月の５９．９から急上昇し、２２年１０月以来の高水準となった。支払価格指数も上昇し、とりわけサービス部門での上昇が目立った。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か 焦点：トランプ政権の影で歩み寄るカナダとＥＵ、準加盟提示でも見える限界 コラム：ＡＩ相場はドットコム・バブルの再来か、強気派に分がある理由 焦点：中国株、ＧＤＰ発表後も買い不発　不動産低迷で慎重ムード コラム：トランプ米大統領、任期中の利下げは望み薄　市場は高金利長期化を想定 最終更新: 9/24(木) 0:03 ロイター

item.description: DHAKA, Sept 23 : Bangladesh will buy a further 11 aircraft from Boeing, officials said on Wednesday, expanding national carrier Biman Bangladesh Airlines' planned orders to 25 jets as Dhaka seeks closer trade ties with the United States amid concerns over tariffs on its exports.The agreement, scheduled to b

item.content:encoded:

Bangladesh to buy 11 more Boeing jets as it seeks closer US trade ties

FAST

DHAKA, Sept 23 : Bangladesh will buy a further 11 aircraft from Boeing, officials said on Wednesday, expanding national carrier Biman Bangladesh Airlines' planned orders to 25 jets as Dhaka seeks closer trade ties with the United States amid concerns over tariffs on its exports. The agreement, scheduled to be signed in New York on Wednesday, is part of Bangladesh's efforts to boost imports from the United States, ease pressure from a roughly $6 billion trade imbalance and reduce the risk of tariff increases that could hurt its export-driven economy, particularly the garment sector. The US Ambassador to Bangladesh, Brent Christensen, confirmed the Boeing purchase in a Facebook post, calling it another "win-win" for US-Bangladesh relations. Biman is renewing its fleet, aiming to expand capacity and improve connectivity.

The latest order follows a $3.7 billion deal signed in April for 14 Boeing aircraft, including 10 Dreamliners and four 737 MAX 8 jets, with deliveries scheduled between 2031 and 2035. European rival Airbus remains in contention, with a government-appointed technical committee reviewing a proposal to acquire 10 aircraft. Details of the additional Boeing order are expected to be disclosed after the signing ceremony.

item.title: Wall Street cierra en baja ante aumento precios del petróleo y de rendimiento bonos Tesoro
item.description: Wall Street cerró a la baja el miércoles, lastrado por Alphabet y Amazon, ya que los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro avanzaron y el presidente de Irán afirmó que Teherán nunca cedería ante la presión de Estados Unidos.
item.dc:creator: Noel Randewich
item.content:encoded: Wall Street cerró a la baja el miércoles, lastrado por Alphabet y Amazon, ya que los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro avanzaron y el presidente de Irán afirmó que Teherán nunca cedería ante la presión de Estados Unidos. * Los precios del petróleo escalaron casi un 4% y el índice del sector energético del S&P 500 (.SPNY) repuntó tras el discurso en la ONU del presidente iraní, Masoud Pezeshkian, un día después de que el mandatario estadounidense, Donald Trump, advirtiera que podría "aniquilar" a Irán. * Una encuesta reveló que la actividad empresarial en Estados Unidos se aceleró en septiembre hasta su nivel más alto en más de cinco años, lo que impulsó a los rendimientos de los bonos gubernamentales y aumentó las expectativas de que la Reserva Federal suba las tasas de interés en su reunión de octubre. * Los retornos de los bonos del Tesoro a dos años alcanzaron su nivel más alto desde 2024, mientras que los de la deuda a 10 años tocaron su máximo desde 2007. * "El mercado de valores quiere una resolución al conflicto (en Oriente Medio) y, si no la conseguimos, tendremos tasas más altas durante más tiempo, lo que seguirá pesando sobre el mercado de renta variable", señaló Lauren Cassidy, directora de inversiones de Founders 100 ETF en Dallas. * Meta Platforms (META.O) extendió sus ganancias de esta semana tras la buena acogida de su asistente de IA "Muse". Según analistas, este podría beneficiar a las firmas de infraestructura tecnológica, al tiempo que desafía a bancos, plataformas de comercio electrónico y otros negocios orientados al consumidor. * Alphabet (GOOGL.O) , empresa matriz de Google, cayó, al igual que Amazon (AMZN.O) , que ha bloqueado el uso de Muse en su plataforma de compras. * El índice de semiconductores PHLX (.SOX) retrocedió, con Nvidia (NVDA.O) perdiendo terreno. * Según datos preliminares, el S&P 500 (.SPX) perdió 57,74 puntos, o un 0,74%, a 7.706,39 puntos; el Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) cedió 308,24 puntos, o un 1,10%, a 26.943,61 unidades; y el Promedio Industrial Dow Jones (.DJI) cayó 340,39 puntos, o un 0,66%, a 51.523,30 unidades. * Los mercados también analizaron los comentarios del gobernador de la Fed Michael Barr, quien señaló que probablemente el banco central deba aplicar nuevas subidas de tasas de interés, dado que la inflación se mantiene por sobre el objetivo del 2%.

item.title: Petrobras já garantiu importações de diesel de 650 mi litros em outubro
item.description: A Petrobras já garantiu as compras externas de diesel necessárias para outubro, quando sazonalmente há um pico de consumo de diesel no Brasil, enquanto não vê grandes volumes necessários de compras externas para novembro, afirmou a diretora de Logística, Comercialização e Mercados, Angélica Laureano.
item.dc:creator: Marta Nogueira
item.content:encoded: A Petrobras (PETR3.SA) já garantiu as compras externas de diesel necessárias para outubro, quando sazonalmente há um pico de consumo de diesel no Brasil, enquanto não vê grandes volumes necessários de compras externas para novembro, afirmou a diretora de Logística, Comercialização e Mercados, Angélica Laureano. A afirmação vem após executivos do setor de distribuição e importação terem afirmado mais cedo neste mês que havia preocupações com restrições localizadas de oferta no país. [USN:L6N4580W6 TEXT:"Na ocasião"], a defasagem em relação aos valores praticados pela Petrobras no Brasil havia subido para níveis recordes com uma nova escalada de preços do produto no exterior. Também nesta quarta-feira, o presidente da Vibra Energia (VBBR3.SA) , Ernesto Pousada, afirmou que a maior distribuidora do país está preparada para ampliar as importações de diesel se houver necessidade, mesmo no atual cenário, em que o combustível no mercado internacional está entre R$2 e R$3 por litro mais caro que no Brasil. A Petrobras, principal supridora de diesel no Brasil, prevê importar 650 milhões de litros de diesel no próximo mês. Por volta de outubro, o Brasil costuma passar por seu período de maior demanda de diesel, devido ao plantio da safra verão, que coincide também com o transporte do milho recém-colhido. "As compras para outubro já estão realizadas. Em novembro ainda não sabemos se vamos ter demanda adicional, porque nós temos uma produção que atende bastante à nossa demanda", disse Laureano, após participar de uma mesa de discussões no congresso de petróleo e gás ROG.e. "Mas não é previsto que em novembro venhamos a importar um volume grande de diesel, porque já é um momento depois da safra." O volume que a Petrobras deve importar em outubro, contudo, representa menos da metade das importações totais do Brasil no mesmo mês do ano passado, de 1,6 bilhão de litros, segundo dados da reguladora ANP. Ela adicionou que a refinaria da empresa no Paraná, a Repar, está parando para manutenção programada e retornará em novembro. Mas disse que as demais unidades de refino estão em operação, com fator de utilização "bastante alto". DISTRIBUIÇÃO Em uma outra mesa da ROG.e, Pousada destacou que em março e abril deste ano a Vibra dobrou suas importações de diesel. Segundo ele, a Vibra tem capacidade de importação nos principais portos brasileiros e acesso a diferentes fornecedores internacionais, o que permite à companhia reagir a mudanças nos fluxos globais de diesel. Pousada ponderou que algumas fontes que tradicionalmente abasteciam o Brasil deixaram de fornecer o produto nos últimos meses, mas que a companhia conseguiu substituir esses volumes. "Algumas fontes sumiram no mercado. Fontes que tipicamente abasteciam o Brasil pararam de abastecer e em nenhum momento faltou diesel para os nossos clientes", afirmou. Questionado sobre um cenário de eventuais restrições ainda maiores à oferta internacional, Pousada disse acreditar que o principal impacto para o Brasil seria sobre os preços, e não sobre a disponibilidade do produto. O aumento das importações no início do ano também expôs gargalos na infraestrutura brasileira, segundo Pousada. Ele afirmou que, ao dobrar as compras externas em março e abril, a Vibra conseguiu receber o produto pelos portos, mas enfrentou pressão sobre sua estrutura de transporte rodoviário para levar o combustível ao interior do país. A empresa está mais acostumada a receber volumes por dutos diretamente da Petrobras ou de outras refinarias brasileiras, disse. "Eu tenho capacidade no porto, pusemos um estresse em caminhões. Custo, isso é improdutividade do país", afirmou, defendendo mais investimentos em ferrovias e conexões entre portos e mercados consumidores.

item.title: Zelenskiy warns of painful winter for Russia if energy truce talks fail
item.description: President Volodymyr Zelenskiy warned Moscow at the United Nations on Wednesday that Ukraine would strike back and make the coming winter deeply painful for Russia, if the two sides cannot agree a truce on energy attacks before the cold sets in.
item.dc:creator: Tom Balmforth, Antoni Slodkowski, Simon Lewis
item.content:encoded: President Volodymyr Zelenskiy warned Moscow at the United Nations on Wednesday that Ukraine would strike back and make the coming winter deeply painful for Russia, if the two sides cannot agree a truce on energy attacks before the cold sets in. Ukraine and its allies are racing to secure limited agreements on energy infrastructure and Black Sea shipping before winter, fearing renewed Russian strikes on power and heating facilities, while Moscow continues to show little interest in wider negotiations to end the war. "Ukrainians understand that this winter could be very harsh for us. But in response, we will have no choice but to make it painful for Russia too," Zelenskiy told the UN General Assembly during the annual gathering of world leaders in New York. Though Russia has a far bigger arsenal of missiles which it has used to pound its enemy throughout the war, Ukraine has developed and used thousands of long-range drones to strike back at Russian warehouses, port infrastructure and oil refineries. "That’s exactly why we say that de-escalation steps are needed before winter," Zelenskiy said, calling for more robust diplomacy and noting the potential sway that Chinese President Xi Jinping could have on Russian President Vladimir Putin. China's Xi, who did not attend the United Nations gathering, was due on Thursday to hold White House talks with US President Donald Trump, with whom Zelenskiy met on Tuesday to discuss a ceasefire on energy-related targets. NO SIGN OF CHANGING RUSSIAN POSITION Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov held talks with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Wednesday, after which Rubio said Ukraine and Russia had both voiced an interest in a limited ceasefire involving grain and energy-related targets. There was no immediate sign of any movement in the Russian position, however. A Russian Foreign Ministry statement said that at the meeting it had "reaffirmed its unconditional commitment to achieving the objectives of its special military operation," the phrase that Moscow uses to describe its war in Ukraine. Addressing the 15-member Security Council on the sidelines of the annual UN gathering of world leaders, Lavrov indicated that Moscow would not countenance any temporary cessation of hostilities. "Europe, whatever it thinks, just wants to get a pause, and it wants to use it to pump the Kyiv regime with weapons," he told a council session focused on the war in Ukraine. Britain, France and Denmark's top diplomats used their speeches to deliver strong condemnations of Russia's war, warning variously of dangerous escalation and the spike in civilian deaths this summer. 'WE ARE WAITING FOR RUSSIA'S RESPONSE' Zelenskiy used his address to the General Assembly to single out Putin's role in driving the war, repeatedly describing him derisively as "patient zero" and "the one from whom this idea of war keeps spreading further". "That is why 'patient zero' must be stopped. He must be denied the space to act – and the space to spread this evil further," he said. Zelenskiy told leaders at a "Crimean Platform" summit on the sidelines of the UN that Kyiv was ready for a maritime truce in the Black Sea based on proposals such as those put forward by Egypt, India and Turkey. "We are waiting for Russia's response. Ukraine is ready ... to ensure safe shipping and food security in the Black Sea if Russia is ready to take real steps towards de-escalation too. We have to start somewhere," he said. Top wheat importers in Asia, the Middle East and Africa that count on the Black Sea region for wheat have been finding it hard to secure supplies. Global wheat prices have soared.

item.title: 習氏訪米、中国企業代表団は同行しない見通し＝関係筋
item.description: [北京 ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[北京 ２３日 ロイター] - 中国の習近平国家主席による今週の訪米に、中国企業の代表団が同行しない見通しであることが分かった。関係筋２人が明らかにした。理由は明らかになっていない。

関係筋の１人は、米政権には他の優先事項があると述べた。一方、別の関係筋によると、米当局者は中国軍と関係があるとみられる中国企業の代表が訪問に参加することを望んでいないという。

中国外務省報道官は定例記者会見で、中国企業代表団の同行に関する質問に対し、「その件に関する情報は持ち合わせていない」と述べた。

ロイターは先週、関係筋の話として、習氏の訪米に同行する中国の経済界トップの人選が進められており、米規制当局の厳しい審査や規制措置の対象となっている企業が、市場アクセス拡大を求めて代表団に加わる可能性があると報じていた。

item.title: Debilidad de precios de activos domina escena de mercados argentinos
item.description: La plaza financiera de Argentina finalizó el miércoles con prudencia y retracción sostenida de precios por la cautela entre los inversores ante factores locales y externos.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La plaza financiera de Argentina finalizó el miércoles con prudencia y retracción sostenida de precios por la cautela entre los inversores ante factores locales y externos. Las dudas de cara a las elecciones presidenciales del 2027 en Argentina y el prolongado conflicto en Oriente Medio que presionaba sobre el petróleo contribuían a la cautela en los negocios. "El mercado argentino está en un punto de lateralización por la falta de un conductor sólido a mediano plazo ante la incertidumbre del año electoral, por lo que los activos permanecen tranquilos y las coberturas en dólares agilizan la dinámica", comentó un analista de riesgo de un banco español. "Uno de los principales riesgos es que se tenga un nuevo cambio abrupto de timón político, por lo que la cautela domina la escena de los mercados. La dinámica de la economía real, con un necesario aumento en el ritmo del consumo, será vital para ver alguna nueva variable", agregó. El presidente libertario argentino, Javier Milei, dijo que buscará su reelección, luego de ocupar el cargo en reemplazo de un Gobierno de centroizquierda desde diciembre del 2023. El índice líder S&P Merval (.MERV) de la bolsa porteña cayó un 0,94% a las 2000 GMT y los bonos públicos extrabursátiles retrocedieron un 1,2% promedio ante la salida de fondos institucionales, con un riesgo país que se ubicaba en los 557 puntos básicos, un nivel máximo desde inicio de mayo pasado. Operadores coincidieron en que un aumento en la aversión al riesgo global jugaba en contra de los títulos públicos. El peso mayorista apenas se depreció un 0,13% a 1.516,5 unidades por dólar , en un mercado donde el banco central (BCRA) suele intervenir diariamente para sumar reservas a sus arcas, en base a un acuerdo con el FMI. La entidad monetaria argentina compró 6 millones de dólares de la plaza cambiaria. "El mercado descuenta que habrá estabilidad total del tipo de cambio real hasta mediados del año que viene, según surge de la comparación entre las curvas CER (inflación) y 'dollar linked' (tipo de cambio)", reportó el agente de liquidación y compensación Facimex. "Esto es mayormente consistente con lo que muestra la experiencia histórica de elecciones presidenciales con riesgo de reversión de políticas en Latinoamérica, aunque creemos que las valuaciones actuales dejan algo de espacio para captar valor rebalanceando posiciones a junio 2027", agregó. El [USN:L1N45E0R2 TEXT:"Tesoro"] de Argentina concretó el martes un canje de deuda a corto plazo por equivalente a 3.332 millones de dólares, un 75% del volumen propuesto para despejar el horizonte financiero. El Banco de Exportación e Importación de Estados Unidos tiene previsto financiar proyectos relacionados con minerales críticos y energía en Argentina por un valor de hasta 7.000 millones de dólares, según un documento al que tuvo acceso [USN:L6N45F08J TEXT:"Reuters"], como parte de una iniciativa para profundizar la cooperación económica entre Washington y Buenos Aires.

item.title: イランとの合意「一定期間にわたる取り組み必要」＝米国務長官
item.description: [ニューヨーク ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ニューヨーク　２３日　ロイター] - ルビオ米国務長官は２３日、イランとの合意には一定期間にわたる多大な取り組みが必要になるとの見方を示した。また、トランプ大統領には軍事的な選択肢もあると記者団に語った。

ルビオ氏は、イラン問題について「われわれは（ホルムズ）海峡が問題であることを理解している」とした上で、「われわれは、引き続き海峡の防衛と開放を維持する」と述べた。

また、「イランとの合意が成立するなら、一定期間にわたる多大な取り組みが必要になるだろう」とした上で、トランプ大統領には軍事的選択肢を含め、多くの選択肢があると述べた。

item.title: First US-Iran talks in months raise hopes for progress despite no concessions
item.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner communicated through mediators on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

World

First US-Iran talks in months raise hopes for progress despite no concessions

Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner communicated through mediators on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York.

Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and other delegates attend the 81st United Nations General Assembly at UN headquarters in New York City, US, on Sep 23, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Mike Segar)

FAST

UNITED NATIONS/DUBAI: The first shuttle talks between the United States and Iran in months raised hopes on Wednesday (Sep 23) that the adversaries could make progress towards ending the Middle East war, although neither side spelled out any change in its position. Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner communicated through mediators on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York, the first such contacts since an interim ceasefire agreement collapsed in July. "Steve and Jared had a very productive meeting today with mediators of Iran," US President Donald Trump said. "I think there's a lot of momentum for them to make a deal. It's what we're hearing from everybody." Earlier, Trump had told the UN General Assembly in a speech that he had to decide whether to make a deal with Iran or " annihilate " it. Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian was due to address the gathering on Wednesday. Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmail Baghaei said Tehran had engaged with the United States through a Qatari mediator in New York and conveyed conditions, including an end to the war on all fronts and a halt to US "acts of aggression". Some Iranian state media had earlier reported that Araghchi and Witkoff had met, but Iranian officials clarified to Reuters that it was not face-to-face. Araghchi met the prime minister of Qatar, Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani, one of the main mediators at previous talks. The contacts offered the first diplomatic opening in months after negotiations broke down in July and fighting resumed across the region. Since then, the two sides have repeatedly exchanged fire , although Trump has stopped short of a full-scale resumption of US strikes after military commanders warned munitions stocks were running low. IRAN HARDLINERS RESIST DIPLOMATIC MOVES The diplomatic contact in New York caused backlash in Iranian media associated with hardliners. An opinion piece run by the semi-official Tasnim news agency, associated with the Revolutionary Guards, said Araghchi was wrong to have contacts with Witkoff and Kushner, "a major gift to Trump", as Iran had already conveyed its terms. Iranian sources told Reuters the delegation had been ordered not to meet the Americans face-to-face by the Supreme National Security Council, a body that includes figures selected by Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei, the supreme leader, who has yet to appear in public since replacing his father killed on the war's first day. One Iranian journalist covering the visit told Reuters that some hardliners viewed the trip to New York itself as an insult to the memory of the slain leader, Ali Khamenei.

Related:

Iran 'toughened' conditions for ending war after US deal collapse: Guards spokesman

Iran attacks US targets despite Trump threats

OIL PRICES HOLD NEAR TWO-WEEK LOW Still, the diplomatic opening helped keep oil prices near two-week lows. Brent crude hovered around US$100 a barrel after surging earlier this month when Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis launched a major offensive, threatening traffic through the Red Sea, an alternative Saudi export route. The war, launched by Trump in February alongside Israel as "Operation Epic Fury", has lasted nearly seven months, killing thousands of people, disrupting global energy supplies and spreading to other countries in the region - particularly to Lebanon and more recently to Yemen. Trump repeated previous assertions that the war could end around the time of November's US midterm elections, though he has not explained why. An interim agreement reached in June, signed by Trump and Pezeshkian, would have given Iran its main demands: lifting financial sanctions and unfreezing assets in return for talks on limiting its nuclear programme. But that deal unravelled within weeks over shipping rules in the Strait of Hormuz, a conduit for a fifth of global oil and liquefied natural gas before the war. Iran wants to exert control and collect fees from ships that use it, which Washington rejects. In the latest reported attack in the strait, Britain's UKMTO maritime security agency said a cargo ship had been hit by projectiles, causing two casualties among the crew. The crew had been evacuated, and the ship was on fire and adrift. Despite near-daily attacks, traffic through the strait has picked up in recent weeks. Oil producers pay shipping companies fees of as much as a quarter of a cargo's value to take the wartime risk of sailing through the strait with transponders switched off, before transferring crude to other vessels on the far side. Exports from the United Arab Emirates have already recovered to pre-war levels, and Saudi Arabia has sold 60 million barrels of Gulf oil for both this month and next, to be delivered beyond the strait off the coast of Oman. Nevertheless, a third of Gulf oil is estimated to be missing from global supplies. Shortages have particularly hit refined products such as diesel, causing inflation, pushing up interest rates and hurting Trump's Republicans ahead of the elections.

Source: Reuters/rk

item.title: Florida fund sues New York Times over alleged anti-Israel bias, demands records
item.description: Florida's state-run public pension fund and a conservative think tank sued the New York Times on Wednesday, seeking materials to determine whether the company's board is letting the newspaper promote biased editorial coverage against Israel.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan Stempel
item.content:encoded: Florida's state-run public pension fund and a conservative think tank sued the New York Times (NYT.N) on Wednesday, seeking materials to determine whether the company's board is letting the newspaper promote biased editorial coverage against Israel. According to a petition filed in a New York state court in Manhattan, a series of factual errors in Times reporting on various subjects supports a reasonable inference that the board has allowed journalistic standards to be "weaponized within the company to serve the personal agendas of unchecked editors." The State Board of Administration of Florida (SBA), which oversees the Florida Retirement System Trust Fund, and the National Center for Public Policy Research said they are not second-guessing the newspaper's editorial judgment, but want assurances the board is making sure the Times follows its editorial standards and avoids "biased and unreliable" reporting. Both petitioners are Times shareholders, and said New York state law entitled them to inspect its records but the newspaper refused. "This lawsuit has no merit and was brought for an improper purpose," Times spokesperson Charlie Stadtlander said. "Although it is positioned as a corporate governance petition to inspect the company’s books and records, it is a transparent attempt to exert agenda-driven pressure against an independent media organization, level false allegations of bias and chill journalism protected by the First Amendment," he added. "We will defend against the suit vigorously.” BATTLES OVER ISRAEL COVERAGE, INDEPENDENCE Many media, including the Times, have faced accusations they have skewed coverage against Israel following the October 2023 outbreak of war in Gaza . Wednesday's petition also escalates a growing battle nationwide over journalistic independence, including US President Donald Trump's decision last week to ban CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House. Those [USN:FWN45C04L TEXT:"outlets sued Trump"], saying the ban was unconstitutional and violated their First Amendment rights. The Florida pension fund serves more than 1.2 million retirees, and had about $235.7 billion of assets under management as of August 31, according to its website. Florida Governor Ron DeSantis and Attorney General James Uthmeier, both Republicans, are SBA trustees. “The Times says unreliable journalism is a material risk," Uthmeier said in a post on X. "We asked if the board oversees its standards, and they refused to produce a single page." WHISTLEBLOWER CLAIMS Wednesday's petition is based in part on claims by an unnamed former Times newsroom employee who worked there for a decade, and began complaining as early as 2019 about its alleged widespread culture of anti-Israel bias. The petition said the Times repeatedly brushed off the whistleblower's complaints, including when a supervisor told her "it's not your job to be the ombudsman" and a human resources representative suggested she "go find a place whose values align with yours." It also said the Times appears to have not followed through on Times publisher and board chair A.G. Sulzberger's commitment in 2019 to update its "unconscious bias training" to include a direct focus on antisemitism. “We’re not trying to censor anyone," Steve Milloy, executive director of the think tank's Free Enterprise Project, said in an interview. "But if they want to go down as the paper of record, then there must be records backing up what they’re claiming.”

item.title: Iran's Pezeshkian accuses Trump of 'bullying mentality,' vows no surrender
item.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian accused US President Donald Trump of a "bullying mentality" at the United Nations on Wednesday, saying Iran would not surrender in the war with the US but remained open to diplomacy to end the conflict.
item.dc:creator: Parisa Hafezi, Michelle Nichols
item.content:encoded: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian accused US President Donald Trump of a "bullying mentality" at the United Nations on Wednesday, saying Iran would not surrender in the war with the US but remained open to diplomacy to end the conflict. In a wartime address to the 193-member UN General Assembly, Pezeshkian said threats would only harden Iran's resolve, rejecting Trump's warning that he could annihilate Iran if no deal were reached. "The remarks made by the US president yesterday ... are a sign of a bullying mentality. ... The Iranian people will not bow to pressure. ... Those who are terrorists and train terrorists call us terrorists," he said, referring to Trump's description of Iran as the world's leading sponsor of terrorism. Several times during his speech, Pezeshkian said Iran was ready to resolve tensions with the United States through negotiations, but warned that Tehran would not accept the language of force. The United States delegation walked out at the start of Pezeshkian's speech. The US mission to the United Nations did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Pezeshkian began his address by accusing the United States of killing civilians during the war, holding up photos that included an image of schoolgirls in a classroom. A missile strike on a primary school in Minab on February 28 – hours after US and Israeli attacks on Iran launched the conflict – killed more than 175 children and teachers, according to Iranian officials. The Pentagon has not publicly released the findings of its investigation into the Minab strike, the deadliest civilian-casualty incident involving the US military in decades. Reuters reported on March 5 that an initial internal US military investigation found US forces were likely responsible for the strike. Pezeshkian said Iran had no intention to seek nuclear bombs, but would not give up its right to a peaceful nuclear program. "Neither nuclear weapons nor giving up nuclear knowledge," he said. Seven months into a conflict that has rattled markets and pushed the Gulf to the brink of a wider war, Washington is unleashing an unprecedented economic offensive after military action failed to force Tehran to yield. Iranian leaders fear a worsening economy , marked by surging prices, weaker trade and pressure on household incomes, could reignite nationwide unrest that has repeatedly challenged the Islamic Republic. The Strait of Hormuz, conduit for a fifth of global oil and liquefied natural gas, has become a focus of tensions between Iran and the US. Tehran has conveyed its conditions to reopen the strategic waterway to the United States through mediators, Iranian sources told Reuters on Tuesday. "It cannot be the case that everyone benefits from the Strait of Hormuz while we are denied access to shipping through this waterway. The permanent deployment of hostile fleets and the expansion of the war will not lead to peace," Pezeshkian said.

item.title: ＢｏｆＡ、英中銀利上げ予想に転換 半年で2回実施の見方
item.description: [２３日 ロイター] - バンク・オブ・アメリカ（ＢｏｆＡ）・グローバル・リサーチは、イングランド銀行（英中銀）が今...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＢｏｆＡ、英中銀利上げ予想に転換　半年で2回実施の見方 9/23 23:38 配信

2026年9月16日、英国ロンドンのイングランド銀行の建物。 REUTERS/Corey Rudy

[２３日 ロイター] - バンク・オブ・アメリカ（ＢｏｆＡ）・グローバル・リサーチは、イングランド銀行（英中銀）が今後半年間で２回の利上げに踏み切るとの見方を示した。エネルギー価格の上昇でインフレが長期化するリスクが高まっていることを踏まえたもので、同様の予想を打ち出す他社に続いた。

同社は、英中銀が１１月と２月にそれぞれ０．２５％ポイントの利上げを実施すると予想。従来は金利据え置きが続いた後、２０２７年１１月に利下げに転じるとの見通しを示していたが、これを撤回した。

見通し変更の背景には、先週の英中銀会合で政策当局者が、特に足元の原油・天然ガス価格の急騰に起因するリスクについて、より強い調子で言及したことがある。これを受けバークレイズ、ＵＢＳグローバル・リサーチ、Ｊ．Ｐ．モルガンも利上げを予想している。

ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、市場は英中銀が１１月に利上げする確率を６７％織り込んでおり、１２月にもさらなる利上げが予想されている。

ただ、ＢｏｆＡは見通しを修正したものの、市場は引き締めを過大に織り込んでいる可能性があると指摘。英中銀が２０２８年に利下げを開始するまでに利上げは２回にとどまり、最終的に政策金利は３．５％に戻るとの見方を示した。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：債務膨張の先進国に金融危機の芽、最も懸念される米・伊・英 アングル：英新財務相、実務手腕に一定評価も支出拡大・増税不安消えず アングル：英国経済、ＥＵ離脱から10年の軌跡 アングル：ブレグジット10年、英ＥＵの溝なお深く　極右台頭も重し 焦点：ＥＵ離脱から10年、苦闘続く英輸出企業　非離脱シナリオより低成長の予測 最終更新: 9/23(水) 23:38 ロイター

Sept 23 : Alphabet-owned YouTube unveiled a slate of artificial intelligence tools, shopping updates and personalized viewer features on Wednesday at its annual Made on YouTube event in New York City. Here are some details: • The new creator tools include additions to YouTube Studio for feedback on video drafts, channel-matched thumbnails and testing up to three video cuts. • A Gemini-powered assistant in Shorts and YouTube Create will also help edit clips, trim pauses and sync music.

item.title: アポロのプライベートクレジット、解約5%に再び制限－3四半期連続
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米オルタナティブ資産運用会社アポロ・グローバル・マネジメントは、プライベートクレジット・ファンドからの資金引き出しを3四半期連続で制限している。同社の投資家も、1兆8000億ドル（約285兆円）規模のダイレクトレンディング市場から資金を引き揚げる動きに加わっているもようだ。

約260億ドルの資産を運用するファンド「アポロ・デット・ソリューションズ」は22日、発行済み株式の14.7%相当の払い戻し請求を受け、償還を同5%に再び制限すると投資家に通知した。株主向け書簡で明らかにした。前期も16.8%の償還要求があった。

ブラックロックやクリフウォーターなど同業他社も、自社のプライベートクレジット・ファンドからの資金引き出しを引き続き制限している。融資の質や従来型ソフトウエア企業へのエクスポージャーを巡る懸念から、投資家が資金を引き揚げようとする中、今年は過去最大規模の解約の動きがプライベートクレジット市場を揺るがしている。

アポロ・デット・ソリューションズは7－9月期、総資金流入が約2億ドルだった。投資家が現金で受け取らず、新たな株式の購入に充てた配当金も含まれる。一方、株式の買い戻しに7億ドルを支払ったため、純流出額は約5億ドルと、純資産価値（NAV）の3%に上る見込みだ。同ファンドは、2022年の運用開始以来、年率8.2%のリターンを上げているとしている。

アポロによると、償還請求の大半は、以前の請求が全額満たされなかった投資家による再請求だった。書簡では、今年償還を求めた投資家は、今回の払い戻しにより、請求した資金の約75%を回収することになると説明した。

同ファンドは、未処理の買い戻し請求への対応を引き続き進めるとしたうえで、十分な流動性確保の手段を有しており、「必要に応じてレバレッジを若干高める」ことも可能だとしている。また、「より良好な市場環境の下で、運用会社が行った選択が、運用成績に表れ始めている」とも強調した。

item.title: バーＦＲＢ理事、追加利上げ必要との見方 「インフレ目標達成にリスク」
item.description: [２３日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のバー理事は２３日、ＦＲＢが先週の米連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
バーＦＲＢ理事、追加利上げ必要との見方　「インフレ目標達成にリスク」 9/23 23:31 配信

2026年4月14日、バーFRB理事。REUTERS/Evan Vucci

[２３日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のバー理事は２３日、ＦＲＢが先週の米連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で利上げを決めたことについて、インフレ抑制に向けて金利を「再調整」する重要な一歩を踏み出したと評価した。その上で、さらなる利上げが必要になる公算が大きいと述べた。

バー理事はシカゴ連銀の住宅取得能力に関する会合で行う予定の講演原稿で「われわれのインフレ目標達成に対するリスクは高まった一方、労働市場のリスクは後退した」と指摘した。

さらに、米経済成長は力強く、労働市場は堅調だが、インフレはＦＲＢの目標である２％を上回る水準にとどまり、明確に低下する方向には向かっていないと述べた。「私のメインシナリオでは、インフレを適時に目標まで押し下げるため、追加の政策調整が必要になる公算が大きい」と語った。

バー理事は年内に少なくともあと２回の利上げが必要と考えている可能性がある。

バー理事は先週の利上げに言及し、「経済の変化を踏まえると、われわれは適切な位置になく、正しい方向に調整を行ったと思う。ＦＲＢは最大限の雇用を支える持続可能で息の長い成長を支援したいと考えており、物価の安定はそのために極めて重要だ」とした。

バー理事の金融政策に関する発言は短く、講演の大半は住宅取得能力問題に充てられた。住宅取得能力は供給不足と住宅ローン金利の高止まりで一段と悪化している。
