item.title: 米企業、インフレ見通しを引き上げ 金利上昇を懸念＝ＦＲＢのＣＦＯ調査
item.description:
Howard Schneider
[ワシントン ２３日 ロイター] - 米国の企業財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は、今年と来年の...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米企業、インフレ見通しを引き上げ　金利上昇を懸念＝ＦＲＢのＣＦＯ調査 9/23 23:18 配信

米ニューヨークで2025年11月撮影。REUTERS/Angelina Katsanis

Howard Schneider

[ワシントン　２３日　ロイター] - 米国の企業財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は、今年と来年のインフレ率が一段と高まると予想しており、金利上昇を最大の懸念材料の一つに挙げ始めている。連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が２３日公表した四半期調査から明らかになった。

財務幹部らは今年、価格を平均で５．３％引き上げる見通しを示した。第２・四半期時点の４．６％、年初時点の３．６％から上昇した。来年の価格引き上げ幅は平均４．５％と、第２・四半期時点の４．１％、年初の３．６％から上振れした。

最大の懸念事項としてインフレへの言及が少なくなった一方、「金融政策」に関する言及が最も多く、約２０％の企業が最大の懸念材料として挙げた。前回調査では１５％未満だった。

リッチモンド地区連銀のワデル副総裁は、財務幹部の景気全般に対する楽観的な見方は依然として強いものの、資金調達を巡る懸念が中小企業の見通しに影を落とし始めているとの見方を示唆。「課題がある場合、それは中小企業や資金繰りに制約のある企業で最も顕著だ」と述べた。

中小企業の約５分の１が、事業拡大計画の妨げになったり、コスト吸収を困難にしたりしていると回答した。企業全体では、今後６カ月間の設備投資は、半年前の見通しに比べ減少すると予想している。

設備投資を計画していない企業のうち、約４２％がその理由として「資金調達環境の悪化」や「現金確保の必要性」を挙げており、６カ月前の３２％から上昇した。

調査は８月１７日から９月４日にかけ、約５００社を対象にアトランタ地区連銀とリッチモンド地区連銀がデューク大学フクア経営大学院と共同で実施。これはＦＲＢによる先週の利上げ決定前、ＦＲＢの政策論議が利上げの可能性に傾き、投資家が借り入れコストの上昇に備え始めていた時期に当たる。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：米景気拡大維持、ＦＲＢの利下げペース次第 アングル：出遅れ気味の米不動産株、持ち直し期待高まる 焦点：後退する米企業役員の多様性、トランプ米大統領の政策反映 コラム：「米国例外主義」なお健在、外国投資家のテック株流入持続が示唆 アングル：米株、下半期の上昇基調維持に多くの試練　ＡＩ投資から金融政策まで 最終更新: 9/23(水) 23:22 ロイター

item.title: イラン、米協力国の空港機能停止を示唆 航空制裁巡り報復を警告
item.description:
(表記を一部修正して再送します。)
[ドバイ ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
(表記を一部修正して再送します。)

[ドバイ ２３日 ロイター] - イラン国家安全保障最高評議会のモフセン・レザイ書記は２３日、国営テレビとのインタビューで、周辺国が米国に協力してイラン便の運航を停止させれば、イランはそれらの国の空港が機能しないようにすると述べた。

ベセント米財務長官は２１日、航空サービス提供業者に対する二次制裁を発動すると警告し、これによりイランの全航空会社が９月２３日に運航停止を余儀なくされるとの見通しを示していた。

レザイ氏はまた、イランの条件が満たされない限り、ホルムズ海峡は再開されず、交渉も行われないと述べた。

item.title: 米総合PMI、9月速報値は21年以来の高水準－新規受注や雇用が増加
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 9月の米企業活動は過去5年余りで最も速いペースで拡大した。堅調な需要を背景に、製造業とサービス業で新規受注や雇用が増加した。

雇用は4年余りで最も速いペースで増加した一方、投入価格の伸びは2022年以来の高水準となった。回答企業は主に燃料費や輸送費の上昇を要因に挙げ、多くの企業が賃金の伸び加速も指摘した。

S&Pグローバル・マーケット・インテリジェンスのチーフ・ビジネス・エコノミスト、クリス・ウィリアムソン氏は発表文で、「製造業、サービス業ともに企業活動は明らかに活況を呈している」と指摘。「ただ、こうした成長に伴い、新型コロナウイルスのパンデミック（世界的大流行）期を除けば約20年に及ぶ調査の歴史でも特に深刻な部類に入るサプライチェーンの目詰まりが生じている。企業からは適切な人材の確保が一段と難しくなっているとの報告も増えている」と述べた。

サービス業の企業活動指数は58.7へ上昇し、2021年以来の高水準となった。雇用指数は2022年6月以来の高水準だった。

製造業の指数は57に上昇し、2022年以来の高水準。需要の指標となる新規受注は2022年4月以来の速いペースで拡大し、雇用の伸びも2021年2月以来の高水準となった。

一方、サプライヤーの納期は2022年半ば以来最も長期化し、原材料コストも高止まりしており、サプライチェーンへの圧力が続いていることを示した。

今年の米企業活動は、堅調な個人消費やAIを背景とした企業投資、国防支出に支えられている。S&Pグローバルの最新データは、イランとの戦争に伴うエネルギーコストの上昇やサプライチェーンの混乱にもかかわらず、力強い需要が企業活動を支えている状況を示している。

ウィリアムソン氏は、パンデミック後の経済再開局面を除けば、9月の企業活動の改善は「2015年初め以降で最大だ」と述べた。

原題：US Business Activity Expands at the Fastest Pace Since 2021 (1)（抜粋）

item.title: Inflation pressures raise prospect of Fed rate hike on eve of elections
item.description: Mounting inflation pressures and a strengthening economy look to be pushing the Federal Reserve towards an interest-rate hike on the eve of critical national elections, with traders on Wednesday piling into bets on a second straight policy tightening in late October.
item.dc:creator: Ann Saphir, Howard Schneider
item.content:encoded: Mounting inflation pressures and a strengthening economy look to be pushing the Federal Reserve towards an interest-rate hike on the eve of critical national elections, with traders on Wednesday piling into bets on a second straight policy tightening in late October. A closely watched measure of US business activity, S&P Global's flash US Composite PMI Output Index, jumped this month to its highest level since July 2021, S&P Global reported on Wednesday. The survey's measure of prices paid by businesses for inputs surged to a nearly four-year high. Oil prices took a leg up on Wednesday, with Brent crude futures rising about 2% to $101.09 a barrel, and diesel fuel is fetching over $6.50 a gallon on average, as the [USN:L1N45F09P TEXT:"US-Iran war"] continues to disrupt supply with little prospect for near-term resolution. Diesel has particular potential to broaden price pressures, as it powers the equipment and trucks used to make and move goods throughout the economy. The backdrop of rising inflationary risks and a strong economy means the Fed is likely to deliver more rate hikes, Fed Governor Michael Barr said on Wednesday in what's become a rare bit of "forward guidance" from a US central banker. "Risks to achieving our inflation target have increased, while risks to the labor market have receded," Barr told a Chicago Fed housing affordability conference. "In my base case, further policy adjustments are likely to be needed to ensure inflation comes down to target in a timely fashion." In a unanimous decision last week, policymakers raised the central bank's key rate to the [USN:L6N4570XW TEXT:"3.75%-4.00% range"], and 16 of 18 of them signaled the Fed would probably need to deliver at least one more rate hike before the end of this year. Chairman Kevin Warsh said the Fed was removing "a dose of accommodation" but declined to say if he felt more would be needed. Barr's remarks Wednesday suggest he feels at least two more rate hikes will be required, though he did not say by when. "In my view, given changes to the economy, we were out of position, and we made an adjustment in the right direction," Barr said, referring to the quarter-percentage-point hike last week. "We want to support sustainable, durable growth in support of maximum employment, and price stability is crucial to that." US Treasury yields jumped after Wednesday's data, with the benchmark 10-year yield rising back above 5% to its highest level since 2007. Unusually weak demand for 5-year Treasury notes at Wednesday's auction also helped send 5-year note yields to their own 19-year high. Short-term US interest-rate futures contracts were pricing about a 70% chance of another rate hike at the October 27-28 meeting, up from about 55% earlier in the day. Days after that October Fed decision, President Donald Trump's Republicans will be defending slim majorities in both houses of Congress in national elections set for November 3. Back-to-back rate hikes could underscore the affordability concerns that polls show are a top issue for voters and are undercutting Trump's popularity. Analysts say the inflation the Fed is addressing stems in large part from the administration's policy decisions, including sharply higher tariffs and the war in Iran. Affordability concerns for would-be homeowners are also in focus. The Mortgage Bankers Association reported Wednesday that the average rate on a US 30-year fixed-rate mortgage rose to a more than two-year high of [USN:L6N45E14E TEXT:"7.12%"] last week. Trump has laid into the Fed -- though not Warsh personally -- for what he calls a "political" decision to raise, [USN:L6N45915R TEXT:"not cut"], rates. He has sought to address inflation concerns with proposals including ending the war in Iran after the elections, and banning exports of US diesel. In an interview released Wednesday, Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee said the central bank may need to treat the current energy shock as a source of persistent inflation rather than expect it to dissipate on its own, an approach that implies he also feels more rate hikes could be needed. "For big negative supply shocks ... you'd be better off just assuming from the beginning that this thing is going to be pretty persistent on inflation: that's certainly what happened in Covid; that's what happened with the tariffs. That's maybe what's happening with oil," Goolsbee said in a "Economics, Applied" podcast. "So we better be careful."

item.title: 原油反発、ブレントは100ドル台－ディーゼル燃料の急騰が影響
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： ニューヨーク原油相場は反発。中東からの原油輸送が回復するとの見方が広がる一方で、トレーダーは燃料価格の急騰を意識している。

国際指標の北海ブレント原油先物は1バレル当たり100ドル台を回復した。前日までは5営業日続落していた。トランプ米大統領が前日、ディーゼル燃料の輸出禁止案に前向きな姿勢を示したため、この日は欧州のディーゼル先物が急騰した。これが原油価格の上昇に弾みを付けていると、サクソバンクの商品戦略責任者、オーレ・ハンセン氏は指摘した。

ディーゼル市場では中東とロシアからの供給が急減し、米国が主要な供給国となっている。原油市場では米国からの輸出が停止される懸念が、サウジアラビアの原油輸出が回復するとの楽観を相殺した。

サウジは26日までに東西パイプラインの再稼働を目指すとしている。同国はペルシャ湾岸からの輸出についても、高いペースを維持しているもようだ。

それでもホルムズ海峡を巡るリスクは続いている。英国海運貿易オペレーション（UKMTO）によれば、同海峡を航行中に飛翔体の攻撃を受けた貨物船で火災が発生し、漂流している。

トランプ米大統領は前日、米・イラン代表が3時間にわたって協議したと明らかにし、「非常にうまくいった」と成果を強調したが、市場の反応は冷ややかだったと、サクソバンクのハンセン氏は指摘した。「解決につながる具体的な行動が双方から求められている」と同氏は述べた。

キャピタル・エコノミクスのエコノミスト、ハマド・フセイン氏によれば、ディーゼル燃料の輸出が禁止されれば、米国内のディーゼル価格はいったんは下落する可能性があるものの、国内で石油を輸送する能力に制約があるため、いずれ在庫が積み上がり、製油業者は生産削減を余儀なくされる。

ニューヨーク時間午前10時現在、北海ブレント11月限は前日比2.2%高の101.41ドル。ウェスト・テキサス・インターミディエート（WTI）11月限は同2.7%高い91.97ドル。

item.title: 米ロ外相がＮＹで会談、ウクライナや中東巡り協議＝ロ外務省
item.description: [モスクワ ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[モスクワ　２３日　ロイター] - ロシア外務省は２３日、ラブロフ外相とルビオ米国務長官が国連総会が開かれているニューヨークで会談し、２国間および国際的な議題について幅広く協議したと発表した。

同省によると、両氏はウクライナや中東を含む複数の地域情勢について協議した。ラブロフ氏は２国間関係を可能な限り早期に修復する必要性を強調した。双方は協議を継続することで一致した。

ロシア外務省のザハロワ情報局長は２３日、両氏が握手を交わす様子を写した写真をオンラインで公開した。

item.title: 1 Irán y EEUU siguen lejos en conversaciones de paz, dice funcionario iraní; Pezeshkian promete no rendirse
item.description: Irán y Estados Unidos siguen manteniendo posturas muy distantes sobre cómo poner fin a su guerra, pero la diplomacia debe continuar, dijo el miércoles a Reuters un alto funcionario de Teherán, después de que el presidente iraní afirmara ante la Asamblea General de la ONU que su país nunca se rendiría ante la presión estadounidense.
item.dc:creator: Parisa Hafezi, Humeyra Pamuk, Jana Choukeir
item.content:encoded: Irán y Estados Unidos siguen manteniendo posturas muy distantes sobre cómo poner fin a su guerra, pero la diplomacia debe continuar, dijo el miércoles a Reuters un alto funcionario de Teherán, después de que el presidente iraní afirmara ante la Asamblea General de la ONU que su país nunca se rendiría ante la presión estadounidense. El presidente iraní, Masoud Pezeshkian, condenó en su discurso en Nueva York lo que calificó de "señales de una mentalidad de intimidación" por parte del mandatario estadounidense, Donald Trump, quien había utilizado el mismo foro el martes para amenazar con "aniquilar" a Irán. Estos discursos contrapuestos en la reunión anual de la ONU marcaron el inicio y el final de las primeras conversaciones mediadas entre Estados Unidos e Irán en meses, aunque no parecieron arrojar concesiones en las posturas públicas de ninguna de las partes respecto al fin de la guerra. El alto funcionario iraní, que habló bajo condición de anonimato, señaló que Teherán estaba revisando la respuesta de Washington a sus propuestas de paz, las cuales priorizan el levantamiento del bloqueo naval estadounidense a los puertos iraníes y la reapertura del estrecho de Ormuz. "Todavía existen muchas diferencias entre las posturas de Irán y Estados Unidos, pero la diplomacia continúa", afirmó el funcionario. El secretario de Estado estadounidense, Marco Rubio, declaró el miércoles a la prensa que alcanzar un acuerdo con Irán requeriría un arduo trabajo a lo largo del tiempo, y añadió que Trump también disponía de opciones militares. Estados Unidos también ha anunciado que impondrá las llamadas sanciones secundarias a cualquier país que permita vuelos iraníes a partir del miércoles. Mohsen Rezaei, secretario del Consejo Supremo de Seguridad Nacional de Irán, declaró a la televisión estatal que Irán se aseguraría de que los aeropuertos de los países vecinos no pudieran operar si impedían los vuelos iraníes. IRÁN "NO CEDERÁ ANTE LA PRESIÓN", DICE EL PRESIDENTE En su discurso ante la Asamblea General de 193 miembros, Pezeshkian se centró en el bloqueo estadounidense de los puertos iraníes y del estrecho de Ormuz, vía fluvial por donde transitaba una quinta parte del petróleo y el gas natural licuado a nivel mundial antes de la guerra. "No puede ser que todos se beneficien del estrecho de Ormuz mientras a nosotros se nos niega el acceso al transporte marítimo a través de esta vía. El despliegue permanente de flotas hostiles y la escalada de la guerra no conducirán a la paz", afirmó. "El pueblo iraní no cederá a la presión", añadió. Irán pretende ejercer control sobre el estrecho y cobrar tasas a los buques que lo transitan. Washington rechaza esta pretensión y afirma que el estrecho debe permanecer completamente abierto al transporte marítimo internacional. El martes, Trump afirmó haber impedido que Teherán obtuviera un arma nuclear y advirtió que podría "aniquilar a la República Islámica" si no se llega a un acuerdo para poner fin al conflicto. El miércoles, Pezeshkian reiteró la postura de Irán de que no busca armas nucleares. El ministro de Asuntos Exteriores iraní, Abbas Araqchi, y los enviados estadounidenses Steve Witkoff y Jared Kushner se comunicaron a través de mediadores al margen de la Asamblea General de la ONU, en lo que supone los primeros contactos de este tipo desde que se rompió el acuerdo de alto el fuego provisional en julio. El portavoz del Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores iraní, Esmail Baghaei, dijo que Teherán había entablado conversaciones con Estados Unidos a través de un mediador qatarí en Nueva York y había transmitido una serie de condiciones, entre ellas el fin de la guerra en todos los frentes, el cese de los "actos de agresión" estadounidenses y la liberación de los activos iraníes congelados. IRANÍES DE LÍNEA DURA SE OPONEN A INICIATIVAS DIPLOMÁTICAS El contacto diplomático en Nueva York provocó reacciones negativas en los medios de comunicación iraníes vinculados a los sectores de línea dura. Un artículo de opinión publicado por la agencia de noticias semioficial Tasnim, vinculada a la Guardia Revolucionaria, dice que Araqchi se equivocó al mantener contactos con Witkoff y Kushner, lo que constituía "un gran regalo para Trump", ya que Irán ya había transmitido sus condiciones. Fuentes iraníes comunicaron a Reuters que el Consejo Supremo de Seguridad Nacional —un órgano que incluye a figuras seleccionadas por el ayatolá Mojtaba Jamenei, el líder supremo, quien aún no ha aparecido en público desde que sustituyó a su padre, asesinado el primer día de la guerra— había ordenado a la delegación que no se reuniera cara a cara con los estadounidenses. Un periodista iraní que cubría la visita dijo a Reuters que algunos partidarios de la línea dura consideraban que el mero hecho de viajar a Nueva York constituía un insulto a la memoria del líder asesinado, Ali Jamenei. La guerra, iniciada por Trump en febrero junto con Israel bajo el nombre de "Operación Furia Épica", lleva ya casi siete meses, ha causado la muerte de miles de personas, ha alterado el suministro energético mundial y se ha extendido a otros países de la región —en particular al Líbano y, más recientemente, a Yemen—. En el último ataque del que se ha tenido noticia en el estrecho, la agencia británica de seguridad marítima UKMTO informó de que un buque de carga había sido alcanzado por proyectiles, lo que provocó dos víctimas entre la tripulación. Los tripulantes fueron evacuados y el buque se incendió y estaba a la deriva. A pesar de los ataques casi diarios, el tráfico por el estrecho se ha intensificado en las últimas semanas. Los productores de petróleo pagan a las compañías navieras tasas de hasta una cuarta parte del valor de la carga para asumir el riesgo de navegar por el estrecho con los transpondedores apagados, antes de transferir el crudo a otros buques al otro lado. Las exportaciones de los Emiratos Árabes Unidos ya se han recuperado hasta alcanzar los niveles anteriores a la guerra, y Arabia Saudita ha vendido 60 millones de barriles de petróleo del Golfo tanto para este mes como para el próximo, que se entregarán más allá del estrecho, frente a las costas de Omán. No obstante, se estima que falta un tercio del petróleo del Golfo en los suministros mundiales. La escasez ha afectado especialmente a los productos refinados, como el diésel, lo que ha provocado inflación, ha hecho subir las tasas de interés y ha perjudicado a los republicanos de Trump de cara a las elecciones.

item.title: US business activity at more than five-year high; inflation pressures building
item.description: US business activity raced to a more than five-year high in September, fueled by a surge in new orders, though strong demand strained supply chains and pushed prices higher.
item.dc:creator: Lucia Mutikani
item.content:encoded: US business activity raced to a more than five-year high in September, fueled by a surge in new orders, though strong demand strained supply chains and pushed prices higher. S&P Global said on Wednesday its flash US Composite PMI Output Index, which tracks the manufacturing and services sectors, increased to 58.4 this month. That was the highest level since July 2021 and followed a reading of 56.0 in August. A reading above 50 indicates expansion in the private sector. The rise in the PMI reflected strong gains in both the services and manufacturing sectors. The PMI was consistent with the economy growing at around a 5% annualized rate, S&P Global said. It also noted a sharp rise in work backlogs and supply chain delays, "pointing to a lack of operating capacity which fed through to higher prices." The Atlanta Federal Reserve's gross domestic product tracking estimate is running at a 5.1% rate. The economy grew at a 1.5% pace in the April-June quarter. "Business is clearly booming now in both manufacturing and services," said Chris Williamson, chief business economist at S&P Global Market Intelligence. "However, this growth is being accompanied by some of the most severe supply chain bottlenecks seen in the near-two-decade survey history if the pandemic is excluded." The supply constraints mostly stem from the US-Israeli war with Iran, now in its seventh month. STRONG DEMAND ADDING TO INFLATION Chicago Fed President [USN:L6N45C08M TEXT:"Austan "][USN:L6N45D0L7 TEXT:"Goolsbee"] said on Monday supply shocks were proving more persistent, adding there was evidence that strong demand was now adding to the problem. That view was supported by the findings of the S&P Global survey. The survey's measure of new orders received by businesses raced to 58.2, the highest reading since March 2022, from 55.2 in August. The increase was across both services and manufacturing industries. Incomplete orders, a key indicator of capacity utilization and future business growth, increased to the highest level since May 2022. Though companies across manufacturing and services sectors boosted hiring to tackle the order backlog, S&P Global also noted increasing reports of problems finding suitable staff. "While this accumulation of uncompleted orders bodes well for the further expansion of output and capacity in the coming months, it also indicates that companies are developing more pricing power, and hence is a worry for the inflation outlook," said Williamson. The survey's gauge of prices paid by businesses for inputs jumped to 66.4, the highest reading since October 2022, from 59.9 in August. Both services and manufacturing businesses reported higher input prices. S&P Global noted that high raw materials prices in manufacturing were also often linked to supply shortages. It said suppliers' delivery times lengthened considerably on average, "with the incidence of supply chain delays the most widespread since July 2022." A measure of prices paid increased, with the sharpest gain in the services sector. Further gains are likely as [USN:L6N4580TA TEXT:"record high"] diesel prices will, among other things, boost the cost of transporting goods. The Federal Reserve last week raised its [USN:L6N4570XW TEXT:"benchmark overnight"] interest rate by 25 basis points to the 3.75%-4.00% range and flagged more hikes in the coming months.

item.description: WASHINGTON, Sept 23 : The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration said Wednesday it is investigating startup Comma.ai after reports of five crashes of vehicles using its aftermarket driver-assistance devices involving three reported deaths and 11 serious injuries. NHTSA said vehicles with Comma device

WASHINGTON, Sept 23 : The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration said Wednesday it is investigating startup Comma.ai after reports of five crashes of vehicles using its aftermarket driver-assistance devices involving three reported deaths and 11 serious injuries.  NHTSA said vehicles with Comma devices reportedly struck five stopped or slow-moving vehicles. Comma.ai says the devices that use open source software can allow for hands-free driving and reports more than 30,000 vehicles have logged 402 million miles with the devices. The system "can accelerate, brake automatically for other vehicles, and steer to follow the road/lane," Comma.ai says. The company could not immediately be reached for comment but says on its website that it requires "the driver to be alert, pay attention, and be ready to take over at all times."

NHTSA said it will review any other incidents involving the Comma.ai devices and obtain data to verify system status for each incident and evaluate system performance and safeguards. In 2016, NHTSA demanded that Comma.ai provide proof to regulators that its proposed device for self-driving cars would be safe, or risk having its sale blocked. The company at the time said in response it was redirecting its efforts to "other products and markets." The California Department of Motor Vehicles had also in 2016 sent Comma.ai a cease-and-desist letter. NHTSA and the National Transportation Safety Board have repeatedly investigated serious crashes involving failures of vehicles with advanced driver assistance systems to identify stopped or slow vehicles on highways. In March, the NTSB criticized Ford Motor's hands-free advanced driver assistance system BlueCruise for failing to ensure drivers were not distracted before they were involved in two fatal collisions. The Ford SUVs struck stationary vehicles at highway speeds in San Antonio and Philadelphia, killing three people in total, and there was no attempt to brake by either Ford driver. In 2023, Tesla recalled over 2 million vehicles in the US to better ensure drivers pay attention when using its Autopilot driver assistance system after NHTSA opened a probe after identifying more than a dozen crashes in which Tesla vehicles hit stationary emergency vehicles.

Source: Reuters

item.title: ＥＣＢ、エネルギー高波及なら追加利上げも＝アイルランド中銀総裁
item.description: [ダブリン ２３日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのマクルーフ・アイルランド中銀総裁は２３日、...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＥＣＢ、エネルギー高波及なら追加利上げも＝アイルランド中銀総裁 9/23 22:41 配信

欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのマクルーフ・アイルランド中銀総裁。米ワシントンで4月撮影。REUTERS/Elizabeth Frantz

[ダブリン ２３日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのマクルーフ・アイルランド中銀総裁は２３日、エネルギー価格の高騰が他の分野に波及すれば、ＥＣＢは再び利上げを迫られるとの見方を示した。ただ現時点では、こうした「２次的な」インフレ効果の兆候は見られないとの認識を示した。

同総裁は公共放送ＲＴＥとのインタビューで、「インフレ率は目標を上回っているが、価格に波及し始めるような２次的効果は見られない」と指摘。「もしそのような（エネルギー価格が高止まりし、他の分野に波及する）事態になれば、目標を達成するために再び行動を起こさなければならない」と述べた。

マクルーフ氏は今月、ＥＣＢが年内２回目となる利上げを決定した後、「大幅な」追加利上げは経済成長に打撃を与える恐れもあるとの見方を示していた。

item.title: BHP Escondida mine supervisors' union urges rejection of contract offer, strike looms
item.description: Unionized supervisors at BHP's Escondida copper mine in Chile will urge members to reject the company's latest contract offer, paving the way for a strike at the world's largest copper mine, the union reported.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Unionized supervisors at BHP's Escondida copper mine in Chile will urge members to reject the company's latest contract offer, paving the way for a strike at the world's largest copper mine, the union reported. • BHP presented the offer at the end of Tuesday's session in the formal negotiation process, which will be voted on by union members on September 28-30. • The union board unanimously rejected the latest offer claiming it "lacks essential elements," according to union leader Alexis Barrera. • He called on union members to vote for a strike. • If members vote to reject the offer, a mandatory five-day government mediation follows before a legal strike can begin, with the period extendable by five more days by mutual agreement. • Workers have objected to provisions including task-based work requirements and a possible 14-14 day work/rest shift rotation during contingencies. • Escondida said the offer "contains improvements and new benefits over the current collective agreement, which is already a leading instrument in the industry for the supervisors and staff segment." • The new contract comes amid lower production levels, cost pressures and an investment plan to maintain future productive capacity, according to the company.

(Corrects to say Blockchain.com is a brokerage not an exchange, in first paragraph and third bullet point) By Elizabeth Howcroft Sept 23 : The New York Stock Exchange and crypto brokerage Blockchain.com will together explore creating crypto versions of US-listed stocks, Blockchain.com said in a press release on Wednesday. The partnership is the latest example of a mainstream stock exchange looking to cash in on tokenisation, which is the idea of creating blockchain-based tokens which represent or are pegged to assets such as stocks and bonds.

• Blockchain.com and NYSE announced a "strategic collaboration" to explore selling tokens representing NYSE-listed stocks and ETFs on blockchain, the technology behind cryptocurrencies. • The companies have not yet announced which countries the products will be sold in. • The companies also signed a data agreement, with NYSE's parent company Intercontinental Exchange distributing Blockchain.com's crypto market data and analytics, while the crypto brokerage will use NYSE data in its app. • "It’s a bet by both parties on where capital markets are heading," Blockchain.com said. • Blockchain-based stock tokens rarely offer buyers the same rights as traditional equities, and the buyer typically does not become a shareholder in the underlying company, raising concerns about investor protection. • Proponents say they enable more people to buy stocks and trade them outside of standard market hours. • Blockchain.com, based in London and Dallas, has already started selling tokenised stocks to customers in Europe, but a spokesperson for the company declined to comment on how many customers had bought them. • The US Securities and Exchange Commission unveiled an exemption that will allow platforms to sell blockchain-based versions of stocks and other securities, without having to follow many of the rules that apply to stock exchanges.

item.title: Cenário de incerteza demanda movimentos suaves e previsíveis na política monetária, diz David, do BC
item.description: O diretor de Política Monetária do Banco Central, Nilton David, disse nesta quarta-feira que, em momentos de incerteza como o que a economia vive hoje, a política monetária deve atuar com previsibilidade e adotar movimentos suaves e cautelosos, minimizando solavancos.
item.dc:creator: Bernardo Caram
item.content:encoded: O diretor de Política Monetária do Banco Central, Nilton David, disse nesta quarta-feira que, em momentos de incerteza como o que a economia vive hoje, a política monetária deve atuar com previsibilidade e adotar movimentos suaves e cautelosos, minimizando solavancos. Em evento do banco J.Safra, David destacou que o BC está promovendo um ciclo de "calibração", e não de flexibilização monetária, o que classificou como um "ajuste fino", acrescentando que os juros seguirão em patamar contracionista ao fim desse processo. “A prescrição para quando você tem um ambiente desses é fazer movimentos suaves e previsíveis. É como se estivesse dirigindo numa estrada com neve e neblina, você tem que diminuir a velocidade, manter movimentos bastante cirúrgicos”, afirmou, citando apresentação feita em maio pelo diretor de Assuntos Internacionais do BC, Paulo Picchetti. “A prescrição é sempre fazer uma política monetária de forma mais suave, cautelosa e bastante atenta, minimizando solavancos”, acrescentou. O Comitê de Política Monetária (Copom) [USN:L1N45810C TEXT:"cortou"] na semana passada a taxa básica de juros em 0,25 ponto percentual pela quinta vez consecutiva, a 13,75% ao ano, e deixou os próximos passos em aberto ao afirmar que o cenário de incerteza demanda cautela. Na apresentação desta quarta, a primeira após o fim do período de silêncio dos diretores da autarquia após a reunião, David disse que a política monetária tem surtido efeito e apontou sinais de arrefecimento da inflação, inclusive em itens mais cíclicos, que tendem a responder mais diretamente aos juros. O diretor acrescentou que também parece haver uma desaceleração no ritmo de crescimento dos salários de trabalhadores, ainda que em níveis acima da inflação e da produtividade do país. Ele ressaltou que o BC não trabalha com um alvo para o crescimento da atividade, e sim uma meta de inflação, mas ponderou que é preciso levar o Produto Interno Bruto para patamar próximo ao seu potencial para que não haja pressão inflacionária. David afirmou que o fenômeno El Niño e a guerra no Oriente Médio aumentaram a incerteza e demandam uma política monetária cuidadosa e cautelosa. Em relação ao conflito militar, ele afirmou que a cotação do petróleo parece estar se consolidando em patamar mais elevado, sendo esperado um movimento mais lento de recuo dos preços se houver uma solução da guerra. O diretor disse ser difícil neste momento saber se o choque de oferta deixará resquícios na inflação. Por isso, segundo ele, o BC mantém a "guarda alta" na condução dos juros. "O que as melhores práticas de política monetária dizem é: alguma tolerância nos efeitos diretos de primeira ordem e nenhuma tolerância com os efeitos de segunda ordem. O objetivo do BC é não permitir que uma perturbação de inflação por um choque de oferta se transforme em inflação perene", afirmou.

Sept 23 : Private investment in space companies globally more than doubled to $23 billion in the year through June as the sector shifts toward proven businesses, according to British investment firm Seraphim and Relm Insurance on Wednesday. SpaceX's June IPO has reshaped the funding landscape for the sector, drawing in new investors as venture firms look for the next space company capable of a similar payoff. Investors are funneling capital toward companies that can show operational proof rather than early-stage promise, with the space economy moving from "hype to commercial reality", according to Relm Insurance. It said the companies attracting capital include Earth observation (EO), in-orbit manufacturing and satellite supply chains.

"EO is already an established category — the tech is well established, if still improving," said Andrew Bonwick, Relm's VP of Product Development. "The real value is in the analytics. Customers buying these services don't think of them as space services — they're sold on what they actually want: where are my ships, when should I plant my crops, is that refinery switched on, where's at risk of wildfire." Capital grew more selective toward Earth observation companies with visible revenue and experienced leadership, the report said. In-orbit manufacturing is still in its early days, held back by limited ways to launch and bring products back to Earth, with some companies merging while others struggle to grow beyond small pilot projects. Satellite supply chains have grown more complicated as production increases, pushing companies to bring more of their manufacturing in-house to control costs and reduce reliance on outside suppliers. Traditional insurance policies often don't fit these smaller, experimental space projects, creating demand for new types of coverage, the report said.

Source: Reuters

item.title: エチオピア北部で戦闘再燃、反政府勢力が空港掌握
item.description: ［２３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２３日　ロイター］ - アフリカのエチオピア北部ティグレ州の指導部は２３日、連邦政府との新たな戦争に入ったと表明した。ティグレ州と隣接するアファール州、アムハラ州で戦闘が発生し、４年前に結ばれた和平合意は崩壊した。

アビー首相の顧問は、反政府勢力のティグレ人民解放戦線（ＴＰＬＦ）がティグレ州内で連邦政府の管理下にあった空港を掌握し、隣接するアファール州とアムハラ州の政府軍拠点に対して「全面攻勢」を開始したとＸに投稿。エチオピア航空はティグレ州向けの運航を停止した。

エチオピアでは、２０２０─２２年にＴＰＬＦと連邦政府軍の間で内戦が起き、数十万人が死亡した。２２年１１月にプレトリア合意が締結されたが、数カ月前から対立が強まり、ＴＰＬＦは２１日、アビー政権打倒を目指し、エチオピア各地の武装組織６団体と同盟を結成したと発表していた。

ＴＰＬＦ主導のティグレ州政府は声明で「アビー・アハメドの独裁的かつジェノサイド的な政権が、ティグレの人々に対してさまざまな手段による侵攻を激化させたことを受け、ティグレ州政府はティグレ軍に反撃を指示し、防衛戦争に入ったと発表した」と述べた。

item.title: 米企業業績、アナリストの見通しが弱気に－インフレと金利上昇懸念
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米企業の業績見通しを巡り、株式アナリストは数カ月ぶりに全体として弱気に転じた。インフレと金利上昇が利益に及ぼす影響への懸念が背景にある。

シティグループの指数によると、利益予想を引き下げたアナリストの数が23週間ぶりに、引き上げたアナリストを上回った。2021年9月以来最長となっていた上方修正優勢の流れが途切れた。

BNPパリバ・ウェルス・マネジメント・ドイツのシュテファン・ケンパー最高投資責任者（CIO）は「弱さの主な要因は、生活必需品と一般消費財の両方を含む消費関連、素材、金融だ。生活費の上昇とエネルギー価格の上昇が重なったことに直接関係しているとみられる」と分析した。

ウォール街のアナリストは、米企業の利益が今年大幅に伸びるとの見方におおむね自信を示しているものの、一部は目先の株式市場の見通しに懸念を示している。

モルガン・スタンレーのストラテジスト、マイケル・ウィルソン氏は今週、株式のバリュエーションがさらに低下し続け、エネルギー価格の一段の上昇によって金融政策が引き締められれば、S&P500種株価指数が最大7%下落するリスクがあると警告した。

経済協力開発機構（OECD）は23日のリポートで、2027年の世界のインフレ率は予想を上回るペースとなり、金融政策のさらなる引き締めが必要になるとの見通しを示した。米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）は物価上昇圧力に対応するため、今月、3年ぶりに政策金利を引き上げた。

原題：Analysts Snap Longest Run of US Earnings Upgrades in Five Years（抜粋）

item.title: トルコ、ファンド不正渦中の投資会社会長ら逮捕－元外務省高官も
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 巨額の投資家資金を消失させた株式ファンドの破綻を捜査しているトルコ当局は、渦中にある証券会社の創業者を逮捕した。

トルコのNTVが報じたところによると、同国投資会社テラ・ヤティリム・メンクル・デエルエルのエムレ・テズメン会長および同社取締役会メンバーのケレム・アルキン、エムレ・アルキン両氏、別の企業幹部1人を当局が23日朝方にそれぞれ逮捕した。テズメン氏は19日から身柄を拘束されていた。

ケレム・アルキン氏はトルコ外務省を昨年退職したばかりで、2021－24年にはトルコの経済協力開発機構（OECD）常駐代表を務めた。同氏の弟であるエムレ氏は著名なエコノミストで、全国放送のテレビ局に定期的に出演するなどコメンテーターとしても活動していた。

NTVによると、テラと並び混乱の震源地となっているプスラ・フィナンス・ホールディングのセルダル・トゥルハン会長も同じ捜査の一環で逮捕された。

当局はこれまでに複数の金融会社の幹部に関連する資産を凍結し、その幹部の一部およびその配偶者、近親者について、資産を減らすような取引に制限を課したと、国営アナドル通信は報道。資産の国外移転の有無を見極めるため、2024年以降の国外送金と暗号資産に関するデータも要請したという。

問題のファンドは浮動株が少なく株価をつり上げやすい銘柄に集中投資して好パフォーマンスであるかのように見せかけ、数十万人に上る個人投資家の資金を引きつけていた。だが、投資先の銘柄は流動性に乏しいため、集中的な解約請求に応じられず行き詰まった。

このファンドの取引を検証した金融専門家によると、保有株を担保に短期資金を借り入れ、同じ銘柄に再び投資しているケースもあった。トルコの法相はこの手法を「ねずみ講詐欺のようなもの」と断じた。

23日の取引では、トルコ株の代表的な指標であるイスタンブール100指数は一時1%上昇。より幅広い全株指数はほぼ横ばいで推移しているが、テラを含む40以上の銘柄は依然として値幅制限いっぱいの10%安に沈んでいる。

FAST

BRUSSELS, Sept 23 : Greece has proposed that European Union states should create a European Spectrum Union which could use some of the funds raised by future national sales of 6G mobile spectrum for technology investment, easing pressure on the bloc's budget. "The potential initial financial scale could be around €12–15 billion," according to the proposal, developed by the chairman of euro zone finance ministers Kyriakos Pierrakakis and presented to EU ministers on Tuesday. "At this stage, this is a planning assumption rather than an official valuation or forecast, and does not include any potential future contribution from selected 5G rights," it said. If the idea is accepted by the 27 countries making up the EU, the money could help ease the problem of how to finance the EU's 2028-2034 budget, proposed at €2 trillion - the main source of financing for all of the EU's main policies.

Negotiations on the financing are tough, because the budget will have to deal with new challenges like more spending on defence and making Europe more competitive, while retaining most of the spending on old policies to support farming and cohesion. Among other new financing options, rejected by some countries and supported by others, is using a share of the cash that EU governments get from selling CO2 emissions permits to companies and a share of the tax on goods imported into the EU that were made in countries where climate policies are weaker than in the EU. Other options include a tax on non-collected e-waste, a share of the tobacco excise duty and an annual lump-sum contribution from large firms operating and selling in the EU. Further proposals include a levy on extreme wealth, on digital services, online gambling and crypto asset capital gains. Ireland will now have to see which of these options, or a mix of them, has a chance to get unanimous support from all 27 EU countries by the next EU summit scheduled for October.

item.title: 米住宅ローン金利が急上昇、節目の7%を上回る－2年超ぶり高水準
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米国の住宅ローン金利が、この2年余りで最も高い水準に上昇した。米住宅市場は物件価格の高止まりと販売低迷で既に不振にあえいでいるが、ローン金利上昇がさらなる重しとなる。

全米抵当貸付銀行協会（MBA）が23日に発表したデータによれば、30年物固定住宅ローン金利は18日終了週に、前週比15ベーシスポイント（bp、1bp＝0.01%）上昇して7.12%となった。2024年5月以来の高水準だ。

当初5年間は固定金利でその後変動金利となるタイプの住宅ローン金利は、13bp低下して6.10%となった。

住宅ローン金利は2月以降、上昇基調にある。2月末にイラン戦争が勃発したことを受けてエネルギー価格が押し上げられ、インフレ懸念が再燃した。米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）は先週、物価上昇圧力を抑えるため、2023年以来となる利上げを実施した。

住宅ローン金利の上昇を受け、ローン申請をする人の数も減っている。MBAによれば、住宅購入のための申請指数は前週比0.8%低下して、4週間ぶりの低水準。借り換えのための申請指数は2.6％低下し、2025年2月以来の低い水準となった。

不動産仲介レッドフィンのチーフエコノミスト、ダリル・フェアウェザー氏は「7%という数字は重要だ。目にする最初の数字が7%では、心理的な影響を及ぼす」と述べた。

同氏は金利上昇によって住宅価格の伸びは抑えられる一方、販売の低迷は続くとみている。

米中古住宅販売件数は8月に減少し、25年6月以来の低い水準となった。米住宅建設業者の業況感は9月に1年ぶりの低水準となり、22年12月以来の最低に並んだ。金利上昇が住宅購入をためらわせているほか、建設資材や燃料の値上がりでコストも膨らんでいる。

原題：US Mortgage Rates Surge Above 7% to a More Than Two-Year High（抜粋）

item.description: WASHINGTON, Sept 23 : Verizon said on Wednesday it would invest $70 million in a nationwide effort to provide AI training to job seekers, small businesses and educators, as the US economy adapts to rapid technological change.The US telecom company is partnering with non-profit programs such as Goodwill Indust

FAST

WASHINGTON, Sept 23 : Verizon said on Wednesday it would invest $70 million in a nationwide effort to provide AI training to job seekers, small businesses and educators, as the US economy adapts to rapid technological change. The US telecom company is partnering with non-profit programs such as Goodwill Industries and aims to provide AI training to hundreds of thousands of people using training resources from companies including IBM, Google, Anthropic, Microsoft and OpenAI. "AI will change the face of the workforce," Verizon CEO Dan Schulman said in an interview. "We can't do it alone, by the way, but maybe we can inspire and be a bit of a role model." Schulman wants other large companies to join the effort and help fund programs that equip workers with skills for specific AI-related jobs.

"It's in the self-interest of all business leaders to step up," Schulman said. "If every Fortune 100 (company) put $50 million or $70 million into this, we have a multibillion-dollar fund." Verizon last year committed $20 million to help departing employees gain AI skills after announcing plans to cut 13,000 jobs. The new initiative adds a further $50 million. "We are very focused on relevant skills for relevant jobs in a transitioning economy," said Goodwill Industries CEO Steven Preston in an interview. "The requirement for AI in job descriptions by employers has just gone up exponentially. So they're looking for people who can apply AI in specific skills." The Verizon platform will offer free training tailored to specific occupations. Many workers view AI training as a "black hole", Preston said, because they are unsure where to begin. Goodwill began providing digital skills training in 2017 as employers increasingly demanded technology skills across a wide range of jobs. "This is providing access to meaningful roles that many people wouldn't have been able to compete for before," Preston said. Verizon senior vice president Donna Epps said the company chose to partner with an organisation such as Goodwill because it already has a strong presence in local communities and can provide hands-on support. "It's a massive challenge to create a AI ready workforce in the U.S.," Epps said.

item.title: McDonald's expects inflation to keep traffic flat, shares dip after $8.5 bln capex plan
item.description: McDonald's warned on Wednesday that industrywide customer traffic in key markets would likely remain flat as long as inflation remained elevated, sending its shares down as much as 6.5% even as it unveiled an $8.5 billion franchisee support plan and a slate of long-term growth initiatives.
item.dc:creator: Anuja Mistry, Waylon Cunningham
item.content:encoded: McDonald's (MCD.N) warned on Wednesday that industrywide customer traffic in key markets would likely remain flat as long as inflation remained elevated, sending its shares down as much as 6.5% even as it unveiled an $8.5 billion franchisee support plan and a slate of long-term growth initiatives. The warning reinforced investor concerns that McDonald's turnaround could take longer than expected, even as it rolls out its "NEXT" strategy to reignite growth after several quarters of slowing sales and intensifying competition from value-focused rivals. "Look at Starbucks, these changes don't happen overnight," said Jake Dollarhide, a McDonald's investor as CEO of Longbow Asset Management, referring to the [USN:L6N44V1E6 TEXT:"turnaround effort at Starbucks"] that took close to a year for investments to translate into boosted sales. Last month, McDonald's [USN:L6N44017R TEXT:"missed "]estimates for second-quarter US sales growth, citing execution missteps that hindered efforts to win back lower-income consumers who had cut back on dining out. Its shares, which are now down about 22% so far this year, dropped to a near four-year low of $234.03 on Wednesday. Newly appointed US business head [USN:L6N441161 TEXT:"Skye Anderson"] acknowledged those shortcomings on Wednesday, saying McDonald's had fallen short on "consistent execution" and needed to improve restaurant operations. The chain on Wednesday outlined an $8.5 billion, decade-long support package for franchisees, who bear hefty costs under the "NEXT" plan, and set new targets for restaurant productivity and operating margins in the low- to mid-50% range by 2030. "We expect industry traffic growth in our wholly owned markets will be flat while inflation remains elevated," CEO Chris Kempczinski said during an investor meeting. "The winners will be the companies that create more demand and deliver it more efficiently." Announced in June, McDonald's "NEXT" strategy focuses on improving food quality, hospitality, value and innovation, with executives on Wednesday providing the first detailed roadmap. The initiative includes simplifying operations, modernizing restaurant designs, investing in employee training and expanding the use of ArchIQ, an AI-powered restaurant operating system that automates tasks such as drive-thru ordering. Anderson, who was named as president of its US business last month to steer the company's turnaround strategy, said on Wednesday that McDonald's was also adapting to changing consumer preferences, including higher-protein options and greater portion flexibility for GLP-1 users. Anderson added that the company is exploring bowls, grilled chicken and egg bites to expand protein-centered options across breakfast, lunch and dinner. "Consumers are making choices based on more than price, and McDonald's needs to give them reasons to visit beyond a deal," eMarketer analyst Suzy Davidkhanian said. McDonald's has seen greater tensions with franchisees who have complained about eroding control and rising costs. McDonald's executives in August said execution of its under-$3 menu was hurt by a third of franchisees that did not participate. Dollarhide, the investor, said he has watched strains in McDonald's franchisee relations closely because a lack of franchisee buy-in can hurt execution of the company's strategies. US restaurant remodeling required by McDonald's and upgrades under the "NEXT" plan could cost at least $1.2 million for the average location. McDonald's will offer some assistance including rent relief, but the support does not extend to the cost of the remodels. "It's a big commitment for franchisees," said Dollarhide. Of the $8.5 billion investment, roughly $5 billion will be deployed by 2030 through rent relief and capital support for franchisees. The company expects the strategy to improve restaurant-level efficiency by 250 basis points, generating about $100,000 in additional annual cash flow for the average US restaurant. The burger chain expects restaurant expansion to contribute about 2.5% of systemwide sales growth in 2027 and around 2% by 2030. US foot traffic at McDonald's has declined year-over-year for every complete month since March, according to estimates from data analytics firm Placer.ai.

item.title: ガザ「平和評議会」、24.5億ドルの復興計画発表 停戦なお不透明
item.description:
Nidal al-Mughrabi
［２３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Nidal al-Mughrabi

［２３日　ロイター］ - トランプ米大統領が設置したパレスチナ自治区ガザの暫定統治機関「平和評議会」は２３日、総額２４億５０００万ドルの復興計画を発表した。計画はイスラエルとイスラム組織ハマスの約２年間に及ぶ戦闘で破壊されたガザ地区のインフラと経済の再建を目指す６６の事業で構成。ただ、米国が仲介する停戦を巡るイスラエルとハマスの隔たりは依然大きく、復興の先行きに不透明感が残っていることを当局者も認めた。

復興計画はニューヨークで開催されている国連総会に合わせて開かれたイベントで平和評議会が発表した。ガザ地区の物的被害額を３５２億ドルと見積もり、向こう１０年で完全な復旧・復興に約７１４億ドルが必要になると試算した。国境検問所の修復や電力・水道インフラの復旧のほか、２万５０００基の携帯型太陽光発電キットの配備、優先的な復興事業に必要な用地の地下にあるトンネルの恒久的な埋め戻しなどが盛り込まれた。

ルビオ米国務長官は記者団に対し「これは明らかに長期的な事業で、６カ月で実現できるものではない。ただ、少なくとも人々に希望を与えることができる。誰もが自らの役割を果たせば、このような未来が待っている」と語った。

トランプ大統領の娘婿でガザ復興計画の策定に関わったジャレッド・クシュナー氏は、復興計画がさまざまな理由で遅延していることを認めた上で、「計画をさらに練り上げ、行動に移すときに備えている」と述べた。

平和評議会のガザ地区担当首席特使、ニコライ・ムラデノフ氏は、ガザ地区を戦闘前の状態に戻すことを目指しているのではないとし、「ガザ地区のパレスチナ人と、国境を挟んで暮らすイスラエルの地域社会の双方が、長年にわたり生活を支配してきた暴力への恐怖を乗り越える機会を得られるようにしたい」と語った。

The outlook comes as Europe competes with Asia for LNG c

FAST

LONDON, Sept 23 : Global gas markets are increasingly pricing in tight supplies well beyond winter as the Iran war disrupts Gulf liquefied natural gas exports and complicates Europe's efforts to rebuild gas inventories, a top industry executive said. The outlook comes as Europe competes with Asia for LNG cargoes while attempting to refill storage sites ahead of winter, amid continued uncertainty over the conflict's impact on exports from Qatar, one of the world's largest LNG suppliers. Forward gas prices suggest traders expect elevated prices and supply risks to persist through next summer before easing, according to Menelaos Ydreos, secretary general of the International Gas Union (IGU), whose members represent more than 90 per cent of the global gas market. "The market right now is saying that they see the conflict getting prolonged," Ydreos told Reuters.

Current futures curves indicate markets expect tight conditions to continue into next year, a marked shift from a few months ago when traders expected prices to ease after winter, he said. "Europe is starting to outbid Asia because they need to refill storage levels," Ydreos said, adding that the current crisis differs from the energy shock that followed Russia's invasion of Ukraine in 2022 because it is affecting multiple regions at the same time. "There is some short-term demand destruction. The question is whether it rebounds after everything settles or whether there are some longer-term implications around policy," Ydreos said. Additional uncertainty stems from Europe's planned ban on Russian LNG imports from January. Russian cargoes currently heading to Europe would likely find alternative buyers, potentially at lower prices. But any disruption to those flows would add further strain to a market already grappling with concerns over Middle East supply, Ydreos said. European policymakers are also wrestling with how to balance climate goals with energy security and affordability, he said, adding that the European Commission should consider easing some implementation requirements while keeping emissions-reduction targets intact. "We're for regulations, but they have to be achievable, practical and incentivise compliance," he said. "If regulations go far beyond that and make it extremely difficult for the industry to comply, they'll look for other regions to send their product."

Source: Reuters

item.title: UK says will revisit Chagos deal after latest Trump criticism
item.description: LONDON: Britain will rework its deal to return the Chagos Islands to Mauritius, a minister confirmed on Wednesday (Sep 23), after US President Donald Trump branded the agreement "terrible" during his first meeting with UK leader Andy Burnham.London's decision to hand back the Indian Ocean archipelago to its f
item.dc:creator: CNA

UK says will revisit Chagos deal after latest Trump criticism

FAST

LONDON: Britain will rework its deal to return the Chagos Islands to Mauritius, a minister confirmed on Wednesday (Sep 23), after US President Donald Trump branded the agreement "terrible" during his first meeting with UK leader Andy Burnham. London's decision to hand back the Indian Ocean archipelago to its former colony and pay to lease a strategic US-UK military base on Diego Garcia has been a bone of contention with Trump's administration for months. The UK confirmed in April that it was pausing the plans agreed last year between the Mauritian government and Britain's then-prime minister Keir Starmer. It faced vocal opposition from Trump, who had initially supported the pact, but then later branded it "an act of great stupidity".

The unpredictable American leader railed against the deal again on Tuesday in his first face-to-face with Burnham, who replaced Starmer in July. Meeting on the sidelines of the United Nations General Assembly in New York, Trump said he believed Burnham would be reconsidering the "terrible deal", as the UK leader sat beside him, nodded and said "yep". Burnham later told broadcasters Britain would "work hard" to find a resolution on the thorny issue and that he was "confident we can find it working with our US partners". Hours later, Defence Secretary Wes Streeting said Trump's opposition was "not news to us" but that his latest comments "provide absolute clarity that his position on this Chagos deal as currently drafted is not changing". "So we have to do more work with our American allies, with President Trump and his administration, to get the deal to a place where we can support it," he told the BBC on Wednesday. Streeting confirmed that annual payments worth at least £120 million (US$159 million) to lease back the military base from Mauritius would not be made "at this stage". Starmer struck the deal after insisting that international legal rulings have put Britain's ownership of the Chagos in doubt and only a deal with Mauritius would guarantee continued US and UK use of the base. "MILLSTONE?" Britain kept control of the Chagos Islands after Mauritius gained independence in the 1960s. It evicted thousands of Chagos islanders who have since mounted a series of legal claims for compensation in British courts. In 2019, the International Court of Justice recommended that Britain hand the archipelago to Mauritius. The deal would have given Britain a 99-year lease of the base, with the option to extend. James Cartlidge, defence spokesman for the main opposition Conservative party, said the agreement "should be binned entirely". But Streeting told Times Radio: "The ostrich strategy of sticking our heads in the sand and hoping it (will) go away ... is not a wise strategy when it concerns one of the most sensitive national security assets we have anywhere in the world." Jack Pannell, a senior researcher at the British Foreign Policy Group think-tank, said Burnham's priorities with Trump would be on "the big international issues" like AI regulation, Ukraine and the Middle East. "Success for Burnham means avoiding this issue becoming a millstone around his neck while he pursues his other foreign policy priorities and focuses on his domestic agenda," Pannell told AFP. "The chances of a breakthrough on this issue are slim, and that may suit the prime minister just fine." On Tuesday, Trump signed a security deal with the leaders of Greenland and Denmark that will allow the US to build two military bases in southern and eastern Greenland.

Source: Reuters/ec

item.title: 英保険・資産運用のL&G、従業員約10%を削減へ－来年半ばまでに
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 英国の保険・資産運用大手リーガル・アンド・ジェネラル・グループ（L&G）は、組織簡素化の一環として、従業員数を約1割削減する方針だ。

ブルームバーグ・ニュースが確認した23日付の従業員向け電子メールによると、同社は、来年半ばまでに約1000人のポストを削減する計画に着手した。この計画に詳しい関係者によると、英国では当初、希望退職を募るが、状況に応じて会社都合による人員削減も検討する。

1兆2000億ポンド（約250兆円）の資産を運用する投資運用部門は、すでに独自の再編計画を進めているため、希望退職プログラムの対象外となる。内部情報だとして匿名を条件に関係者が明らかにした。

L&Gの約1万人の従業員の大半は英国に勤務している。同社の広報担当者は電子メールで、これらの変更は変革の「次の段階」に当たり、「組織体制や働き方を、現在構築している事業と、事業を展開する急速に変化する環境に即したものにする」と説明。「長期的な成長機会が最も大きいとみている分野に、リソースと投資を集中させることにもつながる」と述べた。

原題：L&G Seeks to Cut About 10% of Workforce by Middle of 2027 (1)

--取材協力：Will Standring、Michael Msika.

item.title: 米30年物住宅ローン金利7.12％、2年超ぶり高水準＝米抵当銀行協会
item.description:
Ann Saphir
［２３日 ロイター］ - 米抵当銀行協会（ＭＢＡ）が２３日発表した３０年固定住宅ローンの週平均...

item.content:encoded:
米30年物住宅ローン金利7.12％、2年超ぶり高水準＝米抵当銀行協会 9/23 20:11 配信

カリフォルニア州カールスバッドで16日撮影　REUTERS/Mike Blake

Ann Saphir

［２３日　ロイター］ - 米抵当銀行協会（ＭＢＡ）が２３日発表した３０年固定住宅ローンの週平均金利（１８日までの週）は７．１２％で、前週から１５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇し２０２４年５月以来の高水準となった。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が利上げをし、住宅ローン金利の基準となる米国債利回りが上昇した。

ＭＢＡによると、借り換えと住宅購入向けのローン申請は減少した。借り手の間では変動金利型住宅ローン（ＡＲＭ）の利用が増え、住宅ローン申請に占めるＡＲＭの割合は９．８％だった。ＡＲＭは固定金利型より当初の借入コストが低い一方、数年後にはその時点の市場金利に応じて金利が見直される。

２月下旬に米国とイスラエルがイランを攻撃し、原油価格を押し上げて以降、住宅ローン金利は１％ポイント超上昇。住宅購入を検討する人をためらわせ、米住宅市場を冷え込ませている。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か 焦点：トランプ政権の影で歩み寄るカナダとＥＵ、準加盟提示でも見える限界 コラム：ＡＩ相場はドットコム・バブルの再来か、強気派に分がある理由 焦点：中国株、ＧＤＰ発表後も買い不発　不動産低迷で慎重ムード コラム：トランプ米大統領、任期中の利下げは望み薄　市場は高金利長期化を想定 最終更新: 9/23(水) 20:11 ロイター

item.title: ロシア「和平協議の用意ある」、前提条件なお整わず キーウ攻撃継続
item.description:
Daniel Flynn Pavel Polityuk
［モスクワ／キーウ ２３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Daniel Flynn　Pavel Polityuk

［モスクワ／キーウ　２３日　ロイター］ - ロシアのペスコフ大統領報道官は２３日、ウクライナ和平協議を行う前提条件は依然として整っていないと述べる一方で、和平協議に応じる姿勢は維持していると述べた。ウクライナの首都キーウでは、ロシアによるドローン（小型無人機）攻撃で少なくとも２人が死亡した。

ペスコフ氏は記者団に対し、「現時点で平和的な交渉の軌道に移る前提条件はない。ただ、ロシア側としては和平協議に引き続き応じる用意がある」と述べた。

トランプ米大統領とウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は２２日、ニューヨークで会談した。ゼレンスキー氏は、トランプ氏を交えた３者会談の方式でプーチン大統領と会談する用意があると表明した。

ペスコフ氏は、両首脳が必要と判断すれば、プーチン氏はトランプ氏と１対１の会談を行う用意があると述べたが、ゼレンスキー氏との直接会談を巡るロシアの立場に変化はないと明確にした。

ロシアはかねて、ゼレンスキー氏がロシア側の条件を満たした上で、モスクワで会談する必要があると主張。ウクライナ政府はこれを拒否し、協議は中立国で開催すべきとしている。

ペスコフ氏は首脳会談の構想についても慎重な見方を示した。「一般論として、専門家レベルで下準備が整う前に首脳会談を開くのは、他のいかなる状況でも不適切だ。時間の無駄になる」と語った。

＜ロシア、キーウを激しく攻撃＞

ロシアは２３日、キーウをドローンで激しく攻撃し、キーウ市当局によると、少なくとも２人が死亡、３０人以上が負傷した。鉄道インフラや倉庫、給油所が攻撃された。

市中心部では爆発音が聞かれ、煙が立ち上った。欧州連合（ＥＵ）のマテルノバ駐ウクライナ大使は交流サイトへの投稿で、「これはきょう、ＥＵ代表部の窓から見える光景だ。近くの建物が燃えている」と述べた。

攻撃は午前から午後早い時間にかけて数時間継続。ロシアが迎撃が困難な高速・高高度飛行のジェット推進型ドローンを用いた攻撃を開始して以降、最も激しい攻撃の一つとなった。

ゼレンスキー大統領は、ロシアがこの日の攻撃に投入した無人機の多くがジェット推進型だったとし、「ロシアは引き続き民間施設や重要インフラを標的にしている。製薬施設、ガソリンスタンド、鉄道、通信インフラ、ショッピングモールが攻撃対象となっている」と非難した。

＜ロシア国防省、データセンターと物流拠点標的と表明＞

ロシア国防省はその後、ウクライナ軍を支援するために使用されているとして、複数のデータセンターと物流・倉庫施設を攻撃したと表明。通信アプリ「テレグラム」への投稿で、首都キーウの２カ所のデータセンターのほか、黒海沿岸の港湾都市オデーサの２カ所の物流拠点を標的に攻撃したと明らかにした。

ウクライナのデジタル省によると、ロシアによる攻撃でキーウと周辺地域で約１０万世帯のインターネットが一時的に遮断された。

ウクライナ東部ドネツク州の前線地域にある集落に対してもロシア軍による攻撃があり、少なくとも４人が死亡、４人が負傷した。

item.description: SEOUL: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung and US President Donald Trump welcomed "significant progress" in discussions on strategic investment projects during a 30-minute meeting on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly, Seoul's presidential office said on Wednesday (Sep 23).The meeting came after South

item.content:encoded:

South Korea says Trump welcomes progress in US strategic investment projects

US President Donald Trump meets with South Korean President Lee Jae Myung on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) leaders' summit in Gyeongju, South Korea, on Oct 29, 2025. (Photo: REUTERS/Evelyn Hockstein)

SEOUL: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung and US President Donald Trump welcomed "significant progress" in discussions on strategic investment projects during a 30-minute meeting on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly, Seoul's presidential office said on Wednesday (Sep 23). The meeting came after South Korea's Industry Ministry briefed lawmakers on Tuesday on implementation plans under the countries' US$350 billion investment package, including a Texas gas-fired power project identified as a potential first investment, as well as possible investments in nuclear energy and an Alaskan LNG project. "The two leaders welcomed the significant progress made in discussions on strategic investment projects between the two countries," National Security Adviser Wi Sung-lac told a briefing. Based on the Joint Fact Sheet issued after their summit last November, Lee and Trump also agreed to deepen cooperation and continue discussions on issues including nuclear fuel enrichment and reprocessing, nuclear-powered submarines, shipbuilding and the transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON) from the US to South Korea, Wi said.

Trump also reaffirmed his willingness to engage in dialogue with North Korea, Wi said, with the two leaders agreeing to remain in close communication in pursuit of a peace process. Lee also said the US-China summit scheduled for Thursday would be important for regional developments, including South Korea-China relations, according to Wi. The White House did not immediately comment on the Trump-Lee meeting. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Friday called for the swift execution of South Korean investment commitments during a meeting with South Korean Foreign Minister Cho Hyun, the State Department said. In a post on X, Lee said he had an in-depth discussion with Trump on the progress made on investment projects and reaffirmed their commitment to further strengthening the alliance.

Related:

North Korea fires unidentified projectile into East Sea: Seoul

Court orders North Korea pay Seoul US$32.5 million for blowing up office

DISCUSSED NORTH KOREA, GOLF Earlier on Wednesday, Lee told the UN General Assembly that Seoul would support efforts to revive dialogue with North Korea and work toward a durable peace framework while seeking broader international backing for those efforts. A senior presidential official separately told South Korean media outlets that Lee had told Trump he hoped the US president would help advance engagement with North Korea, to which Trump replied that he would do so. The official said Trump also remarked that he maintained a good relationship with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, though there was no indication of any specific contact currently taking place, the media reports said. The official said Lee and Trump also spent considerable time discussing OPCON transfer, with Trump gaining a better understanding of Seoul's position. The US side stressed the need to meet the required conditions and complete the process as soon as possible. The South Korean side outlined plans to increase defence spending, while expressing a desire to accelerate talks on developing nuclear-powered submarines, the official said. The official was also quoted as saying that progress in talks on investments in US projects helped pave the way for the summit, which had not initially been expected to take place. The two leaders had been briefed on the negotiations and welcomed the progress, but discussions were still under way on the details of the package and how it would be announced, the official said. "The bigger framework is almost complete," the official was quoted as saying. Lee later said on X that Trump had reminded him of their plan to play golf together, first discussed in France in June, and that he hoped they could continue their discussions at the G20 summit in Miami later this year.

Source: Reuters/ec

item.title: Líderes IA advierten a ONU de riesgos para seguridad mientras sistemas se vuelven más potentes
item.description: Directivos de tres de las principales empresas de inteligencia artificial del mundo informaron el miércoles al Consejo de Seguridad de la ONU, en medio de advertencias de que los sistemas de IA, cada vez más potentes, podrían pronto mejorar por sí mismos, escapar al control humano y suponer una amenaza para la seguridad internacional.
item.dc:creator: Michelle Nichols, John Irish, Courtney Rozen
item.content:encoded: Directivos de tres de las principales empresas de inteligencia artificial del mundo informaron el miércoles al Consejo de Seguridad de la ONU, en medio de advertencias de que los sistemas de IA, cada vez más potentes, podrían pronto mejorar por sí mismos, escapar al control humano y suponer una amenaza para la seguridad internacional. Entre quienes se dirigieron al Consejo, compuesto por 15 miembros, durante la reunión anual de la Asamblea General se encontraban el director ejecutivo de OpenAI, Sam Altman; el director ejecutivo de Anthropic, Dario Amodei, y el cofundador de Hugging Face, Clément Delangue, tres de los ejecutivos más destacados del sector. "Si se gestiona mal, incluso creo que la IA podría suponer un riesgo para la humanidad en su conjunto", declaró Amodei, de Anthropic, ante el Consejo de Seguridad. Los gobiernos se han enfrentado al reto de cómo supervisar unos sistemas de IA que avanzan más rápido de lo que los reguladores pueden seguir el ritmo, mientras que Estados Unidos y China —los dos actores dominantes en el desarrollo de la IA— siguen divididos sobre si la tecnología necesita medidas de control globales o si debe dejarse en gran medida en manos de las fuerzas del mercado. "Para que la IA sea democrática, las decisiones más importantes no pueden tomarlas únicamente los laboratorios de San Francisco. Deben configurarse mediante procesos democráticos y por gobiernos que rindan cuentas ante las personas a las que sirven", declaró Altman ante el Consejo. "A nivel internacional, esto requerirá cooperación". "A lo largo de nuestra historia, ha habido momentos en los que países que compiten entre sí y que no siempre se caen muy bien se han unido por intereses comunes y por el bien colectivo ante una nueva tecnología poderosa. Creemos que este debe ser uno de esos momentos", afirmó. Yoshua Bengio, un canadiense considerado uno de los "padrinos de la IA" y copresidente del Panel Científico Internacional Independiente —creado por la Asamblea General de la ONU el año pasado—, declaró ante el Consejo de Seguridad: "Los peligros son reales e inminentes". "Este Consejo se enfrenta a una amenaza sin precedentes, una que ninguno de sus miembros elegiría, que ninguno puede contener por sí solo y que no respeta las fronteras que defendemos", señaló. Los miembros del Consejo, entre los que se encontraban Estados Unidos y China —principales rivales en materia de IA—, también tenían previsto intervenir. El ministro de Asuntos Exteriores francés, Jean-Noël Barrot, presidió la reunión. TRUMP QUIERE FOMENTAR LA IA, NO FRENARLA Antes de la reunión entre el presidente estadounidense Donald Trump, y el líder chino, Xi Jinping, que tendrá lugar este jueves en Washington, Estados Unidos y China han debatido la creación de un sistema de notificación de objetivos y amenazas comunes que abarque los incidentes relacionados con la IA que alcancen un nivel de seguridad nacional. Trump declaró el martes ante los líderes mundiales en la Asamblea General de la ONU que "rechaza cualquier intento de construir un plan globalista para controlar" la IA, calificando la tecnología de "asombrosa", pero señaló que Estados Unidos actuaría con cautela. "Ahora mismo llevamos una gran ventaja sobre China y sobre todos los demás, y vamos a mantener esa situación", afirmó Trump. "No voy a frenar el crecimiento de algo que será más grande que la Revolución Industrial". "Vamos a fomentarla, no a frenarla. La supervisaremos de cerca a través del Departamento de Justicia", añadió. El secretario general de la ONU, António Guterres, que lleva mucho tiempo abogando por una gobernanza global de la IA, ha advertido de que los rápidos avances de la inteligencia artificial plantean riesgos que no pueden ignorarse, lo que le sitúa en desacuerdo con Trump.

item.title: 中国当局、不動産大手の延滞融資巡り銀行に窓口指導か 不良債権分類防ぐ
item.description: [２２日 ロイター] - 中国の金融規制当局が、中国不動産大手の万科企業の延滞融資を不良債権に分類せず、返済期限を延...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国当局、不動産大手の延滞融資巡り銀行に窓口指導か　不良債権分類防ぐ 9/23 19:37 配信

北京で2025年12月撮影　REUTERS/Tingshu Wang

[２２日 ロイター] - 中国の金融規制当局が、中国不動産大手の万科企業の延滞融資を不良債権に分類せず、返済期限を延長するよう一部銀行に求めたことが、事情に詳しい複数の関係者の話で分かった。

関係者によると、当局は、万科の債務不履行回避に向けた非公式の「窓口指導」で、金融機関に同社を支援し、資金繰り悪化につながる行動を控えるようを行った。

一部銀行に、万科が支払うべき利息の回収を当面見合わせるよう求めたという。

ロイターは指導を受けた銀行数を確認できなかったが、関係者は、主に規模の大きい銀行が対象と述べた。

融資を不良債権に分類しない期間は定められておらず、不動産市場の動向や万科との今後の協議に左右されるという。

万科は長期化する不動産不況下で経営難に陥りながらも、国有企業の資金支援もあって債務不履行を回避してきた数少ない不動産開発会社の一つ。

万科は販売低迷で手元資金が減少し、２０２５年は過去最大の８８６億元の赤字となった。２６年上期は１４９億５０００万元の純損失、売上高は前年同期比３３％減の７０２億元だった。

関係者の１人は、金融当局が市場の信認に与える打撃を懸念し、国有株主との結び付きが強い不動産開発会社で「リスク事象」が起きるのを防ごうとしていると述べた。

item.title: Iran, US still far apart in peace talks, Iranian official says; Pezeshkian vows no surrender
item.description: Iran and the United States remain far apart on how to end their war but diplomacy must continue, a senior Iranian official told Reuters on Wednesday, after Iran's president told the UN General Assembly that Tehran would never surrender to US pressure.
item.dc:creator: Parisa Hafezi, Humeyra Pamuk, Jana Choukeir
item.content:encoded: Iran and the United States remain far apart on how to end their war but diplomacy must continue, a senior Iranian official told Reuters on Wednesday, after Iran's president told the UN General Assembly that Tehran would never surrender to US pressure. Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, in [USN:L6N45F0T5 TEXT:"his speech"] in New York, condemned what he called "signs of a bullying mentality" from US President Donald Trump, who had used the same forum on Tuesday to threaten to "annihilate" Iran. The duelling speeches at the annual UN gathering bookended the first shuttle talks between the US and Iran for months, though they appeared to have yielded no concessions in the public stance of either side towards ending the war . The senior Iranian official, speaking on condition of anonymity, said Tehran was reviewing Washington's response to its peace proposals, which prioritise lifting a US naval blockade on Iranian ports and reopening the Strait of Hormuz. "There are still many differences between the Iranian and US positions, but diplomacy is continuing," the official said. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio told reporters on Wednesday that a deal with Iran would involve hard work over a period of time, adding that Trump also had military options. The US has also said it will impose so-called secondary sanctions against any country that allows Iranian flights after Wednesday. Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, told state TV Iran would ensure neighbouring countries' airports could not function if they stop Iranian flights. IRAN 'WILL NOT BOW TO PRESSURE', PRESIDENT SAYS In his address to the 193-member General Assembly, Pezeshkian homed in on the US blockade of Iranian ports and on the Strait of Hormuz, conduit for a fifth of global oil and liquefied natural gas shipments before the war. "It cannot be the case that everyone benefits from the Strait of Hormuz while we are denied access to shipping through this waterway. The permanent deployment of hostile fleets and the expansion of the war will not lead to peace," he said. "The Iranian people will not bow to pressure," he added. Iran wants to exert control over the strait and collect fees from ships that use it. Washington rejects this and says the strait must remain fully open to international shipping. Oil prices were [USN:L1N45F01U TEXT:"up almost 2%"] on Wednesday in choppy trade as traders weighed the comments of Pezeshkian and Trump. Trump on Tuesday argued that he had prevented Tehran from obtaining a nuclear weapon and could "annihilate the Islamic Republic" if no deal is reached to end the conflict. Pezeshkian on Wednesday reiterated Iran's line that it is not seeking nuclear weapons. Iranian and US officials held their first known indirect talks on Tuesday since a ceasefire collapsed in July, with Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi and US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner communicating through mediators. Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmail Baghaei said Tehran had conveyed conditions during a two-hour exchange of messages with Washington via a Qatari mediator. These included an end to the war on all fronts, a halt to US "acts of aggression" and the release of frozen Iranian assets. IRAN HARDLINERS RESIST DIPLOMATIC MOVES The diplomatic contact in New York caused a backlash in Iranian media associated with hardliners. An opinion piece run by the semi-official Tasnim news agency, associated with the Revolutionary Guards, said Araqchi was wrong to have contacts with Witkoff and Kushner, "a major gift to Trump", as Iran had already conveyed its terms. Iranian sources told Reuters the delegation had been ordered not to meet the Americans face-to-face by the Supreme National Security Council, a body that includes figures selected by Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei, the supreme leader. Khamenei has yet to appear in public since replacing his father, who was killed on the war's first day. One Iranian journalist covering the visit told Reuters that some hardliners viewed the trip to New York itself as an insult to the memory of the slain leader, Ali Khamenei. The war, launched by Trump in February alongside Israel as "Operation Epic Fury", has lasted nearly seven months, killing thousands of people, disrupting global energy supplies and spreading to other countries in the region — particularly to Lebanon and more recently to Yemen. In the latest reported attack in the Strait of Hormuz, Britain's UKMTO maritime security agency said [USN:S8N44D002 TEXT:"a cargo ship had been hit by projectiles"], causing two casualties among the crew. The crew was evacuated and the ship was on fire and adrift. Despite near-daily attacks, traffic through the strait has picked up in recent weeks. Oil producers pay shipping companies fees of as much as a quarter of a cargo's value to take the wartime risk of sailing through the strait with [USN:L1N45A0KR TEXT:"transponders switched off"], before transferring crude to other vessels on the far side. Exports from the United Arab Emirates have already recovered to pre-war levels, and Saudi Arabia has sold 60 million barrels of Gulf oil for both this month and next, to be delivered beyond the strait off the coast of Oman. Nevertheless, [USN:L6N44U0L7 TEXT:"a third of Gulf oil is estimated to be missing"] from global supplies. Shortages have particularly hit refined products such as diesel, causing inflation, pushing up interest rates and hurting Trump's Republicans.

item.title: Tigrayan leaders say new war with Ethiopian government has begun
item.description: Forces from the northern Ethiopian region of Tigray launched a major offensive against the federal government on Wednesday, a senior Ethiopian official said, shattering a four-year-old peace deal and threatening a wider regional conflict.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Forces from the northern Ethiopian region of Tigray launched a major offensive against the federal government on Wednesday, a senior Ethiopian official said, shattering a four-year-old peace deal and threatening a wider regional conflict. Tigray's leaders said in a statement they had entered a "defensive" war to counter aggression by the federal government. A civil war that began in 2020 between the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF) and federal forces resulted in hundreds of thousands of deaths before the Pretoria Agreement, brokered by the African Union, was signed in November 2022. The new hostilities follow months of growing animosity between the two sides, capped by Sunday's announcement that the TPLF had [USN:L6N45D0K7 TEXT:"formed an alliance"] with six other armed groups from across Ethiopia aimed at overthrowing Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed's government. The TPLF-led regional administration said there had been an "intensification of the invasion conducted through various methods" by Abiy's government against the people of Tigray. "The Tigray Forces have been instructed to counter the attack and have entered a defensive war," it said in a statement. Getachew Reda, an adviser to Abiy and a former TPLF official, wrote on X that the TPLF had seized control of federally controlled airports in Tigray and launched an "all-out offensive" against government positions in the neighbouring regions of Afar and Amhara. "The TPLF politico-military leadership has obviously taken irresponsibility to new heights," he said. Ethiopian Airlines suspended flights to the region. FEARS OF A WIDER WAR Spokespeople for Abiy, the federal government and the TPLF did not respond to requests for comment on Wednesday. The chair of the African Union Commission, Mahmoud Ali Youssouf, urged the warring parties to immediately de-escalate tensions and hold direct talks, and called on neighbouring countries not to contribute to further escalation. The US ambassador to Ethiopia, Ervin J. Massinga, accused the TPLF leadership, which had sanctions imposed on it by the US State Department in June, of "engaging in an unwinnable fight" and called for political dialogue. Regional diplomats and analysts have warned for months that a resumption of the conflict in Tigray could quickly escalate into a wider war, overlapping with fighting in neighbouring Sudan and further roiling the volatile Red Sea region. A [USN:L6N40Y0KB TEXT:"civil war"] that broke out in 2023 in Sudan has drawn in powerful states from outside the Horn of Africa and created what the UN describes as the world's largest humanitarian crisis. In the 2020-2022 Tigray war, Ethiopia's neighbour and historical adversary Eritrea backed the government militarily against the TPLF, but relations between the two countries have soured since then. Abiy's spokesperson, Billene Seyoum, said on Monday members of the newly announced alliance had been collaborating for a while with Eritrea's financial backing. Eritrea has denied accusations it supports Ethiopian armed groups. Its information minister declined comment on Wednesday about the latest developments. ARMED GROUPS SIDE WITH TPLF In Afar, Tigrayan forces were fighting alongside a local armed group, and in Amhara, they were fighting alongside the Fano militia, said a senior Ethiopian government official, a diplomatic source, a humanitarian source and another source with links to the TPLF and Fano. Fano sided with the federal government during the 2020-2022 war, but rose up against it in 2023 in an ongoing insurgency that has resulted in thousands of deaths. It is a member of the new alliance with the TPLF. The regional government in Afar accused the TPLF on Wednesday of launching an invasion and said Afari forces would defend themselves in coordination with their allies. In Amhara, federal forces were firing heavy weapons from a camp in the town of Lalibela, whose rock-hewn churches date back to the 12th and 13th centuries, two residents told Reuters. The firing targeted advancing Fano forces some 50 km (30 miles) outside the town, the residents said. The wider scale and intensity of the fighting were not clear. Jawar Mohammed, a political analyst and formerly a close ally of Abiy, said the federal government was limiting its engagement to try to prove to the international community that the TPLF was the instigator. The federal government is in a tactically stronger position than in 2020 because of its large stocks of drones and divisions within the TPLF, said Edward Bach, Senior Africa Analyst at risk intelligence company Verisk Maplecroft. Tigray is yet to recover from the humanitarian toll of the 2020-2022 war, which pushed hundreds of thousands into famine conditions. Around 750,000 Tigrayans were still internally displaced as of February, according to the UN refugee agency, and the region faces drought linked to El Nino. The Ethiopian military has carried out several drone strikes against Tigrayan forces in recent months, according to data from the Armed Conflict Location & Event Data project. The federal government has not commented on any of the reported strikes.
